author: andrew-murray
fields.title: Obwetoowaze
fields.description: Andrew Murray anokola mu magezi amakulu ag'obwetoowaze, ng'awakanya okwegulumiza mu nsi eyeeraliikirira nnyo okwegulumiza. Ayoleka ensonga essatu ez'obwetoowaze: nga bitonde, ng'aboonoonyi, era ng'abatukuvu, ng'aggya obulokozi mu ggye ery'omu ggulu, mu Yesu, ne mu kisa kya Katonda. Murray awakanya endowooza enkyamu, ng'assa essira ku bwetoowaze nga kwe kwenyigira mu bulamu bwa Kristo era nga kwe kutuukiriza okusinga obulungi ekigendererwa kyaffe. Ebirimu: Ekitiibwa ky'Ekitonde—Ekyama ky'Okununulibwa—Obwetoowaze mu Bulamu bwa Yesu—Obwetoowaze mu Kuyigiriza kwa Yesu—Obwetoowaze mu Bayigirizwa ba Yesu—Obwetoowaze mu Bulamu obwa Buli Lunaku—Obwetoowaze n'Obutukuvu—Obwetoowaze n'Ekibi—Obwetoowaze n'Okukkiriza—Obwetoowaze n'Okufa eri Omuntu ku Bwe—Obwetoowaze n'Essanyu—Obwetoowaze n'Okugulumizibwa—Okusaba olw'Obwetoowaze.

fields.title: Ekitiibwa ky'Ekitonde
fields.body_html:
"Ggwe osaanira, Mukama waffe era Katonda waffe, okuweebwa ekitiibwa n'ettendo n'amaanyi, kubanga ggwe watonda ebintu byonna, era olw'okwagala kwo byabaawo ne bitondebwa." Okub. 4:11.

Katonda bwe yatonda obutonde bwonna, ekigendererwa kyali kimu: okufuula ekitonde okugabana ku bulungi bwe obutuukiridde n'omukisa gwe, bw'atyo n'ayolesa mu kyo ekitiibwa ky'okwagala kwe, n'amagezi ge, n'amaanyi ge. Katonda yayagala okweyoleka mu bitonde ne ng'ayita mu byo, ng'abitegeeza ku bulungi bwe n'ekitiibwa kye ng'ekigero bye byali bisobola okukikkiriza. Naye okutegeeza kuno tekwali kuwa kitonde kintu kye kyandibadde nga kirina mu kyokka, obulamu oba obulungi obumu, kye kyandifuga era ne kikozesa nga bwe kyagala. Nedda n'akatono. Naye nga Katonda bw'ali oyo omulamu bulijjo, aliwo bulijjo, akola bulijjo, awanirira ebintu byonna n'ekigambo ky'amaanyi ge, era ebintu byonna mwe biri, enkolagana y'ekitonde ne Katonda teyandibadde okuggyako ey'okwesigama okutaggwaawo, okutuufu ddala, era okw'ensi yonna. Nga Katonda bwe yatonda edda n'amaanyi ge mu mazima, mu mazima gago n'amaanyi ago ge kigwana okukuuma buli kaseera.

Ekitonde tekigwana kutunula mabega gokka eri ensibuko n'entandikwa ey'olubereberye ey'okubaawo kwakyo, ne kikkiriza nti eyo kirina ebbanja lya buli kintu eri Katonda — nga ye kwe kwerinda kwakyo okusinga, obutuukirivu bwakyo obw'oku ntikko, n'essanyu lyakyo lyokka, kaakano ne mu bulamu obutaggwaawo bwonna — naye era kiteekwa okweyanjula ng'ekibya ekitaliimu, Katonda mw'ayinza okubeera n'alaga amaanyi ge n'obulungi bwe.

Obulamu Katonda bw'agaba tebuweebwa mulundi gumu okumalira ddala, wabula buli kaseera obutasalako, olw'okukola okutaggwaawo okw'amaanyi ge amangi. Obwetoowaze, ekifo eky'okwesigama kwonna ku Katonda, mu butonde bw'ebintu bwennyini, gwe mulimu ogusooka era obutuukirivu obusingira ddala obw'ekitonde, era gwe muzi gwa buli butuukirivu.

Bw'atyo amalala, oba okufiirwa obwetoowaze buno, gwe muzi gwa buli kibi na buli kibi ekyonoona. Bamalayika abaagwa, bwe baatandika okwetunuulira n'okwesiima, bwe baatuusibwa mu bujeemu, ne basuulibwa okuva mu kitangaala ky'eggulu ne bagenda mu kizikiza eky'ebweru. Mu ngeri y'emu, omusota bwe gwafuuwa obutwa bw'amalala gaagwo, okwegomba okuba nga Katonda, mu mitima gya bajjajjaffe abaasooka, nabo bwe baava mu kitiibwa kyabwe ekya waggulu ne bagwa mu bunaku bwonna omuntu mw'agudde kaakano. Mu ggulu ne mu nsi, amalala n'okwegulumiza gy'emiryango, kwe kuzaalibwa, era kye kikolimo eky'amagombe.

Tewali kirala kiyinza kuba kununula lwaffe okuggyako okuzzibwa obuggya kw'obwetoowaze obwabula, enkolagana ey'olubereberye era eyokka ey'amazima ey'ekitonde ne Katonda waakyo. Bw'atyo Yesu yajja okukomyawo obwetoowaze ku nsi, okutufuula abagabana ku bwo, era n'abwo okutulokola. Mu ggulu, yeetoowaza n'afuuka omuntu. Obwetoowaze bwe tulaba mu ye bwali bumuliko mu ggulu; bwe bwamuleeta era ye n'abuleeta okuva eyo. Wano ku nsi "yeetoowaza, n'agonda okutuusa ku kufa" (Abafiripi 2:8); obwetoowaze bwe bwawa okufa kwe omuwendo, bwe butyo ne bufuuka okununula lwaffe. Ne kaakano obulokozi bw'agaba si butono era si kirala wabula kwe kutegeeza obulamu bwe n'okufa kwe, empisa ye n'omwoyo gwe, obwetoowaze bwe, ng'omusingi n'omuzi gw'enkolagana ye ne Katonda n'omulimu gwe ogw'okununula.

Yesu Kristo yatwala ekifo era n'atuukiriza ekigendererwa ky'omuntu, ng'ekitonde, olw'obulamu bwe obw'obwetoowaze obutuukiridde. Obwetoowaze bwe bwe bulokozi bwaffe, n'obulokozi bwe bwe bwetoowaze bwaffe. Obulamu bw'abalokole n'obw'abatukuvu buteekwa okubeera n'akabonero kano ak'okununulibwa mu kibi, n'okuzzibwa okutuukiridde mu mbeera yaabwe ey'olubereberye; enkolagana yaabwe yonna ne Katonda n'abantu ng'erangibwa obwetoowaze obubuna mu byonna. Awatali kino, tewayinza kubaawo kubeera kwa mazima mu maaso ga Katonda, oba okulaba ekisa kye n'amaanyi g'Omwoyo gwe, wabula okubulwako okukkiriza okunywevu, n'okwagala, n'essanyu, n'amaanyi.

Obwetoowaze gwe ttaka lyokka ebisa gye bisimba emirandira. Noolwekyo, obutaba na bwetoowaze kwe kunnyonnyola okumala olwa buli bulema na buli kulemererwa. Obwetoowaze si kisa oba butuukirivu obumu ku bulala bwokka; gwe muzi gwa byonna, kubanga gwe gwokka omuwendo omutuufu mu maaso ga Katonda, era gukkiriza ye okukola byonna nga Katonda. Katonda yatukola ng'ebitonde eby'amagezi ng'ekitegeerwa eky'obutuufu bw'obutonde bw'ekiragiro oba obwetaavu bwakyo obw'amazima bwe kirala kituufu, bwe kityo n'okugonda kwaffe eri kyo bwe kunaaba okwanguyirivu era okujjuvu. Okuyitibwa okudda mu bwetoowaze tekufiibwako mu Kkanisa kubanga obutonde bwakwo obw'amazima n'obukulu bwakwo tebitegeereddwa bulungi.

Si kintu kye tuleetera Katonda, oba ky'atuwa; wabula bwe bumanyi obw'okubeera ekitaliiko kyonna obujja bwe tulaba engeri Katonda gy'ali byonna mu mazima, era mwe tuwa Katonda ekkubo okuba byonna. Ekitonde bwe kitegeera nti buno bwe bukungu obw'amazima, ne kikkiriza n'okwagala kwakyo, ebirowoozo byakyo n'okumatiza kwakyo bikola ekibya obulamu n'ekitiibwa kya Katonda mwe binaakolera ne byeyoleka. Kirengera obwetoowaze nga kwokka kwe kukkiriza amazima g'ekifo kyakyo ng'ekitonde n'okwewaayo eri Katonda.

Mu bulamu bw'Abakristaayo abanyiikivu, abo abanoonya era abeeyatula obutukuvu, obwetoowaze bwe bwandibadde akabonero akasooka ak'obutuukirivu bwabwe. Emirundi mingi kigambibwa nti si bwe kiri. Ensonga emu teyandibadde nti mu kuyigiriza n'ekyokulabirako eby'Ekkanisa, obwetoowaze tebwabangako na kifo kya bukulu bwa waggulu ekibugwanira? Era nti kino, nate, kiva ku kunyooma amazima gano nti newankubadde ekibi bwe kiri eky'amaanyi ng'ensonga ey'okutuleetera obwetoowaze, waliwo endala ey'obuyinza obusingako obugazi n'amaanyi, eyo efuula bamalayika, eyo eyafuula Yesu, eyo efuula abatukuvu abasingira ddala mu ggulu, okuba abetoowaze bwe batyo.

Akabonero akasooka era akasinga obukulu ak'enkolagana y'ekitonde, era n'ekyama ky'omukisa gwakyo, bwe bwetoowaze n'obutabaako kyonna obuleka Katonda nga wa ddembe okuba byonna. Nkakasa nti waliwo Abakristaayo bangi abanaatula nti bye baayitamu byafaanana nnyo ng'ebyange mu kino, nti twali tumaze ebbanga ddene nga tumanyi Mukama naye nga tetutegeeredde nti obuteefu n'obwetoowaze bw'omutima bwe bulina okuba akabonero akaawula omuyigirizwa nga bwe kaali eri Omuyigiriza. Ate era, nti obwetoowaze buno si kintu kinajja kyokka, wabula kiteekwa okufuulibwa ekigendererwa eky'okwegomba okw'enjawulo, n'okusaba, n'okukkiriza, n'okukola.

Bwe tunaayiga ekigambo, tujja kulaba ebiragiro ebyawukana ennyo era ebyaddibwamu emirundi mingi Yesu bye yawa abayigirizwa be ku nsonga eno, n'engeri gye baalwiramu okumutegeera. Ka tukkirize, ku ntandikwa yennyini ey'okufumiitiriza kwaffe, nti tewali kintu kya butonde eri omuntu, tewali kirimba era ekyekwese amaaso gaffe, tewali kizibu era kya kabi nga amalala.

Ka twetegeere nti tewali kirala okuggyako obumalirivu n'obugumiikiriza, nga tulindirira Katonda ne Kristo, bijja kutuzuulira engeri gye tubulwako ekisa eky'obwetoowaze, n'engeri gye tutasobola okufuna kye tunoonya.

Ka twekenneenye empisa za Kristo okutuusa emyoyo gyaffe lwe ginajjula okwagala n'okwewuunya obwetoowaze bwe. Era ka tukkirize nti, bwe tunaamenyebwa olw'okutegeera amalala gaffe, n'obutasobola kwaffe okugagoba, Yesu Kristo yennyini ajja kuyingira n'atuwa ekisa kino nakyo, nga kitundu ky'obulamu bwe obw'ekitalo obuli mu ffe.

EKIGAMBO A Bino byonna biraga mu nsi ey'emirembe n'emirembe nti amalala gasobola okuwaayira wansi bamalayika abasingira ddala waggulu ne bafuuka baddayimoni, ate obwetoowaze ne busitula omubiri n'omusaayi ebyagwa ne bituusa ku ntebe ez'obwakabaka eza bamalayika. Bw'atyo, guno gwe muggo omukulu ogwa Katonda okutonda ekitonde ekiggya okuva mu bwakabaka bwa bamalayika obwagwa. Olw'ekigendererwa kino, kiyimiridde mu mbeera yaakyo ey'olutalo wakati w'omuliro n'amalala ga bamalayika abaagwa, n'obwetoowaze bw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, ekkondeere ery'oluvannyuma liryoke livuge amazima amakulu okuyita mu buziba obw'emirembe n'emirembe, nti obubi tebuyinza kuba na ntandikwa okuggyako mu malala, so tebuyinza kukoma okuggyako mu bwetoowaze.

Amazima ge gano: amalala gateekwa okufa mu ggwe, oba nga tewali kya ggulu kiyinza kubeera mulamu mu ggwe. Wansi w'ebbendera ery'amazima, weewaayo eri omwoyo omuteefu era omwetoowaze ogwa Yesu Omutukuvu. Obwetoowaze buteekwa okusiga ensigo, oba nga tewayinza kubaawo kukungula mu ggulu. Totunuulira malala ng'empisa embi yokka, so totunuulira bwetoowaze ng'obutuukirivu obulungi bwokka: kubanga bumu kwe kufa, n'obulala bwe bulamu; bumu bwonna gwe muliro gw'amagombe, n'obulala bwonna gwe ggulu. Nga bw'olina amalala munda yo, bw'otyo bw'olina bamalayika abaagwa nga balamu mu ggwe; ne nga bw'olina obwetoowaze obw'amazima, bw'otyo bw'olina Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda munda yo.

Singa oyinza okulaba buli kusesa kwa malala kye kukola eri emmeeme yo, wandyegayiridde buli kintu ky'osisinkana okukusikamu omusota, newankubadde n'okufiirwa omukono oba eriiso. Singa oyinza okulaba amaanyi amawoomerevu, ag'obwakatonda, agakyusa, agali mu bwetoowaze, engeri gye gagobamu obutwa obw'obuzaale bwo, ne gakolera Omwoyo gwa Katonda ekifo okubeera mulamu mu ggwe, wandisinze okwagala okuba entebe y'ebigere ey'ensi yonna okusinga okubulwako ekigero kyabwo ekisinga obutono." --Spirit of Prayer, Pt.II, p.73, Edition of Moreton, Canterbury, 1893.

Olw'ekigendererwa kino, kiyimiridde mu mbeera yaakyo ey'olutalo wakati w'omuliro n'amalala ga bamalayika abaagwa, n'obwetoowaze bw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, ekkondeere ery'oluvannyuma liryoke livuge amazima amakulu okuyita mu buziba obw'emirembe n'emirembe, nti obubi tebuyinza kuba na ntandikwa okuggyako mu malala, so tebuyinza kukoma okuggyako mu bwetoowaze. Amazima ge gano: amalala gateekwa okufa mu ggwe, oba nga tewali kya ggulu kiyinza kubeera mulamu mu ggwe. Wansi w'ebbendera ery'amazima, weewaayo eri omwoyo omuteefu era omwetoowaze ogwa Yesu Omutukuvu. Obwetoowaze buteekwa okusiga ensigo, oba nga tewayinza kubaawo kukungula mu ggulu. Totunuulira malala ng'empisa embi yokka, so totunuulira bwetoowaze ng'obutuukirivu obulungi bwokka: kubanga bumu kwe kufa, n'obulala bwe bulamu; bumu bwonna gwe muliro gw'amagombe, n'obulala bwonna gwe ggulu. Nga bw'olina amalala munda yo, bw'otyo bw'olina bamalayika abaagwa nga balamu mu ggwe; ne nga bw'olina obwetoowaze obw'amazima, bw'otyo bw'olina Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda munda yo. Singa oyinza okulaba buli kusesa kwa malala kye kukola eri emmeeme yo, wandyegayiridde buli kintu ky'osisinkana okukusikamu omusota, newankubadde n'okufiirwa omukono oba eriiso. Singa oyinza okulaba amaanyi amawoomerevu, ag'obwakatonda, agakyusa, agali mu bwetoowaze, engeri gye gagobamu obutwa obw'obuzaale bwo, ne gakolera Omwoyo gwa Katonda ekifo okubeera mulamu mu ggwe, wandisinze okwagala okuba entebe y'ebigere ey'ensi yonna okusinga okubulwako ekigero kyabwo ekisinga obutono." --Spirit of Prayer, Pt.II, p.73, Edition of Moreton, Canterbury, 1893.

fields.title: Ekyama ky'Okununulibwa
fields.body_html:
Mube n'omwoyo guno mu mmwe, ogwo ogwali mu Kristo Yesu, atali bwe yali mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, teyalowooza kwenkanankana ne Katonda kuba kintu kya kunyagira, naye ne yeefiira, ng'atwala ekifaananyi eky'omuddu, ng'azaalibwa mu kifaananyi ky'abantu. Era bwe yalabika mu kifaananyi ky'omuntu, ne yeetoowaza, ng'agonda okutuusa ku kufa, weewaawo okufa okw'omusaalaba. Katonda kyeyava amugulumiza ennyo n'amuwa erinnya erisinga amannya gonna, Abafiripi 2:5-9.

Tewali muti guyinza kukula okuggyako ku mulandira ogwaguzaala. Mu bulamu bwagwo bwonna, guyinza okuba omulamu mu bulamu obwabadde mu nsigo eyaguwa okubaawo bwokka. Okutegeera obulungi amazima gano nga tugageza ku Adamu ow'olubereberye ne Adamu ow'okubiri kituyamba okutegeera obwetaavu n'engeri y'okununulibwa okuli mu Yesu. Omusota ogw'edda bwe gwayogera ebigambo byagwo eby'okukema mu kutu kwa Kaawa — ogwo eyagobebwa mu ggulu olw'amalala ge, era omuzimu gwe gwonna nga malala — ebigambo ebyo byalina obutwa bwennyini obw'omu magombe.

Bwe yawuliriza n'awaayo okwegomba kwe n'okusiima kwe eri essuubi ery'okuba nga Katonda, ng'amanyi obulungi n'obubi, obutwa bwayingira mu mwoyo gwe, mu musaayi gwe, ne mu bulamu bwe, ne buzikiriza emirembe gyonna obwetoowaze obw'omukisa n'okwesigama ku Katonda okwandituleeteredde essanyu ery'olubeerera. Olw'ekyo, obulamu bwe n'obulamu bw'ekika ekyava mu ye ne bwonooneka okutuuka ku mulandira gwabwo gwennyini olw'amalala ga Setaani yennyini, ekibi ekisingira ddala okwesittaza mu bibi byonna ne mu bikolimo byonna.

Obunaku bwonna ensi kw'ebadde etegekebwa, entalo zaayo zonna n'okuyiwa omusaayi mu mawanga, obwerowoozi bwayo obw'okwefaako n'okubonaabona, okwegomba kwayo n'obuggya, emitima egyamenyeka n'obulamu obukaawereddwa, awamu n'obunaku bwayo obwa buli lunaku, byonna bisibuka mu ekyo amalala gano agakolimirwa, ag'omu magombe, oba agaffe ffe oba ag'abalala, bye gatuleetedde. Malala ge gafuula okununulibwa okwetaagisa. Malala gaffe ge twetaaga okununulibwako. Okutegeera kwaffe obwetaavu bw'okununulibwa kunaasinziira nnyo ku kumanya kwaffe engeri embi ey'amaanyi agayingidde mu bulamu bwaffe. Amaanyi Setaani ge yaggya mu magombe n'agasuula mu bulamu bw'omuntu gakola buli lunaku, buli ssaawa, n'amaanyi amangi mu nsi yonna. Abantu babonyaabonyezebwa gago, gabatiisa, babagalwanyisa, era babagadduka, naye tebamanyi lwe gajja, wadde ekiseera we gafunira obufuzi bwago obw'entiisa.

Si kya kwewuunya nti tebamanyi gaŋŋwanyisibwa wa oba gatyo. Amalala galina omulandira n'amaanyi gaago mu maanyi ag'omwoyo ag'entiisa, ebweru waffe era ne munda yaffe; nga bwe kyetaagisa nti tugaatula era tugaawulize ng'agaffe ffe, era kyetaagisa okugamanya mu nsibuko yaago eya Setaani. Kino bwe kituleeta mu kuggwaamu essuubi lyonna okugawangula oba okugagoba, kijja kutwanguyiriza okutuuka ku maanyi ago agasukka obuntu, mu go gokka mwe muli okununulibwa kwaffe — okununula okwa Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda. Okulwana okutaliiko ssuubi eri emirimu gy'obwomu n'amalala munda yaffe kuyinza okweyongera obutaba na ssuubi bwe tulowooza ku maanyi g'ekizikiza agali emabega w'ebyo byonna; okuggwaamu essuubi okutuukiridde kunaatusaanyiza obulungi okutegeera n'okukkiriza amaanyi n'obulamu ebiri ebweru waffe naffe, weewaawo obwetoowaze obw'omu ggulu nga bwaleetebwa wansi era ne busembezebwa Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda, okugoba Setaani n'amalala ge.

Tewali muti guyinza kukula okuggyako ku mulandira ogwaguzaala. Nga bwe twetaaga okutunuulira Adamu ow'olubereberye n'okugwa kwe okumanya amaanyi g'ekibi ekiri munda yaffe, bwe tutyo twetaaga okumanya obulungi Adamu ow'okubiri n'amaanyi ge ag'okutuwa munda yaffe obulamu obw'obwetoowaze obulamu ddala era obunywevu era obufuga nga bwe gwabadde omulimu gw'amalala. Obulamu bwaffe tubuggya mu Kristo era mu ye, mu butuufu, weewaawo mu butuufu okusinga bwe tubuggya mu Adamu era mu ye. Tusaanidde okutambula nga twesimbye emirandira mu ye, nga tunywerera ku Mutwe ogwo omubiri gwonna gwe gukuliramu okukula okuva eri Katonda.

Obulamu bwa Katonda, obwayingira mu buntu mu kufuuka omuntu, gwe mulandira gwe tusaanidde okuyimirirako n'okukulira; ge maanyi go gamu ag'ekitalo agaakolera eyo, era okuva eyo okutuuka ku kuzuukira, agakola munda yaffe buli lunaku. Ekyetaago kyaffe kimu: okwekenneenya, okumanya, n'okwesiga obulamu obwabikkulwa mu Kristo ng'obulamu obukaakati obwaffe, era obulindirira okukkiriza kwaffe bunyweze n'okufuga obuntu bwaffe bwonna.

Mu ndaba eno, kya mugaso ogutategeerekeka nti tusaanidde okuba n'ebirowoozo ebituufu ku ekyo Kristo ky'ali, ku ekyo ekimufuula Kristo mu butuufu, na ddala ku ekyo ekiyinza okubalibwa ng'ekiraga engeri ye entongole, omulandira n'ensa ey'engeri ye yonna nga Omununuzi waffe. Tewali kuddamu okulala wabula kumu: bwe bwetoowaze bwe. Kuki okufuuka omuntu okujjako obwetoowaze bwe obw'omu ggulu, okwefiira kwe n'okufuuka omuntu? Kiki obulamu bwe ku nsi okujjako bwetoowaze; okutwala kwe ekifaananyi eky'omuddu? Era kiki okutangirira kwe okujjako bwetoowaze? “Ne yeetoowaza ng'agonda” (Abafiripi 2:8). Era kiki okulinnya kwe mu ggulu n'ekitiibwa kye, okujjako obwetoowaze obwagulumizibwa ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka ne butikkirwa ekitiibwa? “Katonda kyeyava amugulumiza ennyo” (Abafiripi 2:9). Mu ggulu, gye yali ne Kitaawe, mu kuzaalibwa kwe, mu bulamu bwe, mu kufa kwe, mu kutuula kwe ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka, byonna tewali kirala wabula obwetoowaze.

Kristo bwe bwetoowaze bwa Katonda obwafuuka omubiri mu buntu, Okwagala okw'olubeerera nga kwetoowaza, nga kwambala ekyambalo eky'obuwombeefu n'obukkakkamu okutuwangula, okutuweereza, n'okutulokola. Nga okwagala kwa Katonda n'okwetoowaza kwe bwe kimufuula omugabi, omubeezi, n'omuddu wa bonna, bw'atyo Yesu, olw'obwetaavu, ye yali Obwetoowaze obwafuuka omuntu. Bw'atyo, akyali wakati mu ntebe ey'obwakabaka, Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda omuwombeefu era omwetoowaze. Kino bwe kiba omulandira gw'omuti, engeri yaagwo eteekwa okulabika mu buli ttabi, olukoola, n'ekibala.

Obwetoowaze bwe buba ekisooka, ekisa ekitwalira awamu byonna eby'obulamu bwa Yesu, obwetoowaze bwe buba ekyama ky'okutangirira kwe, kale obulamu obw'obwomwoyo bwaffe obulungi n'amaanyi gaabwo binaasinziira ddala ku ffe okuteeka ekisa kino nakyo mu maaso, n'okufuula obwetoowaze ekintu ekikulu kye tumusiima, ekintu ekikulu kye tumusaba, ekintu ekimu kye twenyisa okuwaayo ebirala byonna. Si kya kwewuunya nti obulamu bw'Ekikristaayo emirundi mingi bunafu era tebubala bibala ng'omulandira gwennyini ogw'obulamu bwa Kristo tegufiibwako, tegumanyiddwa? Si kya kwewuunya nti essanyu ery'obulokozi liwuliddwa katono nnyo ng'ekyo Kristo kye yazuula era kye yaleeta kinoonyezebwa katono nnyo? Okutuusa obwetoowaze obunaawummulira mu nkomerero n'okufa kw'obwomu, obuwaayo ekitiibwa kyonna eky'abantu nga Yesu bwe yakola okunoonya ekitiibwa ekiva eri Katonda yekka, obwefuula era bwe bwebala nga tewali kintu, Katonda alyoke abeere byonna, Mukama yekka alyoke agulumizibwe — okutuusa obwetoowaze ng'obwo bwe tunoonya mu Kristo okusinga essanyu lyaffe erikulu, era bwe twaniriza ku muwendo gwonna, waliwo essuubi ttono nnyo ery'eddiini erinaawangula ensi.

Sisobola kwegayirira musomi wange n'obunyiikivu bungi bwe kityo, singa obulabufu bwe tebunnaba kussibwa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo ku bbula ery'obwetoowaze eriri munda ye oba ekimwetoolodde, okuwummulako n'okwebuuza obanga alaba bingi eby'omwoyo gw'Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda omuwombeefu era omwetoowaze mu abo abayitibwa erinnya lye.

Ka alowooze engeri obutaba na kwagala kwonna, obutassaayo mwoyo kwonna eri ebyetaago, enneewulira, n'obunafu bw'abalala, okusala emisango okukalabalaba n'okwanguyiriza n'ebigambo byonna, ebitera okuwolerezebwa nga bigambibwa nti kwa lwatu era kwa mazima.

Enneeyoleka zonna ez'obusungu, obukalubo, n'obunyiivu, enneewulira zonna ez'obukaayu n'okwawukana, byonna birina omulandira gwabyo mu malala agabulijjo geenoonya gokka. Amaaso ge ganaazibulwa okulaba engeri amalala amaddugavu, aga Setaani, bwe gaseeba nga geeyingiza wonna awo, n'okukuŋŋaana kw'abatukuvu nga tekulekeddwa. Ka atandike okwebuuza kye kyandivuddemu singa, mu ye yennyini n'ekimwetoolodde, eri banne abatukuvu n'ensi, abakkiriza baaluŋŋamizibwanga ddala olubeerera obwetoowaze bwa Yesu. Ka ayogere obanga okukaaba kw'omutima gwaffe gwonna, emisana n'ekiro, tekusaanidde kuba nti, Ayi, obwetoowaze bwa Yesu bubeere mu nze ne mu bonna abanneetoolodde!

Ka atereeze omutima gwe mu bwesimbu ku bbula lye ery'obwetoowaze obwabikkulwa mu kifaananyi ky'obulamu bwa Kristo, ne mu ngeri yonna ey'okununulibwa kwe, era anaatandika okuwulira ng'atannamanya ddala Kristo n'obulokozi bwe kye biri. Ggwe omukkiriza! Yiga obwetoowaze bwa Yesu. Kino kye kyama, omulandira ogukwekeddwa ogw'okununulibwa kwo. Bugwemu nnyo buli lunaku.

Kkiriza n'omutima gwo gwonna nti Kristo ono, Katonda gw'akuwadde, nga bwe bwetoowaze bwe obw'obwakatonda bwakukolera omulimu, bw'atyo ajja okuyingira okubeera n'okukola munda yo naawe, n'akufuula ekyo Kitaawe ky'ayagala okuba.

EKIGAMBO B Twetaaga okumanya ebintu bibiri: Ekimu kiri nti obulokozi bwaffe bwonna businziira mu kulokolebwa okuva mu ffe ffennyini, oba ekyo kye tuli olw'obuzaaliranwa, n'ekirala kiri nti mu ngeri y'ebintu byonna, tewali kintu kiyinza kubeera bulokozi buno oba mulokozi gye tuli okuggyako obwetoowaze bwa Katonda obw'engeri eyo obusukka byonna ebiyinza okwogerwa.

N'olwekyo, etteeka ery'olubereberye eritakyuka ery'Omulokozi eri omuntu eyagwa. Omuntu bw'ateeyefiiriza, tayinza kuba muyigirizwa Wange (Matayo 16:24). Obwomu bwe bubi bwonna obw'obuntu obwagwa, so ng'okwefiiriza kwe busobozi bwaffe okulokolebwa. Obwetoowaze gwe mulokozi waffe, so ng'obwomu gwe mulandira, amatabi, n'omuti gw'obubi bwonna obw'embeera yaffe eyagwa. Ebibi byonna eby'bamalayika abaagwa n'abantu bizaalibwa mu malala ag'obwomu. Ku luuyi olulala, empisa zonna ennungi ez'obulamu obw'omu ggulu ze mpisa ez'obwetoowaze.

Bwetoowaze bwokka bwe bukola olukonko olutasomokeka wakati w'eggulu n'amagombe.

Kale kiki, oba kiki ekiri mu kulwana okunene olw'obulamu obutaggwaawo? Byonna biri mu kuwakana wakati w'amalala n'obwetoowaze. Amalala n'obwetoowaze ge maanyi abiri agafuga, obwakabaka bubiri obulwanira okufuna omuntu emirembe gyonna. Tewabangawo, so tewaliba, wabula obwetoowaze bumu, era obwo bwe bwetoowaze bwa Kristo. Amalala n'obwomu bye byonna bya muntu, okutuusa omuntu lw'aba na byonna okuva eri Kristo. N'olwekyo alwana olutalo olulungi oyo yekka gwe okulwana kwe kuli nti obuzaaliranwa obwesinza gwennyini bw'alina okuva eri Adamu buleetebwe mu kufa olw'obwetoowaze obusukka obuntu obwa Kristo obuleetebwa mu bulamu munda ye.

Nga okwagala kwa Katonda n'okwetoowaza kwe bwe kimufuula omugabi, omubeezi, n'omuddu wa bonna, bw'atyo Yesu, olw'obwetaavu, ye yali Obwetoowaze obwafuuka omuntu. Bw'atyo, akyali wakati mu ntebe ey'obwakabaka, Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda omuwombeefu era omwetoowaze. Kino bwe kiba omulandira gw'omuti, engeri yaagwo eteekwa okulabika mu buli ttabi, olukoola, n'ekibala. Obwetoowaze bwe buba ekisooka, ekisa ekitwalira awamu byonna eby'obulamu bwa Yesu, obwetoowaze bwe buba ekyama ky'okutangirira kwe, kale obulamu obw'obwomwoyo bwaffe obulungi n'amaanyi gaabwo binaasinziira ddala ku ffe okuteeka ekisa kino nakyo mu maaso, n'okufuula obwetoowaze ekintu ekikulu kye tumusiima, ekintu ekikulu kye tumusaba, ekintu ekimu kye twenyisa okuwaayo ebirala byonna. Si kya kwewuunya nti obulamu bw'Ekikristaayo emirundi mingi bunafu era tebubala bibala ng'omulandira gwennyini ogw'obulamu bwa Kristo tegufiibwako, tegumanyiddwa? Si kya kwewuunya nti essanyu ery'obulokozi liwuliddwa katono nnyo ng'ekyo Kristo kye yazuula era kye yaleeta kinoonyezebwa katono nnyo? Okutuusa obwetoowaze obunaawummulira mu nkomerero n'okufa kw'obwomu, obuwaayo ekitiibwa kyonna eky'abantu nga Yesu bwe yakola okunoonya ekitiibwa ekiva eri Katonda yekka, obwefuula era bwe bwebala nga tewali kintu, Katonda alyoke abeere byonna, Mukama yekka alyoke agulumizibwe — okutuusa obwetoowaze ng'obwo bwe tunoonya mu Kristo okusinga essanyu lyaffe erikulu, era bwe twaniriza ku muwendo gwonna, waliwo essuubi ttono nnyo ery'eddiini erinaawangula ensi. Sisobola kwegayirira musomi wange n'obunyiikivu bungi bwe kityo, singa obulabufu bwe tebunnaba kussibwa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo ku bbula ery'obwetoowaze eriri munda ye oba ekimwetoolodde, okuwummulako n'okwebuuza obanga alaba bingi eby'omwoyo gw'Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda omuwombeefu era omwetoowaze mu abo abayitibwa erinnya lye. Ka alowooze engeri obutaba na kwagala kwonna, obutassaayo mwoyo kwonna eri ebyetaago, enneewulira, n'obunafu bw'abalala, okusala emisango okukalabalaba n'okwanguyiriza n'ebigambo byonna, ebitera okuwolerezebwa nga bigambibwa nti kwa lwatu era kwa mazima. Enneeyoleka zonna ez'obusungu, obukalubo, n'obunyiivu, enneewulira zonna ez'obukaayu n'okwawukana, byonna birina omulandira gwabyo mu malala agabulijjo geenoonya gokka. Amaaso ge ganaazibulwa okulaba engeri amalala amaddugavu, aga Setaani, bwe gaseeba nga geeyingiza wonna awo, n'okukuŋŋaana kw'abatukuvu nga tekulekeddwa. Ka atandike okwebuuza kye kyandivuddemu singa, mu ye yennyini n'ekimwetoolodde, eri banne abatukuvu n'ensi, abakkiriza baaluŋŋamizibwanga ddala olubeerera obwetoowaze bwa Yesu. Ka ayogere obanga okukaaba kw'omutima gwaffe gwonna, emisana n'ekiro, tekusaanidde kuba nti, Ayi, obwetoowaze bwa Yesu bubeere mu nze ne mu bonna abanneetoolodde! Ka atereeze omutima gwe mu bwesimbu ku bbula lye ery'obwetoowaze obwabikkulwa mu kifaananyi ky'obulamu bwa Kristo, ne mu ngeri yonna ey'okununulibwa kwe, era anaatandika okuwulira ng'atannamanya ddala Kristo n'obulokozi bwe kye biri. Ggwe omukkiriza! Yiga obwetoowaze bwa Yesu. Kino kye kyama, omulandira ogukwekeddwa ogw'okununulibwa kwo. Bugwemu nnyo buli lunaku. Kkiriza n'omutima gwo gwonna nti Kristo ono, Katonda gw'akuwadde, nga bwe bwetoowaze bwe obw'obwakatonda bwakukolera omulimu, bw'atyo ajja okuyingira okubeera n'okukola munda yo naawe, n'akufuula ekyo Kitaawe ky'ayagala okuba. EKIGAMBO B Twetaaga okumanya ebintu bibiri: Ekimu kiri nti obulokozi bwaffe bwonna businziira mu kulokolebwa okuva mu ffe ffennyini, oba ekyo kye tuli olw'obuzaaliranwa, n'ekirala kiri nti mu ngeri y'ebintu byonna, tewali kintu kiyinza kubeera bulokozi buno oba mulokozi gye tuli okuggyako obwetoowaze bwa Katonda obw'engeri eyo obusukka byonna ebiyinza okwogerwa. N'olwekyo, etteeka ery'olubereberye eritakyuka ery'Omulokozi eri omuntu eyagwa. Omuntu bw'ateeyefiiriza, tayinza kuba muyigirizwa Wange (Matayo 16:24). Obwomu bwe bubi bwonna obw'obuntu obwagwa, so ng'okwefiiriza kwe busobozi bwaffe okulokolebwa. Obwetoowaze gwe mulokozi waffe, so ng'obwomu gwe mulandira, amatabi, n'omuti gw'obubi bwonna obw'embeera yaffe eyagwa. Ebibi byonna eby'bamalayika abaagwa n'abantu bizaalibwa mu malala ag'obwomu. Ku luuyi olulala, empisa zonna ennungi ez'obulamu obw'omu ggulu ze mpisa ez'obwetoowaze. Bwetoowaze bwokka bwe bukola olukonko olutasomokeka wakati w'eggulu n'amagombe. Kale kiki, oba kiki ekiri mu kulwana okunene olw'obulamu obutaggwaawo? Byonna biri mu kuwakana wakati w'amalala n'obwetoowaze. Amalala n'obwetoowaze ge maanyi abiri agafuga, obwakabaka bubiri obulwanira okufuna omuntu emirembe gyonna. Tewabangawo, so tewaliba, wabula obwetoowaze bumu, era obwo bwe bwetoowaze bwa Kristo. Amalala n'obwomu bye byonna bya muntu, okutuusa omuntu lw'aba na byonna okuva eri Kristo. N'olwekyo alwana olutalo olulungi oyo yekka gwe okulwana kwe kuli nti obuzaaliranwa obwesinza gwennyini bw'alina okuva eri Adamu buleetebwe mu kufa olw'obwetoowaze obusukka obuntu obwa Kristo obuleetebwa mu bulamu munda ye.

fields.title: Obwetoowaze mu Bulamu bwa Yesu
fields.body_html:
"Naye nze ndi mu mmwe ng'oyo aweereza." Lukka 22:27.

Mu Njiri ya Yokaana, obulamu obw'omunda obwa Mukama waffe bubikkuliddwa gye tuli. Yesu ayogera emirundi mingi ku nkolagana ye ne Kitaawe, ku nsonga ezimuluŋŋamya, ne ku kutegeera kwe amaanyi n'omwoyo mw'akolera. Wadde ekigambo "okwetoowaza" nga tekirimu, tewali wonna mu Byawandiikibwa gye tunaalaba bulungi obwetoowaze bwe mwe bwali. Twamala okwogera nti ekisa kino mu mazima si kirala wabula okukkiriza okwangu okw'ekitonde okuleka Katonda okuba byonna, olw'ekyo ne kyewaayo eri okukola kwe kwokka.

Mu Yesu, tujja kulaba engeri, ng'Omwana wa Katonda mu ggulu, era ng'omuntu ku nsi, gye yatwala ekifo eky'okwewolako okutuukiridde, n'awa Katonda ekitiibwa n'ettendo eryamugwanira. Era ekyo kye yayigiriza emirundi mingi kyatuukirira mu ye yennyini: "buli eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa."

(Matayo 23:12). Nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti, "Katonda kyeyava amugulumiza ennyo" (Abafiripi 2:9).

Wuliriza ebigambo Mukama waffe by'ayogera ku nkolagana ye ne Kitaawe, n'engeri gy'akozesaamu obutakoowa ebigambo "si," ne "tewali," nga yeeyogerako. "Si nze," Pawulo mw'ayolesa enkolagana ye ne Kristo, gwe mwoyo gwennyini ogw'ekyo Kristo ky'ayogera ku nkolagana ye ne Kitaawe.

"Omwana tayinza kukola kintu ku bubwe" (Yokaana 5:19).

"Siyinza kukola kintu ku bwange. Nga bwe mpulira, bwe nsala omusango, era omusango gwange gwa nsonga, kubanga sinoonya kwagala kwange."

(Yokaana 5:30).

"Ekitiibwa sikiggya mu bantu" (Yokaana 5:41).

"Nava mu ggulu, si kukola kye njagala nze" (Yokaana 6:38).

"Okuyigiriza kwange si kwange" (Yokaana 7:16) "Sajja ku bwange" (Yokaana 7:28) "Siyinza kukola kintu ku bwange" (Yokaana 8:28) "Sajja ku bwange, wabula ye yantuma" (Yokaana 8:42).

"Sinoonya kitiibwa kyange" (Yokaana 8:50) "Ebigambo bye mbagamba sibyogera ku buyinza bwange" (Yokaana 14:10).

"Ekigambo kye muwulira si kyange" (Yokaana 14:24).

Ebigambo bino bitubikkulira emirandira egisingayo obuwanvu egy'obulamu n'omulimu gwa Kristo. Bitubuulira engeri Katonda Ayinzabyonna gye yasobozesa okukola omulimu gwe ogw'amaanyi ogw'okununula ng'ayita mu ye. Biraga Kristo kye yatwala ng'embeera y'omutima eyamugwanira ng'Omwana wa Kitaawe. Bituyigiriza obutonde n'obulamu obw'enkizo obw'okununula okwo Kristo kwe yatuukiriza era kw'atuwa kaakano. Kye kino: Yali tewali, Katonda alyoke abe byonna. Yeewaayo yekka n'okwagala kwe n'amaanyi ge byonna eri Kitaawe alyoke akole mu ye. Ku maanyi ge, ku kwagala kwe, ne ku kitiibwa kye, ku butume bwe bwonna awamu n'emirimu gye gyonna n'okuyigiriza kwe, ku bino byonna yagamba nti, Si nze; siri kintu; Neewaddeyo eri Kitaawe akole; siri kintu, Kitaawe ye byonna.

Obulamu buno obw'okwefiiriza okutuukiridde, obw'okuwulira n'okwesigama ku kwagala kwa Kitaawe, Kristo yabusanga nga bwa mirembe na ssanyu ebituukiridde. Teyafiirwa kintu olw'okuwaayo byonna eri Katonda. Katonda yassaamu ekitiibwa obwesige bwe, n'amukolera byonna, oluvannyuma n'amugulumiza ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo mu kitiibwa (Ebikolwa 5:31).

Era olw'okuba nga Kristo bw'atyo yeetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda, era nga Katonda yali mu maaso ge bulijjo, yasobola okwetoowaza ne mu maaso g'abantu, era n'okuba Omuweereza wa bonna. Obwetoowaze bwe bwali bwokka kwe kwewaayo yeewaddeyo eri Katonda, okumuleka akole mu ye ky'ayagala, ka babeere abantu abaali okumwetoolodde bye bandimwogeddeeko oba bye bandimukoze.

Mu mbeera eno ey'omutima, mu mwoyo guno n'endowooza eno, mwe okununula kwa Kristo mwe kulina amaanyi n'obuyinza bwakwo. Kya kutuleeta mu ndowooza eno kye tufuulibwa abagabana mu Kristo. Kuno kwe kweggaana ddala Omulokozi waffe kw'atuyita, okukkiriza nti omuntu talina kirungi mu ye, wabula ng'ekibya ekyereere Katonda ky'ateekwa okujjuza, era nti okwewaanako okuba oba okukola kintu kyonna tekusaana kukkirizibwa n'akaseera n'akamu. Mu kino, okusinga era okukulembera buli kimu, mwe okufaanana Yesu mwe kuli, okuba n'okukola ekitali kintu ku bwaffe, Katonda alyoke abe byonna. Wano we tulina omulandira n'obutonde bw'obwetoowaze obwa nnamaddala. Olw'okuba nga kino tekitegeerekeka wadde okunoonyezebwa, obwetoowaze bwaffe kyebuva buba obw'okungulu era obunafu.

Tuteekwa okuyiga eri Yesu, engeri gy'ali omuwombeefu era eyeetoowaza mu mutima. Atuyigiriza nti obwetoowaze obwa nnamaddala buva era bufuna amaanyi gaabwo mu kumanya nti Katonda ye akola byonna mu byonna, nti ekifo kyaffe kwe kumuwuliramu mu kwewaayo n'okwesigama okutuukiridde, mu kukkiriza okujjuvu okuba n'okukola ekitali kintu ku bwaffe. Buno bwe bulamu Kristo bwe yajja okubikkula n'okugaba, obulamu eri Katonda obwajja ng'obuyita mu kufiira ekibi n'omuntu. Bwe tuwulira nti obulamu buno buli waggulu nnyo era bukira amaanyi gaffe, kale tuteekwa okububunoonyeza mu ye. Kristo abeera mu ffe y'anaatubeeramu obulamu buno, obw'obuwombeefu n'obwetoowaze.

Bwe twagala kino ennyo, ka tube, mu kaseera kano, okusinga byonna, tunoonye ekyama ekitukuvu eky'okumanya obutonde bwa Katonda, nga buli kaseera akola byonna mu byonna. Ekyama, obutonde bwonna, buli kitonde, era okusinga byonna, buli mwana wa Katonda, kye kiteekwa okuwa obujulizi, nti si kirala wabula ekibya, oluguudo, Katonda omulamu mw'ayinza okwolesa obugagga bw'amagezi ge, amaanyi ge, n'obulungi bwe. Omulandira gwa buli mpisa nnungi n'ekisa, ogwa buli kukkiriza n'okusinza okukkirizibwa, kwe kumanya nti tetulina kintu okuggyako kye tuweebwa, ne twetoowaza ennyo nnyini okulindirira Katonda akituwe.

Kyali olw'okuba nga obwetoowaze buno tebwali bwewuunyo bwa kiseera buseera bwokka, obwazuukusibwa ne bukozesebwa ng'alowooza ku Katonda, wabula omwoyo gwennyini ogw'obulamu bwe bwonna, Yesu kyeyava aba omwetoowaze mu nkolagana ye n'abantu nga bw'ali ne Katonda. Yeewulira ng'Omuweereza wa Katonda olw'abantu Katonda be yatonda era be yayagala. Ng'ekivaamu eky'obutonde, yeetwala ng'Omuweereza w'abantu Katonda alyoke akole omulimu gwe ogw'okwagala ng'ayita mu ye. Teyalowooza n'akaseera n'akamu ku kunoonya kitiibwa kye, oba okwolesa amaanyi ge okwennyweza. Omwoyo gwe gwonna gwali gwa bulamu obwaweebwayo eri Katonda akolere mu bwo.

Abakristaayo bwe balitandika okusoma obwetoowaze bwa Yesu ng'ensibuko yennyini ey'okununula kwe, ng'omukisa gwennyini ogw'obulamu obw'Omwana wa Katonda, ng'enkolagana yokka eya nnamaddala ne Kitaawe, era bwe kityo ng'ekyo Yesu ky'ateekwa okutuwa bwe tuba n'okugabana naye. Olwo obwetaavu obw'entiisa obw'obwetoowaze obw'amazima, obw'omu ggulu, obweyoleka, bulifuuka omugugu n'ennaku, n'eddiini yaffe eya bulijjo eriteekebwa ku bbali okufuna kino, akabonero akasooka era akasinga aka Kristo mu ffe.

Owooluganda, oyambadde obwetoowaze? Buuza ku bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku. Buuza Yesu. Buuza mikwano gyo.

Buuza ensi. Era tandika okutendereza Katonda kubanga akubikkulidde mu Yesu obwetoowaze obw'omu ggulu bw'otannamanya bulungi, era obw'omukisa gw'omu ggulu gw'oyinza obutannakomba nga guyita mu bwo ne gujja mu ggwe.

Yeewulira ng'Omuweereza wa Katonda olw'abantu Katonda be yatonda era be yayagala. Ng'ekivaamu eky'obutonde, yeetwala ng'Omuweereza w'abantu Katonda alyoke akole omulimu gwe ogw'okwagala ng'ayita mu ye. Teyalowooza n'akaseera n'akamu ku kunoonya kitiibwa kye, oba okwolesa amaanyi ge okwennyweza. Omwoyo gwe gwonna gwali gwa bulamu obwaweebwayo eri Katonda akolere mu bwo. Abakristaayo bwe balitandika okusoma obwetoowaze bwa Yesu ng'ensibuko yennyini ey'okununula kwe, ng'omukisa gwennyini ogw'obulamu obw'Omwana wa Katonda, ng'enkolagana yokka eya nnamaddala ne Kitaawe, era bwe kityo ng'ekyo Yesu ky'ateekwa okutuwa bwe tuba n'okugabana naye. Olwo obwetaavu obw'entiisa obw'obwetoowaze obw'amazima, obw'omu ggulu, obweyoleka, bulifuuka omugugu n'ennaku, n'eddiini yaffe eya bulijjo eriteekebwa ku bbali okufuna kino, akabonero akasooka era akasinga aka Kristo mu ffe. Owooluganda, oyambadde obwetoowaze? Buuza ku bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku. Buuza Yesu. Buuza mikwano gyo. Buuza ensi. fields.title: Obwetoowaze mu Kuyigiriza kwa Yesu
fields.body_html:
"Muyige gye ndi, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omwetoowaze mu mutima" Matayo 11:29. "N'ayagala okuba omukulu mu mmwe kimugwanira okuba omuddu wammwe, nga n'Omwana w'omuntu bwe yajja, si kuweerezebwa, wabula okuweereza" Matayo 20:27.

Twalaba obwetoowaze mu bulamu bwa Kristo; kale, nga bwe yatuggulirawo omutima gwe, ka tuwulirize okuyigiriza kwe. Omwo mwe tunaawulirira engeri gy'akwogerako, n'engeri gy'asuubira abantu, naddala abayigirizwa be, okuba abeetoowaze nga ye bwe yali. Ka tusome n'obwegendereza ebitundu ebyawandiikibwa, bye siyinza kukola kirala okuggyako okubijuliza, tusobole okutegeera bulungi engeri gye yakiyigirizaamu emirundi mingi era n'obunyiikivu. Kino kijja kutuyamba okutegeera Ye ky'atusaba.

Tunuulire entandikwa y'obuweereza bwe. Mu Miganyulo egyasooka Okubuulira kw'oku Lusozi, agamba nti: "Balina omukisa abaavu mu mwoyo: kubanga obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu bwabwe. Balina omukisa abawombeefu: kubanga baligabana ensi." (Matayo 5:3, 5). Ebigambo ebisookedde ddala mu kulangirira kwe obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu bibikkula omulyango omuggule, ogwo gwokka gwe tuyingiriramu.

Abaavu, abaawaayo buli kimu ku lwa Kristo, be bajjirwa obwakabaka. Omuntu ayinza okugamba nti: “Naye Abakristaayo abamu bagagga nnyo, nga balina ettaka, emmotoka, n'obusuubuzi bungi.”

Yee, ekyo kiyinza okubaawo, naddala nga bwe bali abaana b'Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo; naye bwe bakitwala nga butaliimu, bayinza mangu okukiwaayo ku lw'enjiri; abo baavu mu Mwoyo. Abawombeefu, abatanoonya kantu konna mu bo bennyini, ensi eriba yaabwe. Emikisa egy'omu ggulu n'egy'oku nsi gya beetoowaze.

Ku bulamu obw'omu ggulu n'obw'oku nsi, obwetoowaze bwe kyama ky'omukisa.

"Muyige gye ndi, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omwetoowaze mu mutima, era muliraba okuwummula kw'emmeeme zammwe." (Matayo 11:29). Yesu yeewaayo ng'Omuyigiriza. Atubuulira omwoyo bwe guli, gwe tunaasanga mu Ye ng'Omuyigiriza, era gwe tuyinza okuyiga n'okuweebwa okuva gy'ali. Obuwombeefu n'obwetoowaze kye kintu kimu ky'atuwa, era mu byo mwe tunaasanga okuwummula okutuukiridde okw'emmeeme.

Mu Ndagaano Empya, tulaba abayigirizwa nga bawakana ani anaaba omukulu mu bwakabaka, era nga bakkiriziganya okubuuza Omuyigiriza (Lukka 9:46, Matayo 18:3-5). N'ateeka omwana wakati mu bo n'agamba nti, "Buli eyeetoowaza ng'omwana ono, aligulumizibwa." "Ani asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw'omu ggulu?" Matayo 18:1. Ekibuuzo kino ddala kya makulu manene. Kiki ekinaaba enjawulo enkulu mu bwakabaka obw'omu ggulu? Eky'okuddamu, teri n'omu yandikiwadde okuggyako Yesu. Ekitiibwa ekikulu eky'omu ggulu, okulowooza okw'omu ggulu okw'amazima, ekisinga mu bisa, kwe kwetoowaza. "Buli asembeza omwana ono mu linnya lyange asembeza Nze, n'oyo asembeza Nze asembeza oyo eyantuma.

Kubanga oyo asinga obuto mu mmwe mwenna, oyo ye mukulu." Lukka 9:48.

Batabani ba Zebbedaayo baali basabye Yesu ani anaatuula ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo n'ogwa kkono, ekifo ekisinga waggulu mu bwakabaka. Yesu n'agamba nti si kya Ye kukiwa, wabula kya Kitaawe, anaakiwa abo abaakitegekerwa. Tebateekwa kukyagala wadde okukisaba. Ebirowoozo byabwe biteekwa okuba ku kikompe n'okubatizibwa okw'okutoowazibwa. N'agattako nti, "N'ayagala okuba omukulu mu mmwe kimugwanira okuba omuddu wammwe, nga n'Omwana w'omuntu bwe yajja, si kuweerezebwa, wabula okuweereza" Matayo 20:27. Obwetoowaze, nga bwe bubonero bwa Kristo ow'omu ggulu, bwe bunaaba ekipimo kimu eky'ekitiibwa mu ggulu. Asinga okwetoowaza ye asinga okuba okumpi ne Katonda.

Obukulembeze mu Kkanisa businzibwa abasinga okwetoowaza. Ng'ayogera eri ekibiina n'abayigirizwa ku Bafalisaayo n'okwagala kwabwe entebe ez'ekitiibwa, Kristo yaddamu n'agamba (Matayo 23:11), "Asinga obukulu mu mmwe anaabeera muweereza wammwe." Okwetoowaza kwe madaala gokka agatuusa ku kitiibwa mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda.

Ku mulundi omulala, mu nnyumba y'Omufalisaayo, yayogera olugero olw'omugenyi eyandiyitiddwa okwambuka waggulu (Lukka 14:1-11), n'agattako nti, "Kubanga buli eyeegulumiza aliggyibwako ekitiibwa, n'oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa." Lukka 14:11. Ekiragiro tekikyukakyuka; teri kkubo ddala. Okwetoowaza kwokka kwe kunaagulumizibwa.

Oluvannyuma lw'olugero olw'Omufalisaayo n'Omusolooza, Kristo yaddamu n'ayogera (Lukka 18:14), "Kubanga buli eyeegulumiza aliggyibwako ekitiibwa, naye oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa." Mu yeekaalu, ne mu maaso ga Katonda, ne mu kumusinza, buli kimu tekiriiko mugaso nga tekibunyisiddwamu bwetoowaze bwa nnamaddala, obw'amazima eri Katonda n'eri abantu.

Bwe yamala okunaaza ebigere by'abayigirizwa, Yesu yagamba (Yokaana 13:14), "Oba nga Nze, Mukama wammwe era Omuyigiriza, nnaaze ebigere byammwe, nammwe kibagwanira okunaazagana ebigere." Obuyinza obw'ekiragiro n'eky'okulabirako, buli ndowooza, oba ey'okugondera oba ey'okufaanana, bifuula obwetoowaze ekintu ekisooka era ekisinga obukulu mu buyigirizwa. Ku mmeeza y'Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu, abayigirizwa baali bakyawakana ani asaana okuba omukulu (Lukka 22:26). Yesu n'agamba, "Asinga obukulu mu mmwe afuuke ng'asinga obuto, n'omukulembeze abeere ng'aweereza. Nze ndi mu mmwe ng'oyo aweereza."

Ekkubo Yesu lye yatambulira, era lye yatuggulirawo, amaanyi n'omwoyo mwe yakolera obulokozi bwaffe, era gye yatulokolera, bulijjo bwe bwetoowaze obumfuula omuweereza wa bonna. Nga kino tekibuulirwa katono! Nga tekikolebwa! Nga obutakibaako tebuwuliddwa wadde okwatulwa! Sigamba nti abakituukako batono, n'ekigero eky'okufaanana Yesu mu bwetoowaze bwe. Naye abalowooza okukifuula ekigendererwa eky'enjawulo eky'okwegomba n'okusaba okutasalako, batono nnyo. Nga ensi ekirabyeko katono! Nga tekirabiddwa n'okulaba wadde mu kibinja eky'omunda eky'Ekkanisa! "Asinga obukulu mu mmwe afuuke ng'asinga obuto, n'omukulembeze abeere ng'aweereza." Ffenna tumanyi kye kitegeeza empisa y'omuweereza omwesigwa oba omuddu. Okwewaayo eri ebyetaago bya mukama we, okufaayo n'okwegendereza okumusanyusa, okusanyukira okukulaakulana kwe n'ekitiibwa kye n'essanyu lye. Waliwo abaweereza ku nsi abalabikamu empisa zino, era gye erinnya ery'omuweereza teribeeranga kintu kirala wabula kitiibwa.

Eri bangi ku ffe tekibadde ssanyu ppya mu bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo okumanya nti tuyinza okwewaayo ng'abaweereza, ng'abaddu ba Katonda, era n'okuzuula nti okumuweereza kwe ddembe lyaffe erisinga obukulu? Eddembe okuva mu kibi ne mu bwaffe? Kaakano tulina okuyiga essomo eddala, nti Yesu atuyita okuba abaweereza ba bannaffe, era nti, bwe tukikkiriza n'omutima gwaffe gwonna, n'okuweereza kuno kunaaba okw'omukisa ennyo, eddembe eppya era erijjuvu okuva mu kibi ne mu bwaffe.

Okusooka, kiyinza okulabika ng'ekizibu, naye kino kiva kwokka ku malala agakyeetwala ng'ekintu.

Bwe tunaamala okuyiga nti obutaba kantu mu maaso ga Katonda kwe kitiibwa eky'ekitonde, omwoyo gwa Yesu, essanyu ery'omu ggulu, tunaasembeza n'omutima gwaffe gwonna okukangavvulwa kwe tuyinza okufuna nga tuweereza n'abo abagezaako okutunyiiza. Omutima gwaffe bwe gunaaba nga gwessizza ku kino, okutukuzibwa okw'amazima, tunaasoma buli kigambo kya Yesu ekikwata ku kwetoowaza n'obunyiikivu obuggya, era teriibe kifo kya wansi nnyo, wadde okukutama okwa wansi ennyo, wadde okuweereza okunyoomebwa oba okuwangaala ennyo, singa tusobola okugabana n'okukakasa obumu ne Oyo eyayogera nti, "Nze ndi mu mmwe ng'oyo aweereza." (Lukka 22:27).

Abooluganda, lino lye kkubo erituusa ku bulamu obw'ekifo waggulu. Wansi, wansi ennyo! Kino Yesu kye yagamba bulijjo abayigirizwa abaali balowooza okuba abakulu mu bwakabaka, n'okutuula ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo n'ogwa kkono. Temunoonya wadde okusaba okugulumizibwa; ogwo mulimu gwa Katonda. Mwegendereze mube n'omusingi mwetoowaze, temutwala kifo mu maaso ga Katonda oba omuntu okuggyako eky'omuweereza; ogwo gwe mulimu gwammwe; ekyo kibeere ekigendererwa kyammwe ekimu n'okusaba kwammwe. Katonda mwesigwa. Nga amazzi bulijjo bwe ganoonya ne gajjuza ekifo ekisinga wansi, bwe kityo mu kaseera Katonda k'asangira ekitonde nga kyetoowazizza era nga kya bwereere, ekitiibwa kye n'amaanyi ge bikulukuta ne biyingira okugulumiza n'okuwa omukisa. Oyo eyeetoowaza — ekyo kye kiteekwa okuba ekintu kyaffe ekimu kye tufaako — aligulumizibwa; ekyo kifa ku Katonda; olw'amaanyi ge amangi era mu kwagala kwe okungi anaakikola.

Abantu oluusi boogera ng'obwetoowaze n'obuwombeefu bwe binaatunyaga ebyo ebya ssa, eby'obuvumu, n'eby'obusajja. Singa bonna bakkiriza nti buno bwe bukungu obw'obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu, nti guno gwe mwoyo ogw'obwakabaka Kabaka w'omu ggulu gwe yalaga, nti kino kifaanana Katonda, okwetoowaza, okufuuka omuweereza wa bonna! Lino lye kkubo erituusa ku ssanyu n'ekitiibwa eky'okubeerawo kwa Kristo mu ffe bulijjo, n'amaanyi ge okutuwummuliza bulijjo. Yesu, Omuwombeefu era Omwetoowaze, atuyita okumuyigirako ekkubo erituusa eri Katonda.

Ka tusome ebigambo bye tubadde tusoma okutuusa omutima gwaffe lwe gunajjula ekirowoozo nti: Ekyetaago kyange ekimu bwe bwetoowaze. Era ka tukkirize nti ky'alaga, akiwaayo; nga bw'ali, bw'atugabira. Nga Omuwombeefu era Omwetoowaze, anajja n'abeera mu mutima ogwegomba.

Omutima gwaffe bwe gunaaba nga gwessizza ku kino, okutukuzibwa okw'amazima, tunaasoma buli kigambo kya Yesu ekikwata ku kwetoowaza n'obunyiikivu obuggya, era teriibe kifo kya wansi nnyo, wadde okukutama okwa wansi ennyo, wadde okuweereza okunyoomebwa oba okuwangaala ennyo, singa tusobola okugabana n'okukakasa obumu ne Oyo eyayogera nti, "Nze ndi mu mmwe ng'oyo aweereza." (Lukka 22:27). Abooluganda, lino lye kkubo erituusa ku bulamu obw'ekifo waggulu. Wansi, wansi ennyo! Kino Yesu kye yagamba bulijjo abayigirizwa abaali balowooza okuba abakulu mu bwakabaka, n'okutuula ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo n'ogwa kkono. Temunoonya wadde okusaba okugulumizibwa; ogwo mulimu gwa Katonda. Mwegendereze mube n'omusingi mwetoowaze, temutwala kifo mu maaso ga Katonda oba omuntu okuggyako eky'omuweereza; ogwo gwe mulimu gwammwe; ekyo kibeere ekigendererwa kyammwe ekimu n'okusaba kwammwe. Katonda mwesigwa. Nga amazzi bulijjo bwe ganoonya ne gajjuza ekifo ekisinga wansi, bwe kityo mu kaseera Katonda k'asangira ekitonde nga kyetoowazizza era nga kya bwereere, ekitiibwa kye n'amaanyi ge bikulukuta ne biyingira okugulumiza n'okuwa omukisa. Oyo eyeetoowaza — ekyo kye kiteekwa okuba ekintu kyaffe ekimu kye tufaako — aligulumizibwa; ekyo kifa ku Katonda; olw'amaanyi ge amangi era mu kwagala kwe okungi anaakikola. Abantu oluusi boogera ng'obwetoowaze n'obuwombeefu bwe binaatunyaga ebyo ebya ssa, eby'obuvumu, n'eby'obusajja. Ka tusome ebigambo bye tubadde tusoma okutuusa omutima gwaffe lwe gunajjula ekirowoozo nti: Ekyetaago kyange ekimu bwe bwetoowaze. Era ka tukkirize nti ky'alaga, akiwaayo; nga bw'ali, bw'atugabira. Nga Omuwombeefu era Omwetoowaze, anajja n'abeera mu mutima ogwegomba.

fields.title: Obwetoowaze mu Bayigirizwa ba Yesu
fields.body_html:
"Asinga obukulu mu mmwe abeere ng'asinga obuto, n'omukulembeze abeere ng'oyo aweereza." Lukka 22:26.

Twetegerezza obwetoowaze mu muntu wa Yesu ne mu njigiriza ye. Kaakati ka tubunoonye mu kibiina ky'abo be yeeroboza okubeera naye, abatume ekkumi n'ababiri. Bwe kiba nti obwetoowaze bwe tutabalabako bulaga bulungi enjawulo eri wakati wa Kristo n'abantu, kijja kutuyamba okusiima enkyukakyuka ey'amaanyi Pentekoote gye yaleeta mu bo, era kikakase engeri gye tuyinza okwenyigira mu ddala mu buwanguzi obutuukiridde obw'obwetoowaze bwa Kristo ku malala Setaani ge yassa mu muntu. Mu byawandiikibwa ebyajulizibwa okuva mu njigiriza ya Yesu, twakimala okulaba embeera abayigirizwa mwe baalaga nga tebalina n'akatono ku kisa ky'obwetoowaze. Olumu, baali bawakana mu kkubo ani ku bo eyandibadde asinga obukulu.

Olulala, batabani ba Zebbedaayo ne nnyaabwe baali basabye ebifo ebisooka, entebe ey'oku mukono ogwa ddyo n'ogwa kkono. Ate oluvannyuma, ku mmeeza ey'ekyekiro ku kiro eky'enkomerero, ne wabaawo nate empaka ani ayandibaliddwa okuba asinga obukulu. Si kutegeeza nga tewaali biseera lwe beetoowaza ddala mu maaso ga Mukama waabwe. Bwe kityo bwe kyali ne Peetero bwe yaleekaana nti, "Vva ku nze, kubanga ndi muntu wa kibi, ai Mukama wange." Lukka 5:8.

Bwe kityo bwe kyali ne bayigirizwa bwe baagwa wansi ne basinza oyo eyali asirisizza omuyaga. Naye enjatula ez'obwetoowaze ez'ebbanga ne bbanga zeezo zoolekesa bwereere embeera etereevu ey'emyoyo gyabwe, nga bwe kyalabikira mu kubikkulwa okw'obutonde era okw'olubuto mu biseera ebirala okw'ekifo n'amaanyi eby'obwefaako. Okwetegereza amakulu ga bino byonna kujja kutuyigiriza amasomo agasingira ddala obukulu.

Ekisooka, obungi bw'eddiini eyeenyiikivu era ennamu bwe buyinza okubaawo ate ng'obwetoowaze bukyabulako mu ngeri ey'ennaku.

Kirabe mu bayigirizwa. Mu bo mwalimu okwegatta okw'omuliro eri Yesu. Baali balese byonna ku lulwe. Kitaawe yali abibikkulidde nti ye Kristo wa Katonda. Baamukkiriza, baamwagala, ne bagondera amateeka ge. Baali balese byonna okumugoberera. Abalala bwe baddayo emabega, bo ne banywerera ku ye. Baali beeteefuteefu okufa naye. Naye ekyali mu buziba okusinga bino byonna kyali amaanyi ag'ekizikiza agaali mu buvamu bwabwe, ago obubi bwago obw'ekyenyinyalwa bwe baali tebamanyidde ddala, agaali galina okuttibwa ne gasuulibwa ebweru, nga tebannaba kufuuka bajulizi b'amaanyi ga Yesu ag'okulokola.

Tuyinza okusanga abayigiriza n'abaweereza, ababuulizi b'enjiri n'abakozi, ababaka n'abasomesa, abalimu ebirabo by'Omwoyo ebingi era ebyeeyoleka, era abali emikutu gy'omukisa eri ebibiina by'abantu, naye ku abo, ekiseera eky'okugezesebwa bwe kituuka, oba enkolagana eya kumpi bw'ereeta okumanya okugazi, kyeeyoleka mu ngeri ey'obulumi nti ekisa ky'obwetoowaze, ng'engeri eneenywerera, tekirabika luyi. Byonna bikwasa ekisomo nti obwetoowaze bwe bumu ku bisa ebisookerwako era ebisingira ddala waggulu. Kimu ku ebyo ebisinga obuzibu okufunibwa, kye kimu okufuba kwaffe okusooka era okusinga obukulu kwe kwandireeserezeddwa, era kimu ekijja mu maanyi kwokka. Omwoyo ogujjula bwe gutufuula abaagabana ku Kristo abeera mu ffe, ye abeera munda mu ffe.

Ekyokubiri, obutaba na maanyi bwe kuyigiriza kwonna okw'ebweru n'okufuba kwonna okw'omuntu ku bubwe, mu kuwangula amalala oba okuwa omutima omuwombeefu era omwetoowaze. Okumala emyaka esatu, abayigirizwa baali mu ssomero ery'okutendekebwa ery'a Yesu, era yali abagambye ekisomo ekikulu kye yayagala okubayigiriza. "Muyige gye ndi, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omwetoowaze mu mutima" Matayo 11:29. Emirundi n'emirundi yali abagambye, ne Abafalisaayo, n'ekibiina ky'abantu, ku bwetoowaze ng'ekkubo ekyokka eridda mu kitiibwa kya Katonda. Teyabeera mu maaso gaabwe ng'Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda mu bwetoowaze bwe obwa Katonda kyokka, wabula emirundi egisukka ogumu yali abaggulirawo ekyama ekisingira ddala munda eky'obulamu bwe: "Omwana w'omuntu teyajja kuweerezebwa, wabula okuweereza" (Matayo 20:28); "Nze ndi wakati mu mmwe ng'oyo aweereza." Lukka 22:27. Yali abanaazizza ebigere byabwe, n'abagamba nti balina okugoberera ekyokulabirako kye. Naye wadde bwe kityo byonna byali bigasizza katono.

Ku Kyekiro Ekitukuvu, empaka zaali zikyaliwo ku ani eyandibadde asinga obukulu. Awatali kubuusabuusa emirundi mingi baali bagezaako okuyiga ebisomo bye, ne bamalirira ddala obutaddamu kumunakuwaza naye byonna bwereere. Okuyigiriza bo naffe ekisomo ekyetaagisa ennyo, nti tewali kuyigiriza kwa kungulu, wadde okwa Kristo yennyini; tewali mpaka wadde nga zikkiriza, tewali kutegeera bulungi bw'obwetoowaze, wadde nga kwa buziba butya, tewali kumalirira kwa muntu oba kufuba, wadde nga kwa mazima era kwa nyiikivu kutya, ekiyinza okugoba sitaani ow'amalala. Setaani bw'agoba Setaani, kuba kudda mu buggya mu maanyi agakiryawo, wadde nga gakwekeddwa okusingawo. Tewali kiyinza kugasa okuggyako kino, nti obuntu obuggya mu bwetoowaze bwabwo obwa Katonda bubikkulwe mu maanyi okudda mu kifo eky'obukadde, okufuuka ddala obuntu bwaffe bwennyini nga bwe bwabeeranga bulijjo.

Ekyokusatu, kwe kubeera kwa Kristo munda mu ffe kwokka, mu bwetoowaze bwe obwa Katonda, kwe tufuukira abetoowaze mu mazima.

Amalala gaffe tugaggya mu mulala, mu Adamu; noolwekyo, obwetoowaze bwaffe nabwo tulina okububaggya mu mulala. Amalala gaffe ge gaffe, era gatufuga n'amaanyi amabi bwe gatyo kubanga ge ffe fennyini, obuntu bwaffe bwennyini.

Obwetoowaze bulina okuba obwaffe mu ngeri y'emu, bulina okuba ffe fennyini era obuntu bwaffe. Nga bwe kyabadde eky'obutonde era ekyangu okuba ow'amalala, bwe kityo bwe kiteekwa okubeera, era bwe kirituuka, okuba omwetoowaze. Ekisuubizo kigamba nti, "We," ne mu mutima, "kyeyongera, ekisa ne kisukkirira nnyo okusingawo" Abaruumi 5:20.

Okuyigiriza kwonna okwa Kristo eri abayigirizwa be n'okufuba kwabwe kwonna okutaliimu kwali kwe kuteekateeka okwetaagisa okw'okuyingira kwe mu bo mu maanyi aga Katonda, okuwa n'okubeera mu bo ekyo kye yali abayigirizza okwegomba. Mu kufa kwe, yazikiriza amaanyi ga sitaani, yaggyawo ekibi, era yatuukiriza okununulibwa okw'olubeerera. Mu kuzuukira kwe, yaweebwa okuva eri Kitaawe obulamu obuggya ddala, obulamu bw'omuntu mu maanyi ga Katonda, obusobola okutuusibwa eri abantu, okuyingira, okuzza obuggya, n'okujjuza obulamu bwabwe n'amaanyi ge aga Katonda.

Mu kulinnya kwe mu ggulu, yaweebwa Omwoyo owa Kitaawe, gw'ayita okukola ky'atayinza kukola nga akyali ku nsi: okwefuula omu n'abo be yayagala n'okubatuukiririza obulamu bwabwe, balyoke basobole okubeera mu maaso ga Kitaawe mu bwetoowaze obufaanana obubwe, kubanga ye yennyini ye yali abeera era assa omukka mu bo. Ku Pentekoote, yajja n'abeetwala. Omulimu ogw'okuteekateeka n'okukakasa, okuzuukusa okwegomba n'essuubi bye yali atuukirizza okuyigiriza kwe, gwatuukirizibwa enkyukakyuka ey'amaanyi Pentekoote gye yaleeta. Obulamu n'ebbaluwa za Yakobo, Peetero, ne Yokaana biwa obujulizi nti byonna byakyusibwa, era omwoyo gwa Yesu omuwombeefu era abonyaabonyezebwa gwali gubeetutte ddala. Tunaayogera ki ku bintu bino? Mu basomi bange, nkakasa nti waliwo ekibinja ekisukka mu kimu.

Bayinza okubaawo abamu abatabaddewo balowoozezza ku nsonga eno mu ngeri ey'enjawulo, era abatasobola mangu kutegeera bukulu bwayo obungi ng'ekibuuzo ky'obulamu eri Ekkanisa na buli mmemba wayo. Abalala bawulidde nga basaliddwa omusango olw'obunafu bwabwe, ne bafuba nnyo, kyokka baalemererwa ne baggwaamu amaanyi. Abalala bayinza okuwa obujulizi obw'essanyu obw'omukisa ogw'omwoyo n'amaanyi, kyokka tewabaddewo kukakasibwa okwetaagisa ku ekyo abo abeebagalako kye bakyalaba nga tekiriiwo. Ate n'abalala bayinza okuwa obujulizi nti ku kisa kino Mukama abawadde okununulibwa n'obuwanguzi, ate nga abayigirizza obungi bwe bakyeetaaga era bwe bayinza okusuubira okuva mu kujjula kwa Yesu.

Ku kibinja kyonna kye tuli, nkubiriza obwetaavu obunywevu eri ffe ffenna okunoonya okukakasibwa okw'omunda ku kifo eky'enjawulo obwetoowaze kye bulina mu nkolagana yaffe ne Kristo, n'obutasoboka ddala eri Ekkanisa oba omukkiriza okuba nga Kristo bw'ayagala babeere, ng'obwetoowaze bwe tebukyanajulizibwa ng'ekitiibwa kye ekikulu, ekiragiro kye ekisooka, n'omukisa gwaffe ogusinga obukulu. Ka twetegereze mu buziba engeri abayigirizwa gye baali bakyali mu ntandikwa ate ng'ekisa kino kibabbulako nnyo, era ka tusabe Katonda ebirabo ebirala bireme okututa bwe kityo, ne twe tutamanya nti obutabaawo bw'ekisa kino y'ensonga enkweke lwaki amaanyi ga Katonda tegasobola kukola mulimu gwago ogw'amaanyi. Kiba kwokka nga ffe, ng'Omwana, tumanyi era tulaga mu mazima nti tetuyinza kukola kintu ku bwaffe, wabula Katonda y'alikola byonna. Kiba nga amazima ag'okubeera kwa Kristo munda mu ffe gatutte ekifo kye geetaaga mu bulamu bw'abakkiriza, Ekkanisa lw'eneeyambaza ebyambalo byayo ebirungi era obwetoowaze bulabike mu bayigiriza baayo ne bammemba baayo ng'obulungi obw'obutukuvu.

Obulamu n'ebbaluwa za Yakobo, Peetero, ne Yokaana biwa obujulizi nti byonna byakyusibwa, era omwoyo gwa Yesu omuwombeefu era abonyaabonyezebwa gwali gubeetutte ddala. Tunaayogera ki ku bintu bino? Mu basomi bange, nkakasa nti waliwo ekibinja ekisukka mu kimu. Bayinza okubaawo abamu abatabaddewo balowoozezza ku nsonga eno mu ngeri ey'enjawulo, era abatasobola mangu kutegeera bukulu bwayo obungi ng'ekibuuzo ky'obulamu eri Ekkanisa na buli mmemba wayo. Abalala bawulidde nga basaliddwa omusango olw'obunafu bwabwe, ne bafuba nnyo, kyokka baalemererwa ne baggwaamu amaanyi. Abalala bayinza okuwa obujulizi obw'essanyu obw'omukisa ogw'omwoyo n'amaanyi, kyokka tewabaddewo kukakasibwa okwetaagisa ku ekyo abo abeebagalako kye bakyalaba nga tekiriiwo. Ate n'abalala bayinza okuwa obujulizi nti ku kisa kino Mukama abawadde okununulibwa n'obuwanguzi, ate nga abayigirizza obungi bwe bakyeetaaga era bwe bayinza okusuubira okuva mu kujjula kwa Yesu. Ku kibinja kyonna kye tuli, nkubiriza obwetaavu obunywevu eri ffe ffenna okunoonya okukakasibwa okw'omunda ku kifo eky'enjawulo obwetoowaze kye bulina mu nkolagana yaffe ne Kristo, n'obutasoboka ddala eri Ekkanisa oba omukkiriza okuba nga Kristo bw'ayagala babeere, ng'obwetoowaze bwe tebukyanajulizibwa ng'ekitiibwa kye ekikulu, ekiragiro kye ekisooka, n'omukisa gwaffe ogusinga obukulu. Ka twetegereze mu buziba engeri abayigirizwa gye baali bakyali mu ntandikwa ate ng'ekisa kino kibabbulako nnyo, era ka tusabe Katonda ebirabo ebirala bireme okututa bwe kityo, ne twe tutamanya nti obutabaawo bw'ekisa kino y'ensonga enkweke lwaki amaanyi ga Katonda tegasobola kukola mulimu gwago ogw'amaanyi. Kiba kwokka nga ffe, ng'Omwana, tumanyi era tulaga mu mazima nti tetuyinza kukola kintu ku bwaffe, wabula Katonda y'alikola byonna. Kiba nga amazima ag'okubeera kwa Kristo munda mu ffe gatutte ekifo kye geetaaga mu bulamu bw'abakkiriza, Ekkanisa lw'eneeyambaza ebyambalo byayo ebirungi era obwetoowaze bulabike mu bayigiriza baayo ne bammemba baayo ng'obulungi obw'obutukuvu.

fields.title: Obwetoowaze mu Bulamu bwa Buli Lunaku
fields.body_html:
"Omuntu bw'ayogera nti, 'Njagala Katonda,” naye n'akyawa muganda we, mulimba; kubanga oyo atayagala muganda we gw'alabye, tasobola kwagala Katonda gw'atalabanga." 1 Yokaana 4:20.

Ekirowoozo eky'amaanyi nnyo, nti okwagala kwaffe eri Katonda kunaagerebwa okusinziira ku nkolagana yaffe eya buli lunaku n'abantu, n'okwagala kwe kulaga. Okwagala kwaffe eri Katonda kunaasangibwa nga bulimba, okuggyako ng'obutuufu bwakwo bukakasibwa mu kugumira ekigezo eky'obulamu obwa buli lunaku n'abantu bannaffe. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n'obwetoowaze bwaffe. Kyangu okulowooza nti twetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda, naye obwetoowaze eri abantu bwe bunaaba obukakafu bwokka obumala okulaga nti obwetoowaze bwaffe eri Katonda bwa mazima. Kino kiraga nti obwetoowaze bumaze okutuula mu ffe ne bufuuka omuze gwaffe ddala, nga, nga Kristo, twefudde aba bwereere. Bwe tuba mu maaso ga Katonda, obwetoowaze bw'omutima tebufuuse mbeera gye tumusabira, wabula bufuuse mwoyo gwennyini ogw'obulamu bwaffe, era bunaalabika mu mpisa zaffe zonna eri baganda baffe.

Essomo lino lya makulu nnyo; obwetoowaze bwokka obwaffe ddala si bwe tugezaako okulaga mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba, wabula bwe tugenda nabwo, era ne tubukola, mu mpisa zaffe eza bulijjo.

Ebintu ebitono eby'obulamu obwa buli lunaku bye bikulu era bye bigezo eby'emirembe n'emirembe, kubanga bikakasa omwoyo ogutufuga bwe guli. Mu biseera bye tutassaako mwoyo mwe tulagira ddala era ne tweraba kye tuli.

Okumanya omuntu ow'obwetoowaze, okumanya engeri omuntu ow'obwetoowaze gy'eyisamu, oteekwa okumugoberera mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku. Kino si kye Yesu kye yayigiriza? Kyali abayigirizwa bwe baawakana ani asaanira okuba omukulu, bwe yalaba Abafalisaayo nga baagala ebifo ebisinga ku mbaga n'entebe ez'ekitiibwa mu makuŋŋaaniro, bwe yali amaze okubawa ekyokulabirako eky'okunaaza ebigere byabwe, we yayigirizira amasomo ge ag'obwetoowaze.

Obwetoowaze eri Katonda tebugasa bwe butakakasibwa mu bwetoowaze eri abantu. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu kuyigiriza kwa Pawulo. Eri Abaruumi, awandiika nti: "Musussanga bannammwe ekitiibwa." (Abaruumi 12:10); "Temwegulumizanga, naye mukwatiraganenga n'abawombeefu. Temweraba nga b'amagezi mu maaso gammwe mmwe." Abaruumi 12:16.

"Teweeraba nga w'amagezi mu maaso go ggwe" Engero 3:7. Eri Abakkolinso: "Okwagala," era tewali kwagala nga tekulina bwetoowaze ng'emmizi gyakwo, "tekukwatirwa buggya, tekwenyumiriza, tekwegulumiza." 1 Abakkolinso 13:4.

Eri Abaggalatiya: "Tuleme okwegulumiza, nga tunyiiganya bannaffe, nga tukwatirwa bannaffe obuggya." Eri Abaefeso, amangu ddala oluvannyuma lw'essuula essatu ez'ekitalo ku bulamu obw'omu ggulu: "n'obwetoowaze bwonna n'obuwombeefu, n'obugumiikiriza, nga mwegumiikirizaganya mu kwagala"; "Nga muwuliragananga mu kutya Kristo."

Eri Abafiripi: "Temukolanga kintu na kimu olw'okwewuubaala oba okwemanya, wabula mu bwetoowaze buli omu abalenga banne ng'abamusinga." Abafiripi 2:3. "Mube n'endowooza eno mu mmwe, gye mulina mu Kristo Yesu." Abafiripi 2:5 "yeefiisa, n'atwala ekifaananyi eky'omuddu" Abafiripi 2:7.

Eri Abakkolosaayi: "Kale mwambale, ng'abalonde ba Katonda, abatukuvu era abaagalwa, emitima egy'ekisa, obulungi, obwetoowaze, obuwombeefu, n'obugumiikiriza, nga mwegumiikirizaganya, era omuntu bw'aba n'ensonga ku munne, nga musonyiwagana; nga Mukama bwe yabasonyiwa" Abakkolosaayi 3:12-13.

Mu nkolagana yaffe, mu ngeri gye tuyisaganyaamu, mwe tulabira obwetoowaze obwa nnamaddala obw'omutima n'omutima ogw'obwetoowaze. Obwetoowaze bwaffe eri Katonda tebulina makulu mu bwabwo, naye bututegeka okulaga obwetoowaze bwa Yesu eri abantu bannaffe. Twekenneenye obwetoowaze mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku nga tutunuulira ebigambo bino.

Omuntu ow'obwetoowaze bulijjo anoonya okutuukiriza etteeka lino, "Temukolanga kintu na kimu olw'okwewuubaala oba okwemanya, wabula mu bwetoowaze buli omu abalenga banne ng'abamusinga." Abafiripi 2:3. Ekibuuzo kibuuzibwa emirundi mingi, tuyinza tutya okulaba abalala nga batusinga, songa nga tulaba nga batusingibwa mu magezi ne mu butukuvu, mu birabo bye baazaalirwa nabyo, oba mu kisa kye baaweebwa? Ekibuuzo kino amangu ddala kikakasa nga bwe tutategeera bunnyini obwetoowaze obwa nnamaddala obw'omutima kye buli.

Obwetoowaze obwa nnamaddala bujja nga, mu kitangaala kya Katonda, twerabidde nga tuli bwereere, ne tukkiriza okuva ku ffe fennyini n'okwesuula, ne tuleka Katonda okuba byonna. Emmeeme eyakola kino, era esobola okwogera nti, bwe ntyo bwe neefiiriddwawo nga nkulaba Ggwe, tekyeegeraageranya na balala. Yavaako emirembe gyonna endowooza yonna ey'okwefaako mu maaso ga Katonda. Esisinkana abantu bannaayo ng'omuntu ali bwereere, era nga teyeenoonyeza kantu konna. Emmeeme eno muweereza wa Katonda, era ku lulwe muweereza wa bonna.

Omuweereza omwesigwa ayinza okuba n'amagezi okusinga mukama we, kyokka n'akuuma omwoyo n'embeera ey'amazima ey'omuweereza. Omuntu ow'obwetoowaze atunuulira buli mwana wa Katonda, ne singa ali munafu ennyo era atasaanira, n'amuwa ekitiibwa era n'amussa mu maaso mu kitiibwa ng'omwana wa Kabaka. Omwoyo gw'oyo eyanaaza ebigere by'abayigirizwa gutufuula essanyu okuba ddala abasembayo, okuba abaweereza ba bannaffe. Omuntu ow'obwetoowaze tawulira buggya wadde obusungu. Asobola okutendereza Katonda abalala bwe basiimibwa ne baweebwa omukisa okumusinga.

Asobola okugumira okuwulira abalala nga batenderezebwa ate ye nga yeerabiddwa, kubanga mu maaso ga Katonda yayiga okwogera ne Pawulo nti, "Siri kantu." Yafuna omwoyo gwa Yesu ataasanyusa yekka, era ataanoonya kitiibwa kye ye ng'omwoyo ogw'obulamu bwe. Wakati mu ebyo ebibalibwa ng'ebikemo eby'obutagumiikiriza n'obunyiivu, eby'ebirowoozo ebizibu n'ebigambo ebibi, ebiva mu bulemereze n'ebibi eby'Abakristaayo bannaffe, omuntu ow'obwetoowaze atwala mu mutima gwe ekiragiro ekiddibwamu emirundi mingi, era n'akiraga mu bulamu bwe, "nga mwegumiikirizaganya, era omuntu bw'aba n'ensonga ku munne, nga musonyiwagana; nga Mukama bwe yabasonyiwa" Yayiga nti bw'ayambala Mukama waffe Yesu, aba yambadde omutima ogw'ekisa, obulungi, obwetoowaze, obuwombeefu, n'obugumiikiriza.

Yesu yatwala ekifo ky'okwefaako, era kisoboka okusonyiwa nga Yesu bwe yasonyiwa. Obwetoowaze bwe tebuli mu birowoozo oba ebigambo eby'okwenyoomaako byokka, wabula, nga Pawulo bw'akyogera, mu "mutima ogw'obwetoowaze," ogwetooloddwa ekisa n'obulungi, obuwombeefu n'obugumiikiriza, obuwombeefu obuwoomerevu era obwetoowaze obumanyiddwa ng'akabonero k'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda.

Mu kufuba okutuuka ku bintu ebisingako obw'engulu eby'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, omukkiriza emirundi mingi ali mu kabi ak'okugendereza n'okusanyukira ebyo bye tuyinza okuyita empisa ez'obuntu ennyo, ez'obusajja, gamba ng'obuvumu, essanyu, okunyooma ensi, obunyiikivu, n'okwewaayo. N'ab'edda abayitibwa ab'e Sitoyiki baabyigiriza era ne babikola.

Ekisa ekikwata wansi ennyo era ekiwombeefu, eky'obwakatonda era eky'omu ggulu ennyo, ekyo Yesu kye yasooka okuyigiriza ku nsi kubanga yakireeta okuva mu ggulu, ekyo ekikwatagana ennyo n'omusaalaba gwe n'okufa kw'okwefaako, obwavu obw'omwoyo, obuwombeefu, obwetoowaze, n'okwetoowaza, tebirowoozebwako wadde okussibwako omuwendo. Kale nno, twambale omutima ogw'ekisa, obulungi, obwetoowaze, obuwombeefu, n'obugumiikiriza, era tukakase okufaanana kwaffe okwa Kristo, si mu bunyiikivu bwaffe obw'okulokola ababuze bwokka, wabula okusookera byonna mu nkolagana yaffe ne baganda baffe, nga twegumiikirizaganya era nga tusonyiwagana, nga Mukama bwe yatusonyiwa.

Abakristaayo bannange, twekenneenye ekifaananyi eky'omuntu ow'obwetoowaze nga bwe kiri mu Baibuli. Era tubuuze baganda baffe n'ensi oba balaba mu ffe okufaanana n'ekyokulabirako ekisooka. Tuleme okumatira ku kintu kyonna wabula okutwala buli kimu ku byawandiikibwa bino ng'ekisuubizo kya Katonda ky'anaakola mu ffe, ng'okubikkulirwa mu bigambo kw'ekyo Omwoyo gwa Yesu gw'anaatuzaaliramu munda mu ffe. Era buli kulemererwa na buli bbula libe lyokka litukubirize okukyukira mu bwetoowaze ne mu buwombeefu eri Omwana gw'Endiga ow'obuwombeefu era ow'obwetoowaze owa Katonda, nga tukakasa nti we yatuulira ku ntebe mu mutima, obwetoowaze bwe n'obuwombeefu bwe binaaba emu ku migga gy'amazzi amalamu egikulukuta okuva munda mu ffe.

"Namanya Yesu, era yali wa muwendo nnyo eri emmeeme yange, naye ne nsanga ekintu mu nze ekyagaana okusigala nga kiwoomerevu, nga kigumiikiriza, era nga kya kisa. Nakola kye nasobola okukirekereza, naye kyali kiriwo. Neegayirira Yesu ankolere ekintu, era bwe namuwa okwagala kwange, yajja mu mutima gwange, n'aggyamu byonna ebyagaana okuba ebiwoomerevu, eby'ekisa, era ebigumiikiriza, oluvannyuma n'aggalawo oluggi." George Foxe.

Nziramu kye nnaayogera edda. Mpulira nnyo nga tulina okutegeera kutono nnyo nti Ekkanisa erumwa olw'obutaba na bwetoowaze obwa Katonda, obwereere obuwa Katonda ekifo okulaga amaanyi ge. Tekimaze bbanga ddene Omukristaayo, ow'omwoyo omwetoowaze era ogw'okwagala, eyamanya amakuŋŋaaniro g'obweraliikirivu mangi ag'ebibiina eby'enjawulo, bwe yalaga ennaku ye ennyingi nti mu mbeera ezimu omwoyo ogw'okwagala n'okugumiikiriza gwali gubuze nnyo. Abasajja n'abakazi, abaali basobola mu Bulaaya okwerondera abemikwano gyabwe, bwe baaleetebwa awamu kumpi n'abalala ab'ebirowoozo ebitakwatagana, bakisanga nga kizibu okugumira, okwagala, n'okukuuma obumu obw'Omwoyo mu kinywa eky'emirembe. N'abo abandibadde abayambi ba bannaabwe mu ssanyu bafuuka enkonge era ekikoowu. Kino kiva ku butaba na bwetoowaze obwerowooza ng'obwereere, obusanyukira okufuuka n'okubalibwa ng'obusembayo, era obunoonya bwokka, nga Yesu, okuba omuweereza, omuyambi era omusanyusa w'abalala, ne singa ab'ekisembayo era abatasaanira.

Ate era, lwaki abantu abeewaayo n'essanyu olwa Kristo, kibazibuwalira nnyo okwewaayo olwa baganda baabwe? Ekkanisa terina musango? Eyigirizza katono nnyo abaana baayo nti obwetoowaze bwa Kristo bwe busooka mu mpisa ennungi, obw'ekitiibwa okusinga mu birabo byonna n'amaanyi gonna ag'Omwoyo.

Ekkanisa ekakasizza katono nnyo nti obwetoowaze obufaanana n'obwa Kristo bwe bwe eteeka mu maaso era bwe ebuulira olubereberye, nga Kristo bwe yakola, nga kye kyetaagisa ddala, era ekisoboka. Naye tuleme okuggwaamu amaanyi. Okuzuula obutaba na kisa kino kitukubirize okusuubira ebisingawo okuva eri Katonda. Tutunuulire buli muganda waffe atugezesa oba atunyiiza, ng'ekkubo lya Katonda ery'ekisa, ng'ekyuma kya Katonda eky'okutulongoosa, olw'okwenkanya obwetoowaze Yesu Obulamu bwaffe bw'assa munda mu ffe. Era tube n'okukkiriza mu Byonna ebya Katonda, n'obwereere obw'okwefaako, nti, nga tuli bwereere mu maaso gaffe, tusobole, mu maanyi ga Katonda, okunoonya kwokka okuweererezaganya mu kwagala.
