Asobola okugumira okuwulira abalala nga batenderezebwa ate ye nga yeerabiddwa, kubanga mu maaso ga Katonda yayiga okwogera ne Pawulo nti, "Siri kantu." Yafuna omwoyo gwa Yesu ataasanyusa yekka, era ataanoonya kitiibwa kye ye ng'omwoyo ogw'obulamu bwe. Wakati mu ebyo ebibalibwa ng'ebikemo eby'obutagumiikiriza n'obunyiivu, eby'ebirowoozo ebizibu n'ebigambo ebibi, ebiva mu bulemereze n'ebibi eby'Abakristaayo bannaffe, omuntu ow'obwetoowaze atwala mu mutima gwe ekiragiro ekiddibwamu emirundi mingi, era n'akiraga mu bulamu bwe, "nga mwegumiikirizaganya, era omuntu bw'aba n'ensonga ku munne, nga musonyiwagana; nga Mukama bwe yabasonyiwa" Yayiga nti bw'ayambala Mukama waffe Yesu, aba yambadde omutima ogw'ekisa, obulungi, obwetoowaze, obuwombeefu, n'obugumiikiriza. Yesu yatwala ekifo ky'okwefaako, era kisoboka okusonyiwa nga Yesu bwe yasonyiwa. Obwetoowaze bwe tebuli mu birowoozo oba ebigambo eby'okwenyoomaako byokka, wabula, nga Pawulo bw'akyogera, mu "mutima ogw'obwetoowaze," ogwetooloddwa ekisa n'obulungi, obuwombeefu n'obugumiikiriza, obuwombeefu obuwoomerevu era obwetoowaze obumanyiddwa ng'akabonero k'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda. Mu kufuba okutuuka ku bintu ebisingako obw'engulu eby'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, omukkiriza emirundi mingi ali mu kabi ak'okugendereza n'okusanyukira ebyo bye tuyinza okuyita empisa ez'obuntu ennyo, ez'obusajja, gamba ng'obuvumu, essanyu, okunyooma ensi, obunyiikivu, n'okwewaayo. N'ab'edda abayitibwa ab'e Sitoyiki baabyigiriza era ne babikola. Ekisa ekikwata wansi ennyo era ekiwombeefu, eky'obwakatonda era eky'omu ggulu ennyo, ekyo Yesu kye yasooka okuyigiriza ku nsi kubanga yakireeta okuva mu ggulu, ekyo ekikwatagana ennyo n'omusaalaba gwe n'okufa kw'okwefaako, obwavu obw'omwoyo, obuwombeefu, obwetoowaze, n'okwetoowaza, tebirowoozebwako wadde okussibwako omuwendo. Kale nno, twambale omutima ogw'ekisa, obulungi, obwetoowaze, obuwombeefu, n'obugumiikiriza, era tukakase okufaanana kwaffe okwa Kristo, si mu bunyiikivu bwaffe obw'okulokola ababuze bwokka, wabula okusookera byonna mu nkolagana yaffe ne baganda baffe, nga twegumiikirizaganya era nga tusonyiwagana, nga Mukama bwe yatusonyiwa. Abakristaayo bannange, twekenneenye ekifaananyi eky'omuntu ow'obwetoowaze nga bwe kiri mu Baibuli. Era tubuuze baganda baffe n'ensi oba balaba mu ffe okufaanana n'ekyokulabirako ekisooka. Tuleme okumatira ku kintu kyonna wabula okutwala buli kimu ku byawandiikibwa bino ng'ekisuubizo kya Katonda ky'anaakola mu ffe, ng'okubikkulirwa mu bigambo kw'ekyo Omwoyo gwa Yesu gw'anaatuzaaliramu munda mu ffe. Era buli kulemererwa na buli bbula libe lyokka litukubirize okukyukira mu bwetoowaze ne mu buwombeefu eri Omwana gw'Endiga ow'obuwombeefu era ow'obwetoowaze owa Katonda, nga tukakasa nti we yatuulira ku ntebe mu mutima, obwetoowaze bwe n'obuwombeefu bwe binaaba emu ku migga gy'amazzi amalamu egikulukuta okuva munda mu ffe. "Namanya Yesu, era yali wa muwendo nnyo eri emmeeme yange, naye ne nsanga ekintu mu nze ekyagaana okusigala nga kiwoomerevu, nga kigumiikiriza, era nga kya kisa. Nakola kye nasobola okukirekereza, naye kyali kiriwo. Neegayirira Yesu ankolere ekintu, era bwe namuwa okwagala kwange, yajja mu mutima gwange, n'aggyamu byonna ebyagaana okuba ebiwoomerevu, eby'ekisa, era ebigumiikiriza, oluvannyuma n'aggalawo oluggi." George Foxe. Nziramu kye nnaayogera edda. Mpulira nnyo nga tulina okutegeera kutono nnyo nti Ekkanisa erumwa olw'obutaba na bwetoowaze obwa Katonda, obwereere obuwa Katonda ekifo okulaga amaanyi ge. Tekimaze bbanga ddene Omukristaayo, ow'omwoyo omwetoowaze era ogw'okwagala, eyamanya amakuŋŋaaniro g'obweraliikirivu mangi ag'ebibiina eby'enjawulo, bwe yalaga ennaku ye ennyingi nti mu mbeera ezimu omwoyo ogw'okwagala n'okugumiikiriza gwali gubuze nnyo. Abasajja n'abakazi, abaali basobola mu Bulaaya okwerondera abemikwano gyabwe, bwe baaleetebwa awamu kumpi n'abalala ab'ebirowoozo ebitakwatagana, bakisanga nga kizibu okugumira, okwagala, n'okukuuma obumu obw'Omwoyo mu kinywa eky'emirembe. N'abo abandibadde abayambi ba bannaabwe mu ssanyu bafuuka enkonge era ekikoowu. Kino kiva ku butaba na bwetoowaze obwerowooza ng'obwereere, obusanyukira okufuuka n'okubalibwa ng'obusembayo, era obunoonya bwokka, nga Yesu, okuba omuweereza, omuyambi era omusanyusa w'abalala, ne singa ab'ekisembayo era abatasaanira. Ate era, lwaki abantu abeewaayo n'essanyu olwa Kristo, kibazibuwalira nnyo okwewaayo olwa baganda baabwe? Ekkanisa terina musango? Eyigirizza katono nnyo abaana baayo nti obwetoowaze bwa Kristo bwe busooka mu mpisa ennungi, obw'ekitiibwa okusinga mu birabo byonna n'amaanyi gonna ag'Omwoyo. Ekkanisa ekakasizza katono nnyo nti obwetoowaze obufaanana n'obwa Kristo bwe bwe eteeka mu maaso era bwe ebuulira olubereberye, nga Kristo bwe yakola, nga kye kyetaagisa ddala, era ekisoboka. Naye tuleme okuggwaamu amaanyi. Okuzuula obutaba na kisa kino kitukubirize okusuubira ebisingawo okuva eri Katonda. Tutunuulire buli muganda waffe atugezesa oba atunyiiza, ng'ekkubo lya Katonda ery'ekisa, ng'ekyuma kya Katonda eky'okutulongoosa, olw'okwenkanya obwetoowaze Yesu Obulamu bwaffe bw'assa munda mu ffe. Era tube n'okukkiriza mu Byonna ebya Katonda, n'obwereere obw'okwefaako, nti, nga tuli bwereere mu maaso gaffe, tusobole, mu maanyi ga Katonda, okunoonya kwokka okuweererezaganya mu kwagala.

fields.title: Obwetoowaze n'Obutukuvu
fields.body_html:
“Yimirira wo wekka, tonsemberera, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu nnyo okukusinga.” Isaya 65:5.

Twogera ku kuweereza kw'obutukuvu okw'omu biseera byaffe, era tutendereza Katonda olw'ekyo. Tuwulira ebingi ku abo abanoonya obutukuvu n'abo abayigiriza era abakuŋŋaana ku njigiriza z'obutukuvu. Amazima ag'omukisa ag'obutukuvu mu Kristo, n'obutukuvu obw'okukkiriza, ganyweezebwa nga bwe gataali gakoleddwa. Ekigezo ekikulu ku obanga obutukuvu bwe twogera nti tubufunye bwa mazima era bwa bulamu, kiriba nga bulaga mu bwetoowaze obweyongera bwe buleeta. Mu kitonde, obwetoowaze kye kimu ekyetaagisa okusobozesa obutukuvu bwa Katonda okubeera mu ye n'okwaka ng'ayita mu ye. Mu Yesu, Omutukuvu wa Katonda atufuula abatukuvu, obwetoowaze obw'obwakatonda bwe bwali ekyama ky'obulamu bwe, okufa kwe n'okugulumizibwa kwe; ekigezo ekitakyamya eky'obutukuvu bwaffe kiriba bwetoowaze bwe tulina mu maaso ga Katonda n'abantu obutuwa akabonero. Obwetoowaze bwe bumuli n'obulungi bw'obutukuvu.

Akabonero akasooka ak'obutukuvu obw'obulimba kwe kubulwa obwetoowaze. Buli anoonya obutukuvu kimusaanira okwekuuma, si kulwa nga awatali kumanya ekyatandikibwa mu mwoyo kimalirizibwa mu mubiri, era amalala ne gayingira mu kifo gye gatasuubirwa. Abasajja babiri baalinnya mu yeekaalu okusaba, omu Mufalisaayo n'omulala muwooza. Tewali kifo oba ekifo eky'omutindo ogutukuvu ennyo Omufalisaayo ky'atayinza kuyingira. Amalala gayinza okuyimusa omutwe gago mu yeekaalu ya Katonda yennyini, ne gafuula okusinza kwe ekifo eky'okwegulumiza kwago.

Okuva Kristo lwe yayoleka amalala ga Omufalisaayo, Omufalisaayo yeeyambazza ekyambalo ky'omuwooza, era n'oyo aatula ekibi kye ekingi, awamu n'oyo eyeeyogera ku butukuvu obusingira ddala, kibasaanira okuba abeekuumi. Mu kiseera kye tusinga okwegomba okuba n'emitima gyaffe mu yeekaalu ya Katonda, tujja kusanga abasajja abo ababiri nga balinnya okusaba. Era omuwooza ajja kuzuula nti akabi ke tekava mu Mufalisaayo ali okumpi naye amunyooma, wabula mu Mufalisaayo ali munda ye amusiima era amugulumiza.

Mu yeekaalu ya Katonda, bwe twerowooza nti tuli mu kifo ekitukuvu okusinga ebirala byonna, mu maaso g'obutukuvu bwe, twekuume amalala. “Awo olwatuuka ku lunaku olumu abaana ba Katonda ne bajja okulabika mu maaso ga Mukama, ne Setaani naye n'ajja mu bo.” Yobu 1:6 “Ai Katonda, nkwebaza kubanga siri nga abantu abalala, abanyazi, abatali batuukirivu, abenzi, oba nga omuwooza ono.” Lukka 18:11. Kiba mu ekyo ekisaanira okwebaza; kiba mu kwebaza kwennyini kwe tuwaayo eri Katonda. Kiyinza okuba mu kwatula kwennyini nti Katonda ye yakola byonna, omuntu mwe yeezuulira ensonga ey'okwematira. Weewaawo, ne bwe kiba mu yeekaalu, olulimi olw'okwenenya n'okwesiga okusaasira kwa Katonda kwokka lwe luwulirwa, Omufalisaayo ayinza okusitula eddoboozi ery'okutendereza, era mu kwebaza Katonda, ne yeenyumiriza.

Amalala gayinza okwambaza engoye ez'okutendereza oba ez'okwenenya. Newaakubadde ebigambo nti “Siri nga abantu abalala,” bigaanibwa era bivumirirwa, omwoyo gwabyo emirundi mingi guyinza okusangibwa mu nneewulira zaffe ne mu nnimi zaffe eri banne abasinza n'abantu bannaffe. Oyagala okumanya obanga kino kya mazima, wuliriza engeri Amakanisa n'Abakristaayo gye boogeramu ku bannaabwe. Nga wabaawo katono ku buwombeefu n'obukkakkamu bwa Yesu obulabika!

Kijjukirwa katono nnyo nti obwetoowaze obungi bwe busaanidde okuba omusingi gw'ebyo abaweereza ba Yesu bye boogera ku bo bennyini oba ku bannaabwe. Tewali Kkanisa nnyingi oba kkuŋŋaaniro ly'abatukuvu, butume bungi oba nkuŋŋaana, bibiina bingi oba bakiiko, ne butume bungi obuli ewala mu bannaggwanga, gye obumu bweyawukanye n'omulimu gwa Katonda ne gulemesebwa kubanga abantu ababalibwa ng'abatukuvu balaze mu bukalubo, mu bwangu, mu butagumiikiriza, mu kwewolereza, mu kweraga, mu kusala emisango egy'obukambwe n'ebigambo ebitaliimu kisa, nti buli omu teyabala banne okuba abasinga bo, era nti obutukuvu bwabwe bulimu katono ku buwombeefu bw'abatukuvu?

Mu byafaayo eby'omwoyo, abantu bayinza okuba nga baalina ebiseera eby'okwetoowaza okungi n'okumenyeka, naye kino kya njawulo ku kwambazibwa obwetoowaze, ku kuba n'omwoyo omuwombeefu, ku kuba n'obuwombeefu obw'omu birowoozo buli omu mwe yeebalira okuba omuweereza w'abalala, bw'atyo n'alaga endowooza eyo eyaali ne mu Kristo Yesu. “Tonsemberera, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu nnyo okukusinga.” Isaya 65:5. Nga bwe kunyooma obutukuvu! Yesu Omutukuvu ye Muwombeefu, asinga obutukuvu bulijjo y'asinga obwetoowaze. Tewali mutukuvu wabula Katonda; kyetuva tuba n'obutukuvu nga bwe tuba ne Katonda.

Obwetoowaze bwaffe obwa nnamaddala bwe bwo bwe tulina okuva eri Katonda, kubanga obwetoowaze si kirala wabula okubula kw'omuntu mu kulaba nti Katonda ye byonna. Asinga obutukuvu y'aliba asinga obwetoowaze. Zisanze! Newaakubadde Omuyudaaya eyeenyumiriza mu lwatu ow'omu nnaku za Isaya tatera kusangibwa, ne mpisa zaffe zituyigirizza obutayogera bwe tutyo, naye emirundi mingi omwoyo gwe gukyalabika, oba mu ngeri gye tuyisaamu banne abatukuvu oba abaana b'ensi.

Mu mwoyo ebirowoozo mwe biweebwa, omulimu mwe gukolebwa, n'ensobi mwe zyolekebwa, emirundi mingi, newaakubadde ekyambalo kiba kya muwooza, eddoboozi likyali lya Mufalisaayo. “Ai Katonda, nkwebaza kubanga siri nga abantu abalala.” Waliwo obwetoowaze obw'engeri eyo obuyinza okusangibwa, nti abantu ddala bakyeyisa okuba abasinga obutono ku batukuvu bonna, abaweereza ba bonna? Waliwo “okwagala tekukwatirwa buggya, tekwenyumiriza, tekwegulumiza” 1 Abakkolinso 13:4 omwoyo ogw'okwagala mwe guyiyibwa mu mutima, obuntu obw'obwakatonda mwe buzaalibwa okutuukiridde, Kristo Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda omuwombeefu era omukkakkamu mwe abumbibwa munda ddala.

Waliwo amaanyi g'okwagala okutuukiridde okwerabira era okuzuula omukisa gwako mu kuwa abalala omukisa, mu kubagumiikiriza n'okubawa ekitiibwa, ne bwe baba abanafu batya. Okwagala kuno gye kuyingira, Katonda gye ayingira. Era Katonda w'ayingidde mu maanyi ge n'yeeraga okuba byonna, ekitonde awo kifuuka atali kantu. Ekitonde we kifuukira atali kantu mu maaso ga Katonda, tekisobola kuba kirala wabula ekyetoowaza eri kitonde kinnaakyo. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda tekufuuka kya biseera na bbanga, wabula kye kibikka omwoyo kye gwabeeramu bulijjo, era okwetoowaza kwagwo okungi mu maaso ga Katonda kufuuka ekifo ekitukuvu eky'okubeerawo kwe ebigambo n'emirimu gyagwo gyonna mwe biva.

Katonda atuyigirize nti ebirowoozo byaffe, ebigambo byaffe, n'enneewulira zaffe ku bantu bannaffe kye kigezo kye eky'obwetoowaze bwaffe gy'ali, era nti obwetoowaze bwaffe mu maaso ge bwe maanyi gokka agayinza okutusobozesa okubeera abawombeefu bulijjo eri bantu bannaffe. Obwetoowaze bwaffe buteekwa okuba bwe bulamu bwa Kristo, Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, munda yaffe.

Abayigiriza b'obutukuvu bonna, oba baba mu kubuulira oba ku mwaliiro, n'abo bonna abanoonya obutukuvu, oba baba mu kasenge oba mu nkuŋŋaana, bafunire okulabulwa. Tewali malala ga kabi nnyo, kubanga tegaliiwo agakwekeka era ag'obukujjukujju, ng'amalala g'obutukuvu. Si kuba nti omuntu ayogera, oba n'okulowooza alowooza, nti “Tonsemberera, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu nnyo okukusinga.” Isaya 65:5. Nedda, mazima, ekirowoozo ekyo kyandiddwanga na nkyawa. Naye wabaawo, awatali kumanya, empisa ekwekeddwa ey'omwoyo, ematira olw'ebyo bye gutuuseeko, era eteyinza butalaba nga bwe gwavudde abalala mu maaso.

Guyinza okutegeerekeka, si bulijjo mu kweraga oba mu kwetendereza okwenjawulo, wabula mu kubulwa okwetoowaza okwo okungi okuteesobola butaba kabonero k'omwoyo ogulabye ekitiibwa kya Katonda (Yobu 42:5, 6; Isaya 6:5). Gweeraga, si mu bigambo oba mu birowoozo byokka wabula ne mu ddoboozi, mu ngeri gy'ayogeramu ku balala, abo abalina ekirabo eky'okwawula eby'omwoyo mwe batasobola butalaba maanyi g'omuntu. Ne ensi n'amaaso gaayo amakalu egiraba era n'egyoleka ng'obukakafu nti okwatula obulamu obw'omu ggulu tekubala bibala bya ggulu bya njawulo n'akatono.

Owooluganda! Twekuume. Wabula nga buli lwe tweyongera mu ekyo kye tulowooza nti bwe butukuvu, twongera n'okwekenneenya obwetoowaze, tuyinza okuzuula nti tubadde tusanyukira mu birowoozo n'enneewulira ennungi, mu bikolwa eby'okwewaayo n'okukkiriza eby'ekitiibwa, so nga akabonero kokka akakakafu ak'okubeerawo kwa Katonda, kwe kubula kw'omuntu, kabadde tekaliiwo ekiseera kyonna. Mujje tuddukire eri Yesu, era twekweke mu ye okutuusa lwe tunaambazibwa obwetoowaze bwe.

Ekyo kyokka bwe butukuvu bwaffe.

Mu byafaayo eby'omwoyo, abantu bayinza okuba nga baalina ebiseera eby'okwetoowaza okungi n'okumenyeka, naye kino kya njawulo ku kwambazibwa obwetoowaze, ku kuba n'omwoyo omuwombeefu, ku kuba n'obuwombeefu obw'omu birowoozo buli omu mwe yeebalira okuba omuweereza w'abalala, bw'atyo n'alaga endowooza eyo eyaali ne mu Kristo Yesu. “Tonsemberera, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu nnyo okukusinga.” Isaya 65:5. Nga bwe kunyooma obutukuvu! Yesu Omutukuvu ye Muwombeefu, asinga obutukuvu bulijjo y'asinga obwetoowaze. Tewali mutukuvu wabula Katonda; kyetuva tuba n'obutukuvu nga bwe tuba ne Katonda. Obwetoowaze bwaffe obwa nnamaddala bwe bwo bwe tulina okuva eri Katonda, kubanga obwetoowaze si kirala wabula okubula kw'omuntu mu kulaba nti Katonda ye byonna. Asinga obutukuvu y'aliba asinga obwetoowaze. Zisanze! Newaakubadde Omuyudaaya eyeenyumiriza mu lwatu ow'omu nnaku za Isaya tatera kusangibwa, ne mpisa zaffe zituyigirizza obutayogera bwe tutyo, naye emirundi mingi omwoyo gwe gukyalabika, oba mu ngeri gye tuyisaamu banne abatukuvu oba abaana b'ensi. Mu mwoyo ebirowoozo mwe biweebwa, omulimu mwe gukolebwa, n'ensobi mwe zyolekebwa, emirundi mingi, newaakubadde ekyambalo kiba kya muwooza, eddoboozi likyali lya Mufalisaayo. “Ai Katonda, nkwebaza kubanga siri nga abantu abalala.” Waliwo obwetoowaze obw'engeri eyo obuyinza okusangibwa, nti abantu ddala bakyeyisa okuba abasinga obutono ku batukuvu bonna, abaweereza ba bonna? Waliwo “okwagala tekukwatirwa buggya, tekwenyumiriza, tekwegulumiza” 1 Abakkolinso 13:4 omwoyo ogw'okwagala mwe guyiyibwa mu mutima, obuntu obw'obwakatonda mwe buzaalibwa okutuukiridde, Kristo Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda omuwombeefu era omukkakkamu mwe abumbibwa munda ddala. Waliwo amaanyi g'okwagala okutuukiridde okwerabira era okuzuula omukisa gwako mu kuwa abalala omukisa, mu kubagumiikiriza n'okubawa ekitiibwa, ne bwe baba abanafu batya. Okwagala kuno gye kuyingira, Katonda gye ayingira. Era Katonda w'ayingidde mu maanyi ge n'yeeraga okuba byonna, ekitonde awo kifuuka atali kantu. Ekitonde we kifuukira atali kantu mu maaso ga Katonda, tekisobola kuba kirala wabula ekyetoowaza eri kitonde kinnaakyo. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda tekufuuka kya biseera na bbanga, wabula kye kibikka omwoyo kye gwabeeramu bulijjo, era okwetoowaza kwagwo okungi mu maaso ga Katonda kufuuka ekifo ekitukuvu eky'okubeerawo kwe ebigambo n'emirimu gyagwo gyonna mwe biva. Katonda atuyigirize nti ebirowoozo byaffe, ebigambo byaffe, n'enneewulira zaffe ku bantu bannaffe kye kigezo kye eky'obwetoowaze bwaffe gy'ali, era nti obwetoowaze bwaffe mu maaso ge bwe maanyi gokka agayinza okutusobozesa okubeera abawombeefu bulijjo eri bantu bannaffe. Obwetoowaze bwaffe buteekwa okuba bwe bulamu bwa Kristo, Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, munda yaffe. Abayigiriza b'obutukuvu bonna, oba baba mu kubuulira oba ku mwaliiro, n'abo bonna abanoonya obutukuvu, oba baba mu kasenge oba mu nkuŋŋaana, bafunire okulabulwa. Tewali malala ga kabi nnyo, kubanga tegaliiwo agakwekeka era ag'obukujjukujju, ng'amalala g'obutukuvu. Si kuba nti omuntu ayogera, oba n'okulowooza alowooza, nti “Tonsemberera, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu nnyo okukusinga.” Isaya 65:5. Nedda, mazima, ekirowoozo ekyo kyandiddwanga na nkyawa. Naye wabaawo, awatali kumanya, empisa ekwekeddwa ey'omwoyo, ematira olw'ebyo bye gutuuseeko, era eteyinza butalaba nga bwe gwavudde abalala mu maaso. Guyinza okutegeerekeka, si bulijjo mu kweraga oba mu kwetendereza okwenjawulo, wabula mu kubulwa okwetoowaza okwo okungi okuteesobola butaba kabonero k'omwoyo ogulabye ekitiibwa kya Katonda (Yobu 42:5, 6; Isaya 6:5). Gweeraga, si mu bigambo oba mu birowoozo byokka wabula ne mu ddoboozi, mu ngeri gy'ayogeramu ku balala, abo abalina ekirabo eky'okwawula eby'omwoyo mwe batasobola butalaba maanyi g'omuntu. Ne ensi n'amaaso gaayo amakalu egiraba era n'egyoleka ng'obukakafu nti okwatula obulamu obw'omu ggulu tekubala bibala bya ggulu bya njawulo n'akatono. Owooluganda! Twekuume. Wabula nga buli lwe tweyongera mu ekyo kye tulowooza nti bwe butukuvu, twongera n'okwekenneenya obwetoowaze, tuyinza okuzuula nti tubadde tusanyukira mu birowoozo n'enneewulira ennungi, mu bikolwa eby'okwewaayo n'okukkiriza eby'ekitiibwa, so nga akabonero kokka akakakafu ak'okubeerawo kwa Katonda, kwe kubula kw'omuntu, kabadde tekaliiwo ekiseera kyonna. Mujje tuddukire eri Yesu, era twekweke mu ye okutuusa lwe tunaambazibwa obwetoowaze bwe. Ekyo kyokka bwe butukuvu bwaffe.

fields.title: Obuwombeefu N'Ekibi
fields.body_html:
"Aboonoonyi, be nsinga bonna." 1 Timoseewo 1:15. Obuwombeefu butera okugeraageranyizibwa n'okwenenya n'okunakuwala olw'ebibi. Olw'ekyo, kirabika nga tewali kkubo lya kukuza buwombeefu okuggyako okusigaza emmeeme ng'efaayo ku kibi kyayo. Naye tuyize nti obuwombeefu kintu kya maanyi okusinga ekyo. Tulabye mu kuyigiriza kwa Mukama waffe Yesu ne mu bbaluwa engeri empisa eno gy'eyigirizibwamu emirundi mingi awatali kwogera ku kibi n'akatono. Mu ntobo y'ebintu byennyini, mu nkolagana yonna ey'ekitonde n'Omutonzi waakyo, mu bulamu bwa Yesu nga bwe yabutuula era bw'atuwa, obuwombeefu bwe ntobo yennyini ey'obutukuvu n'omukisa. Kwe kuggyawo omuntu ne wateekebwawo Katonda ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka, Katonda n'abeera byonna, ate omuntu ye n'ataba kantu.

Luno lwe luuyi lw'amazima lwe nkakasa nti kyetaagisa ennyo okulunyweza — obuwanvu n'obungi obuggya obw'ekibi ky'omuntu n'ekisa kya Katonda, ebireetera abatukuvu okwewombeeka. Twetaaga bwetaazi okutunuulira omuntu ng'Omutume Pawulo, tulyoke tulabe engeri, mu bulamu bwe bwonna ng'omuntu eyanunulibwa era omutukuvu, okutegeera okw'amaanyi nti yali muyonoonyi gye kwabeereranga obutazikira. Ffenna tumanyi ebifo mw'ayogerera ku bulamu bwe obw'edda ng'omuyiganya era omuvvoozi.

"Nze nsinga obuto ku batume, so sisaanira kuyitibwa mutume, kubanga nayigganya ekkanisa ya Katonda… nafuba okusinga bonna, kyokka si nze, wabula ekisa kya Katonda ekiri nange." (1 Abakkolinso 15:9, 10). "Nze, newankubadde nsinga obuto ku batukuvu bonna, ekisa kino kyampeebwa, okubuulira Abamawanga obugagga bwa Kristo obutanoonyezeka" (Abaefeso 3:8). "Newankubadde edda nnali muvvoozi, era muyiganya, era mujoozi. Naye nasaasirwa kubanga nakikola mu butamanya awamu n'obutakkiriza… Kristo Yesu yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi; be nsinga bonna." (1 Timoseewo 1:13, 15). Ekisa kya Katonda kyali kimulokodde.

Katonda teyaddayo kujjukira bibi bye emirembe gyonna, naye ye teyasobola kwerabira nga bwe yali ayonoonye nnyo mu ngeri ey'entiisa.

Gye yeeyongera okusanyukira obulokozi bwa Katonda, era nga bwe yeeyongera okuweebwa okumanya okw'ekisa kya Katonda okwamujjuza essanyu eritayogerekeka, bwe kutyo kwe kweyongera okutegeera nti yali muyonoonyi eyalokolebwa, era nti obulokozi tebwalina makulu wadde obuwoomu okuggyako ng'okutegeera nti yali muyonoonyi kwe kwakifuula ekyagulwa era eky'amazima gy'ali. Tekyasoboka wadde akaseera katono okwerabira nti yali muyonoonyi Katonda gwe yasitula mu mikono gye n'amutikkira engule ey'okwagala kwe.

Ebyawandiikibwa bye twakayogerako biteregerwako emirundi mingi ng'okwatula kwa Pawulo okw'okwonoona kwa buli lunaku. Naye kyetaaga busa okubisoma n'obwegendereza mu nkolagana yaabyo, olyoke olabe nga ekyo si bwe kiri n'akatono. Birina amakulu amawanvu ennyo okusinga; boogera ku kiwangaala okuyita mu bulamu obutaggwaawo, ekyo ekiriwa eddoboozi lyabyo ery'okwewuunya n'okusinza mu buwombeefu abanunule mwe bavuunamira entebe ey'obwakabaka, ng'abo abanaazibwa ebibi byabwe mu musaayi gw'Omwana gw'Endiga. Tebasobola, wadde mu kitiibwa, kuba kintu kirala okuggyako aboonoonyi abaanunulibwa. Tekisoboka wadde akaseera katono mu bulamu buno omwana wa Katonda okubeera mu kitangaala kyonna eky'okwagala kwe, okuggyako ng'awulira nti ekibi, kye yalokolebwako, kye kyokka eddembe lye era erinnya lye eri byonna ekisa bye kyasuubiza okukola.

Obuwombeefu bwe yajja nabwo olubereberye ng'omuyonoonyi, bufuna amakulu amaggya bwe ategeera nga bwe bumusaanira ng'ekitonde. Ate era, obuwombeefu bwe yazaalibwa nabwo ng'ekitonde, bulina eddoboozi lyabwo eritasingika mu kwewuunya, mu kujjukira kye kiki okuba akajjukizo ak'okwagala kwa Katonda okununula okw'ekitalo. Amakulu amatuufu ag'ebyo byonna Pawulo Omutukuvu by'atuyigiriza gajja mu maanyi bwe tulaba ekintu eky'okwewuunya nti, mu lugendo lwe lwonna olw'Ekikristaayo, tetusangamu wadde lumu okuva mu kkalaamu ye, ne mu bbaluwa mwe tusangamu okwatula okw'omuntu ku bubwe okusingayo, ekintu kyonna ekifaanana ng'okwatula ekibi. Tewali wadde awamu awayogerwako okulemwa oba obulema, tewali kubuulira basomi be nti yaddiŋŋana mu buvunaanyizibwa, oba nti yayonoona eri etteeka ery'okwagala okutuukiridde.

Ekyekuusa, waliwo ebifo, si bitono, mw'eyewolereza mu bigambo ebitaba na makulu bwe bitaba nga byesigamye ku bulamu obutaliiko kamogo mu maaso ga Katonda n'abantu. "Muli bajulirwa, era ne Katonda, engeri gye twali abatukuvu, era abatuukirivu, era abatalina kamogo gye muli mmwe abakkiriza." (1 Abasessaloniika 2:10). "Kubanga okwenyumiriza kwaffe kwe kuno, obujulirwa bw'emmeeme yaffe, nga twetwala mu nsi mu bwesimbu n'amazima aga Katonda, si mu magezi ag'ensi wabula mu kisa kya Katonda, na nnyo bwe tutyo gye muli." (2 Abakkolinso 1:12).

Kino si kiruubirirwa wadde kwegomba, kwe kweyanjula ku ekyo bulamu bwe kye bwali mu butuufu. Newankubadde nga tuyinza tutya okunnyonnyola obutabaawo kw'okwatula ekibi, bonna balikkiriza nti kiteekwa okulaga obulamu obuli mu maanyi ag'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, obutafunibwa oba obutasuubirwa mu nnaku zino. Njagala okunyweza nti obutabaawo kw'okwatula ng'okwo okwonoona kwongera busa amaanyi ku mazima nti si mu kwonoona kwa buli lunaku mwe muli ekyama ky'obuwombeefu obwa wansi ennyo, wabula mu kifo eky'empisa ekitasaanira kwerabirwako wadde akaseera katono, ekyo ekisa ekisukkiridde kye kinaakuumanga nga kiramu bulungi, nti ekifo kyaffe kyokka, ekifo eky'omukisa kyokka, embeera yaffe etaggwaawo mu maaso ga Katonda, ky'ekiteekwa okuba ekya balya essanyu lyabwe erisinga kwe kwatula nti be boonoonyi abaalokolebwa olw'ekisa.

Awamu n'okujjukira kwa Pawulo okw'amaanyi nti yali ayonoonye nnyo mu ngeri ey'entiisa mu biseera eby'edda, ekisa nga tekinnamusanga, n'okutegeera nti yakuumibwa obutayonoona mu kaseera k'akaakano, byagattibwako bulijjo n'okujjukira okutaggwaawo okw'amaanyi ag'ekizikiza agakwese ag'ekibi agaali beetegefu bulijjo okuyingira, era agaaziyizibwa kwokka olw'okubeerawo n'amaanyi ga Kristo abeera munda.

"Kubanga mmanyi nga mu nze, kwe kugamba mu mubiri gwange, temubeeramu kirungi;" — ebigambo bino ebya Abaruumi 7:18 binnyonnyola omubiri nga bwe guli okutuusa ku nkomerero. Okununulibwa okw'ekitiibwa okw'omu Abaruumi 8:2 "Kubanga etteeka ery'Omwoyo ogw'obulamu mu Kristo Yesu lyanfuula wa ddembe okuva mu tteeka ery'ekibi n'okufa" si kuzikiriza wadde kutukuza mubiri, wabula buwanguzi obw'olubeerera Omwoyo bw'awa bw'atta ebikolwa by'omubiri. Ng'obulamu obulungi bwe bugoba obulwadde, ekitangaala bwe kimira ekizikiza, era obulamu bwe buwangula okufa, okubeera kwa Kristo munda ng'ayita mu Mwoyo kwe bulamu obulungi, ekitangaala, n'obulamu bw'emmeeme.

Awamu n'ekyo, okukakasa okw'obunafu n'akabi kutereeza bulijjo okukkiriza mu mulimu ogutaggwaawo ogw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne kufuuka okutegeera okw'obwetoowaze nti twesigamye ku Katonda, okufuula okukkiriza n'essanyu ebisingira ddala okuba abaweereza b'obuwombeefu obulamu obw'ekisa kya Katonda kyokka. Ebyawandiikibwa ebisatu ebyawuliddwako waggulu byonna biraga nti kye kyali ekisa eky'ekyewuunyo ekyaweebwa Pawulo, kye yawulira nga kimwetaagisa buli kaseera, ekyamuwombeeza nnyo bwe kityo. Ekisa kya Katonda ekyali naye, ne kimusobozesa okukola okusinga bonna, ekisa okubuulira Abamawanga obugagga bwa Kristo obutanoonyezeka, ekisa ekyasukkirira ennyo n'okukkiriza n'okwagala okuli mu Kristo Yesu — gwe kisa ekyo, eky'obuzaaliranwa n'ekitiibwa nti kya boonoonyi, ekyo kye kyakuuma okutegeera nti yali ayonoonye era nga ayinza okwonoona nga kuli bulamu bulungi ennyo.

"Ekibi we kyeyongera, ekisa kyasukkirira nnyo okukira" Abaruumi 5:20. Kino kibikkula engeri ntobo y'ekisa gye kuli okukola ku kibi n'okukiggyawo, era nga kiteekwa okuba okumanya okw'ekisa okweyongera n'okutegeera nti oli muyonoonyi. Si kibi, wabula ekisa kya Katonda ekiraga omuntu era ekimujjukiza bulijjo nti yali muyonoonyi ki, kye kimukuuma nga muwombeefu ddala. Si kibi, wabula ekisa, kye kirinfuula okwemanyira ddala nti ndi muyonoonyi, era ne kifuula ekifo ky'omuyonoonyi eky'okwetoowaza okw'ewala ennyo ekifo kye sivaamu.

Ntya nti waliwo abantu si batono, abaagezaako okwewombeeka nga bakozesa ebigambo eby'amaanyi eby'okwesalira omusango n'okwevumirira, kyokka ne kibagwanira okwatula n'ennaku nti omwoyo ogw'obuwombeefu, "omutima ogw'obuwombeefu," awamu n'ebigenderako eby'ekisa n'okusaasira, obuteefu n'obugumiikiriza, gukyali wala nnyo nga bulijjo. Okumalibwamu wewennyini, wadde nga wakati mu kwekyawa okusingira ddala, tekuyinza kutuggya mu ffe. Kwe kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda, si mu tteeka lyokka eriveerera ekibi omusango naye mu kisa kye ekituula omuntu okuva mu kibi, kwe kunaatuwombeeza.

Etteeka liyinza okumenya omutima n'okutya, naye kisa kyokka ekikola n'obuwombeefu obuwoomerera obufuuka essanyu eri emmeeme ng'obuzaaliranwa bwayo obw'okubiri. Kwe kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda mu butukuvu bwe, ng'asemberera okwemanyisa mu kisa kye, kwe kwawombeeza Ibulayimu ne Yakobo, Yobu ne Isaya ne bavuunama wansi ennyo. Emmeeme omuli Katonda Omutonzi, ng'abeera Byonna eby'ekitonde mu bwereere bwakyo, ne Katonda Omununuzi mu kisa kye, ng'abeera Byonna eby'omuyonoonyi mu bwonoonyi bwe, gye alindiriddwa era gy'eyesigibwa era gy'asinzibwa, y'eneesangibwa ng'ejjudde okubeerawo kwe, ne watabaawo kifo ky'okwefaako yekka.

Bwe kityo kyokka ekisuubizo kwe kiyinza okutuukirira: "N'amalala g'omuntu galikkakkanyizibwa, n'okwegulumiza kw'abantu kulissibwa wansi, era Mukama yekka y'aligulumizibwa ku lunaku olwo." Isaya 2:17.

Muyonoonyi abeera mu kitangaala kyonna eky'okwagala kwa Katonda okutukuvu era okununula, mu kufuna okubeeramu okwo okujjuvu okw'okwagala kwa Katonda okujja ng'ayita mu Kristo n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, y'atasobola butaba muwombeefu. Obutamalibwamu kibi kyo, wabula okumalibwamu Katonda, kwe kuleeta okununulibwa okuva mu kwefaako wekka.

Tekisoboka wadde akaseera katono mu bulamu buno omwana wa Katonda okubeera mu kitangaala kyonna eky'okwagala kwe, okuggyako ng'awulira nti ekibi, kye yalokolebwako, kye kyokka eddembe lye era erinnya lye eri byonna ekisa bye kyasuubiza okukola. Obuwombeefu bwe yajja nabwo olubereberye ng'omuyonoonyi, bufuna amakulu amaggya bwe ategeera nga bwe bumusaanira ng'ekitonde. Ate era, obuwombeefu bwe yazaalibwa nabwo ng'ekitonde, bulina eddoboozi lyabwo eritasingika mu kwewuunya, mu kujjukira kye kiki okuba akajjukizo ak'okwagala kwa Katonda okununula okw'ekitalo. Amakulu amatuufu ag'ebyo byonna Pawulo Omutukuvu by'atuyigiriza gajja mu maanyi bwe tulaba ekintu eky'okwewuunya nti, mu lugendo lwe lwonna olw'Ekikristaayo, tetusangamu wadde lumu okuva mu kkalaamu ye, ne mu bbaluwa mwe tusangamu okwatula okw'omuntu ku bubwe okusingayo, ekintu kyonna ekifaanana ng'okwatula ekibi. Tewali wadde awamu awayogerwako okulemwa oba obulema, tewali kubuulira basomi be nti yaddiŋŋana mu buvunaanyizibwa, oba nti yayonoona eri etteeka ery'okwagala okutuukiridde. Ekyekuusa, waliwo ebifo, si bitono, mw'eyewolereza mu bigambo ebitaba na makulu bwe bitaba nga byesigamye ku bulamu obutaliiko kamogo mu maaso ga Katonda n'abantu. "Muli bajulirwa, era ne Katonda, engeri gye twali abatukuvu, era abatuukirivu, era abatalina kamogo gye muli mmwe abakkiriza." (1 Abasessaloniika 2:10). "Kubanga okwenyumiriza kwaffe kwe kuno, obujulirwa bw'emmeeme yaffe, nga twetwala mu nsi mu bwesimbu n'amazima aga Katonda, si mu magezi ag'ensi wabula mu kisa kya Katonda, na nnyo bwe tutyo gye muli." (2 Abakkolinso 1:12). Kino si kiruubirirwa wadde kwegomba, kwe kweyanjula ku ekyo bulamu bwe kye bwali mu butuufu. Newankubadde nga tuyinza tutya okunnyonnyola obutabaawo kw'okwatula ekibi, bonna balikkiriza nti kiteekwa okulaga obulamu obuli mu maanyi ag'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, obutafunibwa oba obutasuubirwa mu nnaku zino. Njagala okunyweza nti obutabaawo kw'okwatula ng'okwo okwonoona kwongera busa amaanyi ku mazima nti si mu kwonoona kwa buli lunaku mwe muli ekyama ky'obuwombeefu obwa wansi ennyo, wabula mu kifo eky'empisa ekitasaanira kwerabirwako wadde akaseera katono, ekyo ekisa ekisukkiridde kye kinaakuumanga nga kiramu bulungi, nti ekifo kyaffe kyokka, ekifo eky'omukisa kyokka, embeera yaffe etaggwaawo mu maaso ga Katonda, ky'ekiteekwa okuba ekya balya essanyu lyabwe erisinga kwe kwatula nti be boonoonyi abaalokolebwa olw'ekisa. Awamu n'okujjukira kwa Pawulo okw'amaanyi nti yali ayonoonye nnyo mu ngeri ey'entiisa mu biseera eby'edda, ekisa nga tekinnamusanga, n'okutegeera nti yakuumibwa obutayonoona mu kaseera k'akaakano, byagattibwako bulijjo n'okujjukira okutaggwaawo okw'amaanyi ag'ekizikiza agakwese ag'ekibi agaali beetegefu bulijjo okuyingira, era agaaziyizibwa kwokka olw'okubeerawo n'amaanyi ga Kristo abeera munda. "Kubanga mmanyi nga mu nze, kwe kugamba mu mubiri gwange, temubeeramu kirungi;" — ebigambo bino ebya Abaruumi 7:18 binnyonnyola omubiri nga bwe guli okutuusa ku nkomerero. Okununulibwa okw'ekitiibwa okw'omu Abaruumi 8:2 "Kubanga etteeka ery'Omwoyo ogw'obulamu mu Kristo Yesu lyanfuula wa ddembe okuva mu tteeka ery'ekibi n'okufa" si kuzikiriza wadde kutukuza mubiri, wabula buwanguzi obw'olubeerera Omwoyo bw'awa bw'atta ebikolwa by'omubiri. Ng'obulamu obulungi bwe bugoba obulwadde, ekitangaala bwe kimira ekizikiza, era obulamu bwe buwangula okufa, okubeera kwa Kristo munda ng'ayita mu Mwoyo kwe bulamu obulungi, ekitangaala, n'obulamu bw'emmeeme. Awamu n'ekyo, okukakasa okw'obunafu n'akabi kutereeza bulijjo okukkiriza mu mulimu ogutaggwaawo ogw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne kufuuka okutegeera okw'obwetoowaze nti twesigamye ku Katonda, okufuula okukkiriza n'essanyu ebisingira ddala okuba abaweereza b'obuwombeefu obulamu obw'ekisa kya Katonda kyokka. Ebyawandiikibwa ebisatu ebyawuliddwako waggulu byonna biraga nti kye kyali ekisa eky'ekyewuunyo ekyaweebwa Pawulo, kye yawulira nga kimwetaagisa buli kaseera, ekyamuwombeeza nnyo bwe kityo. Ekisa kya Katonda ekyali naye, ne kimusobozesa okukola okusinga bonna, ekisa okubuulira Abamawanga obugagga bwa Kristo obutanoonyezeka, ekisa ekyasukkirira ennyo n'okukkiriza n'okwagala okuli mu Kristo Yesu — gwe kisa ekyo, eky'obuzaaliranwa n'ekitiibwa nti kya boonoonyi, ekyo kye kyakuuma okutegeera nti yali ayonoonye era nga ayinza okwonoona nga kuli bulamu bulungi ennyo. "Ekibi we kyeyongera, ekisa kyasukkirira nnyo okukira" Abaruumi 5:20. Kino kibikkula engeri ntobo y'ekisa gye kuli okukola ku kibi n'okukiggyawo, era nga kiteekwa okuba okumanya okw'ekisa okweyongera n'okutegeera nti oli muyonoonyi. Si kibi, wabula ekisa kya Katonda ekiraga omuntu era ekimujjukiza bulijjo nti yali muyonoonyi ki, kye kimukuuma nga muwombeefu ddala. Si kibi, wabula ekisa, kye kirinfuula okwemanyira ddala nti ndi muyonoonyi, era ne kifuula ekifo ky'omuyonoonyi eky'okwetoowaza okw'ewala ennyo ekifo kye sivaamu. Ntya nti waliwo abantu si batono, abaagezaako okwewombeeka nga bakozesa ebigambo eby'amaanyi eby'okwesalira omusango n'okwevumirira, kyokka ne kibagwanira okwatula n'ennaku nti omwoyo ogw'obuwombeefu, "omutima ogw'obuwombeefu," awamu n'ebigenderako eby'ekisa n'okusaasira, obuteefu n'obugumiikiriza, gukyali wala nnyo nga bulijjo. Okumalibwamu wewennyini, wadde nga wakati mu kwekyawa okusingira ddala, tekuyinza kutuggya mu ffe. Kwe kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda, si mu tteeka lyokka eriveerera ekibi omusango naye mu kisa kye ekituula omuntu okuva mu kibi, kwe kunaatuwombeeza. Etteeka liyinza okumenya omutima n'okutya, naye kisa kyokka ekikola n'obuwombeefu obuwoomerera obufuuka essanyu eri emmeeme ng'obuzaaliranwa bwayo obw'okubiri. Kwe kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda mu butukuvu bwe, ng'asemberera okwemanyisa mu kisa kye, kwe kwawombeeza Ibulayimu ne Yakobo, Yobu ne Isaya ne bavuunama wansi ennyo. Emmeeme omuli Katonda Omutonzi, ng'abeera Byonna eby'ekitonde mu bwereere bwakyo, ne Katonda Omununuzi mu kisa kye, ng'abeera Byonna eby'omuyonoonyi mu bwonoonyi bwe, gye alindiriddwa era gy'eyesigibwa era gy'asinzibwa, y'eneesangibwa ng'ejjudde okubeerawo kwe, ne watabaawo kifo ky'okwefaako yekka. Bwe kityo kyokka ekisuubizo kwe kiyinza okutuukirira: "N'amalala g'omuntu galikkakkanyizibwa, n'okwegulumiza kw'abantu kulissibwa wansi, era Mukama yekka y'aligulumizibwa ku lunaku olwo." Isaya 2:17. Muyonoonyi abeera mu kitangaala kyonna eky'okwagala kwa Katonda okutukuvu era okununula, mu kufuna okubeeramu okwo okujjuvu okw'okwagala kwa Katonda okujja ng'ayita mu Kristo n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, y'atasobola butaba muwombeefu. Obutamalibwamu kibi kyo, wabula okumalibwamu Katonda, kwe kuleeta okununulibwa okuva mu kwefaako wekka.

fields.title: Okwetoowaza n'Okukkiriza
fields.body_html:
"Muyinza mutya okukkiriza, nga mufuna ekitiibwa okuva eri bannammwe, so nga temunoonya kitiibwa ekiva eri Katonda yekka?" Yokaana 5:44.

Mu mboozi gye nnaawulira mu biseera bino, omwogezi yagamba nti emikisa gy'obulamu bw'Ekikristaayo obwa waggulu emirundi mingi giringa ebintu ebyanjululwa mu ddirisa ly'eddwaliro, omuntu ayinza okubiraba bulungi naye n'atasobola kubituusaako mukono. Bwe yandigambiddwa okugolola omukono gwe n'aggyako, omuntu yandiddemu nti, Sisobola. Waliwo oluuni olw'endabirwamu oluwanvu wakati wange na byo. Ne bwe kiba kityo, Abakristaayo bayinza okulaba bulungi ebisuubizo ebya mukisa eby'emirembe n'okuwummula okutuukiridde, eby'okwagala n'essanyu ebiyiika, eby'obumu obunywevu n'okubala ebibala, naye ne bawulira nti waliwo ekintu wakati ekiziyiza okubifuna okw'amazima. Ebisuubizo ebyaweebwa okukkiriza bya buwa era bya bwesige nnyo, okuyita n'okugumya kwa maanyi nnyo, n'amaanyi ga Katonda amangi ge kuyinza okwesigama gali kumpi era ga buwa. Noolwekyo, amalala ge gokka ekiziyiza okukkiriza n'omukisa okuba obwaffe.

Mu kyawandiikibwa, Yesu atubikkulira nti mazima ddala amalala ge gafuula okukkiriza okutasoboka. Yokaana 5:44 agamba nti: "Muyinza mutya okukkiriza, nga mufuna ekitiibwa okuva eri bannammwe" Nga bwe tulaba engeri amalala n'okukkiriza gye bikontanamu mu butonde bwabyo awatali kutabaganya, tujja kuyiga nti okukkiriza n'okwetoowaza birina omulandira gwe gumu era nti tetuyinza kubeera na kukkiriza kwa mazima okusinga okwetoowaza okw'amazima kwe tulina. Tujja kulaba nti tuyinza mazima okuba n'okukakasibwa okw'amagezi okw'amaanyi n'obwesige mu mazima ate ng'amalala gasigadde mu mutima, naye kufuula okukkiriza okulamu, okulina amaanyi eri Katonda, okutasoboka.

Twetaaga bwetaazi okulowooza akaseera katono ku kye kukkiriza. Si kwe kwatula obutabaawo bwaffe n'obutayinza kwekolera, okwewaayo n'okulindirira okuleka Katonda akole? Si kyo kyennyini ekintu ekisinga okwetoowaza ekiyinza okubaawo, okukkiriza ekifo kyaffe ng'abeetaaga, abatayinza kwewaanira wadde okufuna wadde okukola kintu kyonna okuggyako ekyo ekisa kye kigaba? Okwetoowaza y'engeri etegeka emmeeme okubeeranga ku bwesige. N'akassa k'amalala akasinga okukwekebwa, mu kwenoonyeza, mu kwewagira, mu kwekakasa, oba mu kwegulumiza, kwongera bwongezi amaanyi eri obwo buntu obutayinza kuyingira wadde okufuna ebintu eby'obwakabaka, kubanga bugaana Katonda okuba nga bw'ali era nga bw'ateekwa okuba, ye Byonna mu byonna. Okukkiriza kye kitundu oba amagezi ag'okutegeera n'okukwata ensi ey'omu ggulu n'emikisa gyayo. Okukkiriza kunoonya ekitiibwa ekiva eri Katonda, era kijja kwokka awo Katonda w'ali byonna.

Ekiseera kyonna gye tuba tufuna ekitiibwa okuva eri bannaffe, nga tunoonya, twagala, era nga tukuuma n'obuggya ekitiibwa eky'obulamu buno, ekitiibwa n'erinnya eddungi ebiva eri abantu, tetunoonya, era tetuyinza kufuna kitiibwa ekiva eri Katonda. Amalala gafuula okukkiriza okutasoboka. Obulokozi bujja okuyita mu musaalaba ne Kristo eyakomererwa. Obulokozi kwe kussekimu ne Kristo eyakomererwa mu Mwoyo ogw'omusaalaba gwe. Obulokozi kwe kwegatta ne Katonda n'okusanyukira mu ye; obulokozi kwe kwenyigira mu kwetoowaza kwa Yesu. Kyewuunyisa nti okukkiriza kwaffe kunafu bwe kutyo ng'amalala gakyafuga nnyo bwe kityo, ate nga tetunnaba na kuyiga wadde okusaba okwetoowaza ng'ekitundu ekisinga obwetaavu era eky'omukisa eky'obulokozi?

Okwetoowaza n'okukkiriza mu Byawandiikibwa bikwatagana nnyo okusinga bangi bwe bamanyi. Kiraba mu bulamu bwa Kristo. Waliwo ebifo bibiri mw'ayogera ku kukkiriza okunene. Omuserikale omukulu, gwe yeewuunya olw'okukkiriza kwe, ng'agamba nti, "Mbagamba nti, siisanga kukkiriza kunene bwe kutyo mu Isiraeri wonna." teyagamba nti, "Mukama wange, sisaanira ggwe okuyingira wansi w'akasolya kange"? Ne maama oyo gwe yagamba nti, "Ggwe omukazi, okukkiriza kwo kunene!" (Matayo 15:28) teyakkiriza erinnya ly'embwa n'agamba nti, "Weewaawo, Mukama wange, naye n'embwa zirya ku bukunkumuka'? (Matayo 15:27) Kwe kwetoowaza okuleeta emmeeme okuba obutaliiko eri Katonda, era kwe kuggyawo buli kiziyiza eri okukkiriza n'akufuula okutya kyokka nti kaleme okumuswaza olw'obutamwesiga kimu kyonna.

Owooluganda, wano si we tulaba ensonga y'okulemererwa mu kunoonya obutukuvu? Si kino, wadde nga tetwakimanya, ekyafuula okwewonga kwaffe n'okukkiriza kwaffe okubeera okwokungulu era okw'ekiseera kitono? Tetwalina kirowoozo ku ngeri amalala n'obuntu bwaffe gye byakyakoleramu munda yaffe mu kyama, ne ku ngeri Katonda yekka, olw'okuyingira kwe n'amaanyi ge amangi, gy'ayinza okubigobamu. Tetwategeera engeri obuntu obuggya era obwa Katonda, nga butwala ekifo ky'obuntu obukadde bwonna, gye buyinza okutufuula abeetoowaza ddala.

Tetwamanya nti okwetoowaza okutuukiridde, okutakoma, era okwa buli wantu kwe kuteekwa okuba engeri ey'omulandira eya buli kusaba na buli kusemberera Katonda awamu na buli kukwatagana n'omuntu; era nti twandifaananye ng'agezaako okulaba awatali maaso, oba okuba omulamu awatali kussa, bwe tuba tugezaako okukkiriza oba okusemberera Katonda oba okubeera mu kwagala kwe, awatali kwetoowaza n'obuwombeefu bw'omutima obubunye wonna.

Owooluganda, tetubadde tukola nsobi nga tweraliikirira nnyo okukkiriza, ate ng'ekiseera kyonna waliwo obuntu obukadde mu malala gaabwo nga bunoonya okwefunira omukisa n'obugagga bwa Katonda? Si kya kwewuunya nga twalemwa okukukkiriza. Ka tukyuse ekkubo lyaffe. Ka tunoonye okusooka okwetoowaza wansi w'omukono gwa Katonda ogw'amaanyi: anaatugulumiza. Omusaalaba, okufa, n'entaana, Yesu mwe yeetoowaza, bye byali ekkubo lye eridda mu kitiibwa kya Katonda.

Okwegomba kwaffe kumu n'okusaba kwaffe okw'amaanyi kubeere kuno, okwetoowazibwa awamu naye era nga ye; ka tukkirize n'essanyu kyonna ekiyinza okututoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda oba abantu; kino kyokka lye kkubo eridda mu kitiibwa kya Katonda. Oboolyawo owulira okwagala okubuuza ekibuuzo. Njogedde ku abamu abalina ebyafaayo eby'omukisa, oba ababa nga bo be bavunaanyizibwako okuleetera abalala omukisa, naye nga bakendeddwa okwetoowaza. Obuuza obanga bano tebakakasa nti balina okukkiriza okw'amazima, wadde okw'amaanyi, wadde nga boolesa bulungi nnyo nti bakyanoonya nnyo ekitiibwa ekiva eri abantu. Waliwo eky'okuddamu ekisinga kimu ekiyinza okuweebwa.

Naye eky'okuddamu ekikulu mu nsonga yaffe eno kye kino: mazima balina ekigero ky'okukkiriza, era ng'omukisa gwe baleetera abalala gwenkanankana n'ekigero ekyo, awamu n'ebirabo eby'enjawulo bye baaweebwa.

Naye mu mukisa ogwo gwennyini, omulimu gw'okukkiriza kwabwe guziyizibwa okubulwa okwetoowaza. Omukisa emirundi mingi guba ogw'okungulu oba ogw'ekiseera kitono kubanga tebaggulawo kkubo Katonda okuba byonna. Okwetoowaza okw'ekiwanvu, awatali kubuusabuusa, kwandireese omukisa ogw'ekiwanvu era ogwuvvu. Omwoyo Omutukuvu teyandikoze mu bo ng'Omwoyo ow'amaanyi kyokka, naye ng'abeera mu bo mu kujjula kw'ekisa kye, na naddala eky'okwetoowaza, yandiyita mu bo ne yeewaayo yekka eri abakyuse bano olw'obulamu obw'amaanyi n'obutukuvu n'obunywevu obwo kaakati obulabika butono nnyo.

"Muyinza mutya okukkiriza, nga mufuna ekitiibwa okuva eri bannammwe" (Yokaana 5:44), Owooluganda! Tewali kiyinza kukuwonya ku kwegomba okufuna ekitiibwa okuva eri abantu, oba ku bunafu bw'omutima n'obulumi n'obusungu ebijja nga tekiweereddwa, okuggyako okwewaayo okunoonya ekitiibwa kyokka ekiva eri Katonda.

Leka ekitiibwa kya Katonda ow'ekitiibwa kyonna kibeere buli kimu gy'oli. Onooteebwa ku kitiibwa ky'abantu n'eky'obuntu bwo, era onoomatira era osanyuke okuba atali kintu. Okuva mu butaliiko kintu buno, onoogenda onywera mu kukkiriza, ng'owa Katonda ekitiibwa, era onoolaba nti gye weeyongera okwetoowaza mu maaso ge, gy'aba asemberera okutuukiriza buli kwegomba kw'okukkiriza kwo.
