Kyewuunyisa nti okukkiriza kwaffe kunafu bwe kutyo ng'amalala gakyafuga nnyo bwe kityo, ate nga tetunnaba na kuyiga wadde okusaba okwetoowaza ng'ekitundu ekisinga obwetaavu era eky'omukisa eky'obulokozi? Okwetoowaza n'okukkiriza mu Byawandiikibwa bikwatagana nnyo okusinga bangi bwe bamanyi. Kiraba mu bulamu bwa Kristo. Waliwo ebifo bibiri mw'ayogera ku kukkiriza okunene. Omuserikale omukulu, gwe yeewuunya olw'okukkiriza kwe, ng'agamba nti, "Mbagamba nti, siisanga kukkiriza kunene bwe kutyo mu Isiraeri wonna." teyagamba nti, "Mukama wange, sisaanira ggwe okuyingira wansi w'akasolya kange"? Ne maama oyo gwe yagamba nti, "Ggwe omukazi, okukkiriza kwo kunene!" (Matayo 15:28) teyakkiriza erinnya ly'embwa n'agamba nti, "Weewaawo, Mukama wange, naye n'embwa zirya ku bukunkumuka'? (Matayo 15:27) Kwe kwetoowaza okuleeta emmeeme okuba obutaliiko eri Katonda, era kwe kuggyawo buli kiziyiza eri okukkiriza n'akufuula okutya kyokka nti kaleme okumuswaza olw'obutamwesiga kimu kyonna. Owooluganda, wano si we tulaba ensonga y'okulemererwa mu kunoonya obutukuvu? Si kino, wadde nga tetwakimanya, ekyafuula okwewonga kwaffe n'okukkiriza kwaffe okubeera okwokungulu era okw'ekiseera kitono? Tetwalina kirowoozo ku ngeri amalala n'obuntu bwaffe gye byakyakoleramu munda yaffe mu kyama, ne ku ngeri Katonda yekka, olw'okuyingira kwe n'amaanyi ge amangi, gy'ayinza okubigobamu. Tetwategeera engeri obuntu obuggya era obwa Katonda, nga butwala ekifo ky'obuntu obukadde bwonna, gye buyinza okutufuula abeetoowaza ddala. Tetwamanya nti okwetoowaza okutuukiridde, okutakoma, era okwa buli wantu kwe kuteekwa okuba engeri ey'omulandira eya buli kusaba na buli kusemberera Katonda awamu na buli kukwatagana n'omuntu; era nti twandifaananye ng'agezaako okulaba awatali maaso, oba okuba omulamu awatali kussa, bwe tuba tugezaako okukkiriza oba okusemberera Katonda oba okubeera mu kwagala kwe, awatali kwetoowaza n'obuwombeefu bw'omutima obubunye wonna. Owooluganda, tetubadde tukola nsobi nga tweraliikirira nnyo okukkiriza, ate ng'ekiseera kyonna waliwo obuntu obukadde mu malala gaabwo nga bunoonya okwefunira omukisa n'obugagga bwa Katonda? Si kya kwewuunya nga twalemwa okukukkiriza. Ka tukyuse ekkubo lyaffe. Ka tunoonye okusooka okwetoowaza wansi w'omukono gwa Katonda ogw'amaanyi: anaatugulumiza. Omusaalaba, okufa, n'entaana, Yesu mwe yeetoowaza, bye byali ekkubo lye eridda mu kitiibwa kya Katonda. Okwegomba kwaffe kumu n'okusaba kwaffe okw'amaanyi kubeere kuno, okwetoowazibwa awamu naye era nga ye; ka tukkirize n'essanyu kyonna ekiyinza okututoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda oba abantu; kino kyokka lye kkubo eridda mu kitiibwa kya Katonda. Oboolyawo owulira okwagala okubuuza ekibuuzo. Njogedde ku abamu abalina ebyafaayo eby'omukisa, oba ababa nga bo be bavunaanyizibwako okuleetera abalala omukisa, naye nga bakendeddwa okwetoowaza. Obuuza obanga bano tebakakasa nti balina okukkiriza okw'amazima, wadde okw'amaanyi, wadde nga boolesa bulungi nnyo nti bakyanoonya nnyo ekitiibwa ekiva eri abantu. Waliwo eky'okuddamu ekisinga kimu ekiyinza okuweebwa. Naye eky'okuddamu ekikulu mu nsonga yaffe eno kye kino: mazima balina ekigero ky'okukkiriza, era ng'omukisa gwe baleetera abalala gwenkanankana n'ekigero ekyo, awamu n'ebirabo eby'enjawulo bye baaweebwa. Naye mu mukisa ogwo gwennyini, omulimu gw'okukkiriza kwabwe guziyizibwa okubulwa okwetoowaza. Omukisa emirundi mingi guba ogw'okungulu oba ogw'ekiseera kitono kubanga tebaggulawo kkubo Katonda okuba byonna. Okwetoowaza okw'ekiwanvu, awatali kubuusabuusa, kwandireese omukisa ogw'ekiwanvu era ogwuvvu. Omwoyo Omutukuvu teyandikoze mu bo ng'Omwoyo ow'amaanyi kyokka, naye ng'abeera mu bo mu kujjula kw'ekisa kye, na naddala eky'okwetoowaza, yandiyita mu bo ne yeewaayo yekka eri abakyuse bano olw'obulamu obw'amaanyi n'obutukuvu n'obunywevu obwo kaakati obulabika butono nnyo. "Muyinza mutya okukkiriza, nga mufuna ekitiibwa okuva eri bannammwe" (Yokaana 5:44), Owooluganda! Tewali kiyinza kukuwonya ku kwegomba okufuna ekitiibwa okuva eri abantu, oba ku bunafu bw'omutima n'obulumi n'obusungu ebijja nga tekiweereddwa, okuggyako okwewaayo okunoonya ekitiibwa kyokka ekiva eri Katonda. Leka ekitiibwa kya Katonda ow'ekitiibwa kyonna kibeere buli kimu gy'oli. Onooteebwa ku kitiibwa ky'abantu n'eky'obuntu bwo, era onoomatira era osanyuke okuba atali kintu. Okuva mu butaliiko kintu buno, onoogenda onywera mu kukkiriza, ng'owa Katonda ekitiibwa, era onoolaba nti gye weeyongera okwetoowaza mu maaso ge, gy'aba asemberera okutuukiriza buli kwegomba kw'okukkiriza kwo.

fields.title: Okwetoowaza n'Okufa eri Obwomu Bwaffe
fields.body_html:
"Yeetoowaza n'afuuka omuwulize okutuusa ku kufa" Abafiripi 2:8.

Okwetoowaza gwe kkubo eritwala eri okufa, kubanga mu kufa kwe kuwaayo obukakafu obusingayo obw'okutuukirira kwakwo.

Okwetoowaza kye kimuli, so ng'okufa eri obwomu bwaffe kwe kibala ekituukiridde. Yesu yeetoowaza n'atuuka okufa, n'aggulawo ekkubo naffe mwe tuteekwa okutambulira. Nga bwe kyali nga tewali kkubo ddala Ye mwe yandiyisizza okulaga okwewaayo kwe eri Katonda mu bujjuvu, oba okuleka n'okuva mu buntu bwaffe okutuuka ku kitiibwa kya Kitaawe, wabula okuyita mu kufa, bwe kityo ne ku ffe.

Okwetoowaza kuteekwa okutukulembera okufa eri obwomu bwaffe, tulyoke tukakase engeri gye twewaddeyo ffennyini mu bujjuvu eri kwo n'eri Katonda. Mu ngeri eno yokka mwe tusumululirwa okuva mu buntu obwagwa, ne tuzuula ekkubo eritwala eri obulamu mu Katonda, eri okuzaalibwa okujjuvu okw'obuntu obuggya, okwetoowaza kwe kuli omukka gwakwo n'essanyu lyakwo. Twogedde ku ekyo Yesu kye yakolera abayigirizwa be bwe yabawa obulamu bwe obw'okuzuukira. Mu kukka kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Ye, obuwombeefu obw'ekitiibwa era obwatuuzibwa ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka, yennyini yava mu ggulu okujja okubeera mu bo.

Yafuna amaanyi ag'okukola kino ng'ayita mu kufa; mu ntobo yaayo ennamba, obulamu bwe yawaayo bwali bulamu obwava mu kufa, obulamu obwaweebwayo eri okufa, ne bufunibwa okuyita mu kufa. Oyo eyajja okubeera mu bo yali Ye eyali afudde kaakano ng'awangaala emirembe n'emirembe. Obulamu bwa Yesu, omuntu we, n'okubeerawo kwe, bibaako obubonero obw'okufa n'obw'obulamu obwazaalibwa okuva mu kufa. Obulamu obwo mu bayigirizwa be nabwo bulina obubonero bw'okufa. Ekiviirako amaanyi g'obulamu bwe okumanyibwa, kwe kubeera nti Omwoyo ogw'okufa, ogw'Oyo eyafa, gwe gubeera ne gukola mu mwoyo.

Akabonero akasooka era akasinga obukulu ak'okufa kwa Mukama Yesu, mu bubonero bw'okufa obulaga omugoberezi wa Yesu ow'amazima, kwe kwetoowaza. Olw'ensonga zino ebbiri, kwetoowaza kwokka kwe kutuusa eri okufa okutuukiridde, era kufa kwokka kwe kutuukiriza okwetoowaza. Okwetoowaza n'okufa biri mu buzaaliranwa bwabyo. Okwetoowaza kwe kimuli ekitannaabika; mu kufa, ekibala kyengezebwa ne kituukirira.

Okwetoowaza kutuusa eri okufa okutuukiridde. Okwetoowaza kitegeeza okwewaayo obwomu bwaffe n'okukkiriza okuba nga toli kintu kyonna mu maaso ga Katonda. Yesu yeetoowaza n'afuuka omuwulize okutuusa ku kufa. Mu kufa, yawaayo obukakafu obusingayo era obutuukiridde nti yali awaddeyo okwagala kwe eri okwagala kwa Katonda.

Mu kufa, Yesu yeewaayo yennyini, awamu n'okutaayaaya kwe okw'obuzaaliranwa okunywa ekikompe. Yaleka obulamu bwe yalina nga yeegatta n'obuntu bwaffe, n'afa eri obwomu bwe, n'ekibi ekyamukema, bwe kityo, ng'omuntu, n'ayingira mu bulamu bwa Katonda obutuukiridde. Singa tekyandibadde lwa kwetoowaza kwe okutaliiko kkomo, nga yeeyita nga taliiko kya kubalibwa okuggyako okuba omuweereza akola era abonaabonera okwagala kwa Katonda, teyandifudde. Kino kituwa eky'okuddamu ku kibuuzo ekibuuzibwa emirundi mingi, so ng'amakulu gaakyo si bulijjo gategeerekeka bulungi. Nnyinza ntya okufa eri obwomu bwange? Okufa eri obwomu bwo si mulimu gwo; guli mulimu gwa Katonda.

Mu Kristo, oli mufu eri ekibi, obulamu obuli mu ggwe buyise mu nkola y'okufa n'okuzuukira, era oyinza okukakasa nti mazima oli mufu eri ekibi. Naye okwolesebwa okujjuvu okw'amaanyi g'okufa kuno mu mpisa zo ne mu bikolwa byo kwesigamye ku kigero Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw'awaayo amaanyi g'okufa kwa Kristo. Era wano we wetaagibwa okuyigirizibwa, bw'oba oyagala okuyingira mu bumu obujjuvu ne Kristo mu kufa kwe, n'omanya okununulibwa okujjuvu okuva mu bwomu bwo, n'oyeetoowaza. Guno gwe mulimu gwo ogumu.

Weeteeke mu maaso ga Katonda mu bunafu bwo obutuukiridde, okkirize n'omutima gwo gwonna nti tolina buyinza kwetta wadde okwewa obulamu ggwe wennyini, era ogwe wansi mu butaba kintu kyo, mu mwoyo ogw'obuwombeefu, obugumiikiriza, n'okwewaayo okw'obwesige eri Katonda. Kkiriza buli kuswazibwa, era buli muntu munno akugezesa oba akukwasa obuyinike omutwalire ng'ekkubo ly'ekisa erikuleetera okwetoowaza. Kozesa buli kakisa okwetoowaza mu maaso ga bantu bannaawo ng'obuyambi obw'okunywerera mu kwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda.

Katonda ajja kukkiriza okwetoowaza okwo ng'obukakafu nti omutima gwo gwonna kwe gwegomba, ng'ekisingira ddala obulungi, kusabire, ng'okwetegeka kwo olw'omulimu gwe ogw'amaanyi ogw'ekisa, Omwoyo we Omutukuvu bw'aliba akunyweza n'amaanyi, n'akubikkulira Kristo mu bujjuvu munda yo, Ye, mu kifaananyi kye eky'omuweereza, alyoke atondebwe ddala munda yo, era abeere mu mutima gwo. Ekkubo ery'okwetoowaza lye litwala eri okufa okutuukiridde, okumanya okujjuvu era okutuukiridde nti tuli bafu mu Kristo.

Kale kiddirira nti: Okufa kuno kwokka kwe kutuusa eri okwetoowaza okutuukiridde. Ayi, weegendereze ensobi eyo abantu bangi gye bakola, abaagala okwetoowaza naye nga batya okwetoowaza ennyo. Balina ebisaanyizo n'ebikoma bingi, okulowooza n'okubuuza kungi, ku ekyo okwetoowaza okw'amazima kwe kuteekwa okubeera n'okukola, ne batayeewaayo mu bujjuvu eri kwo. Weegendereze kino. Weetoowaze okutuusa ku kufa. Mu kufa eri obwomu bwaffe mwe kwetoowaza kwe kutuukirira. Kakasa nti mu ntobo y'okufuna okw'amazima okw'ekisa ekingi, okw'okukulaakulana kwonna okw'amazima mu kwewongera, okw'okwefaananyiriza Yesu okweyongera, wateekwa okubeerawo okufa eri obwomu bwaffe okwekakasa eri Katonda n'abantu mu mpisa zaffe n'empisa z'obulijjo.

Kya nnaku nti kisoboka okwogera ku bulamu obw'okufa n'okutambula okw'Omwoyo, ate ng'okwagala okw'ekisa okusingira ddala tekusobola butalaba nga waliwo obwomu bungi bwe biri. Okufa eri obwomu bwaffe tekulina kabonero ka kufa akakakafu okusinga okwetoowaza okuteefaayo ku kitiibwa kyakwo, okwefukamu kyokka ne kutwala ekifaananyi ky'omuweereza. Kisoboka okwogera nnyo era mu bwesimbu ku bumu ne Yesu eyanyoomebwa era eyagaanibwa, n'okusitula omusaalaba gwe, ate ng'okwetoowaza okuwombeefu, okwa wansi, okw'ekisa, era okuteredde okw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda tekulabika era nga tekunoonyezebwa n'akatono.

Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda ategeeza bintu bibiri: obuwombeefu n'okufa. Ka tunoonye okumwaniriza mu bifaananyi byombi. Mu Ye, tebyawukana; noolwekyo biteekwa okubeera ne mu ffe. Nga gwandibadde mulimu ogutaliiko ssuubi singa ffe twekakkombe okugukola! Obuzaaliranwa tebuyinza kuwangula buzaaliranwa, wadde n'obuyambi bw'ekisa. Obwomu tebuyinza kugoba bwomu, wadde mu muntu eyazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Katonda atenderezebwe! Omulimu gwakoleddwa ne guggwa, ne gutuukirizibwa emirembe gyonna. Okufa kwa Yesu, omulundi gumu emirembe gyonna, kwe kufa kwaffe eri obwomu bwaffe. Ate n'okulinnya kwa Yesu, okuyingira kwe omulundi gumu emirembe gyonna mu Watukuvu Ennyo, kutuwadde Omwoyo Omutukuvu okututuusaako mu maanyi n'okufuula obwaffe ddala amaanyi g'obulamu obw'okufa.

Omwoyo bwe gunoonya era ne gukola okwetoowaza, ne gugoberera ebigere bya Yesu, okutegeera kwagwo okw'obwetaavu bw'ekintu ekirala ekisingawo ne kuzuukusibwa. Okwegomba kwagwo n'essuubi lyagwo ne biraga amaanyi, okukkiriza kwagwo ne kunywezebwa, ne guyiga okwolekera waggulu n'okusaba n'okufuna okujjula okwo okw'amazima okw'Omwoyo gwa Yesu, okuyinza buli lunaku okukuuma okufa kwe eri obwomu n'ekibi mu maanyi gaakwo agajjuvu, era n'okufuula okwetoowaza omwoyo ogubuna mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna. (Laba ekigambo "C" ku nkomerero y'essuula eno.) Abaruumi 6:3 wagamba nti: "Oba temumanyi nga ffe fenna abaabatizibwa mu Kristo Yesu, twabatizibwa mu kufa kwe?"

Abaruumi 6:11 wagamba nti: "Bwe mutyo nammwe mwerowoozeeko nga muli bafu eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu." Okwetegeera kwonna okw'Omukristaayo kuteekwa okujjuzibwa n'okukwatibwako omwoyo ogwaleeta obulamu mu kufa kwa Kristo.

Omuntu bulijjo ateekwa okweyanjula eri Katonda ng'omu eyafiira mu Kristo, era mu Kristo ng'mulamu okuva mu bafu, ng'atwala mu mubiri gwe okufa kwa Mukama Yesu. Obulamu bwe bulijjo bulina obubonero obw'engeri bbiri, emirandira gyabwo nga gyeyongera mu kwetoowaza okw'amazima okutuuka wansi ennyo mu ntaana ya Yesu, okufa eri ekibi n'obwomu, ate omutwe gwabwo nga guyimusibbwa mu maanyi g'okuzuukira okutuuka mu ggulu Yesu gy'ali.

Ggwe akkiriza, twala mu kukkiriza okufa n'obulamu bwa Yesu ng'obubwo. Yingira mu ntaana ye mu kuwummula okuva mu bwomu n'emirimu gyabwo, okuwummula kwa Katonda. Wamu ne Kristo, eyawaayo omwoyo gwe mu mikono gya Kitaawe, weetoowaze era okke buli lunaku mu kwesigama okwo okutuukiridde, okutaliimu buyinza, ku Katonda.

Katonda ajja kukuzuukiza n'akugulumiza. Buli nkya ogwe wansi mu butaba kintu okw'ewala ennyo mu ntaana ya Yesu; buli lunaku obulamu bwa Yesu bujja kulabika mu ggwe.

Leka okwetoowaza okw'okweyagalira, okw'okwagala, okuwummudde, era okusanyufu kubeere akabonero nti mazima weeyagalidde omugabo gwo ogw'obuzaale, okubatizibwa mu kufa kwa Kristo. "Kubanga olw'ekiweebwayo kimu yatuukiriza emirembe gyonna abo abatukuzibwa." Abaebbulaniya 10:14. Emyoyo egiyingira mu kwetoowaza kwe girifuna mu Ye amaanyi ag'okulaba n'okubalira obwomu nga bufudde, era, ng'abo abayize era abafunye okuva gy'ali, okutambula mu buwombeefu bwonna n'obuteefu, nga bagumiikirizaganya mu kwagala. Obulamu obw'okufa bulabika mu buwombeefu n'obuteefu nga obwa Kristo.

EKIGAMBO C Okufa eri obwomu bwaffe, oba okuva wansi w'obuyinza bwabwo, si kintu, so tekiyinza kukolebwa lwa kuziyiza kwonna kwe tuyinza okukukola nga tukozesa amaanyi ag'obuzaaliranwa. Ekkubo erimu ery'amazima ery'okufa eri obwomu bwaffe kwe kubeera n'obugumiikiriza, obuwombeefu, okwetoowaza, n'okwewaayo eri Katonda. Guno gwe mazima era gwe butuukiridde bw'okufa eri obwomu bwaffe. Kubanga bwe nkubuuza Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda kye ategeeza, toteekwa kuntegeeza nti kye kiri era kye kitegeeza kwe kutuukirira kw'obugumiikiriza, obuwombeefu, okwetoowaza, n'okwewaayo eri Katonda? Noolwekyo, toteekwa kugamba nti okwegomba n'okukkiriza empisa zino kwe kwesiga Kristo, kwe kwewaayo ggwe wennyini eri Ye, era kwe kutuukirira kw'okukkiriza mu Ye? Ate era, olwokubanga okwekubira kuno okw'omutima gwo okugwa mu bugumiikiriza, obuwombeefu, okwetoowaza, n'okwewaayo eri Katonda mazima kwe kuleka byonna by'oli ne byonna by'olina okuva mu Adamu eyagwa, kwe kuleka mu bujjuvu byonna by'olina okugoberera Kristo. Kye kikolwa kyo eky'okukkiriza mu Ye ekisingira ddala waggulu. Kristo taliiwo wadde wamu okuggyako mu mpisa zino; bwe ziba awo, Ye aba mu bwakabaka bwe. Leka ono abeere Kristo gw'ogoberera.

"Omwoyo ogw'okwagala okwa Katonda tegusobola kuzaalibwa mu kitonde kyonna ekyagwa, okutuusa lwe kiyagala ne kironda okuba ekifu eri obwomu bwonna, mu kwewaayo okw'obugumiikiriza n'okwetoowaza eri amaanyi n'okusaasira kwa Katonda." Nnoonya obulokozi bwange bwonna ng'ayita mu birungi n'obutabaganya bw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda owuwombeefu, ow'obwetoowaze, omugumiikiriza, era abonaabona, oyo yekka alina amaanyi ag'okuzaala okuzaalibwa okw'omukisa okw'empisa zino ez'omu ggulu mu mwoyo gwange. Tewali ngeri ndala ey'obulokozi wabula mu n'olw'okuzaalibwa kw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda owuwombeefu, ow'obwetoowaze, omugumiikiriza, era eyeewaayo, mu myoyo gyaffe.

Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda bw'aleeta okuzaalibwa okw'amazima okw'obuwombeefu bwe, okwetoowaza kwe, n'okwewaayo kwe okujjuvu eri Katonda mu myoyo gyaffe, olwo lwe lunaku olw'okuzaalibwa kw'Omwoyo ogw'okwagala mu myoyo gyaffe, ogunaagenda, buli lwe tugutuukako, ne guliisa emyoyo gyaffe emirembe n'essanyu mu Katonda ebinaagenda okusangula okujjukira kwa buli kimu kye twayita emirembe oba essanyu edda. "Ekkubo lino eritwala eri Katonda terisobya. Obutasobya buno bwesigamiziddwa ku ngeri ebbiri ez'Omulokozi waffe.

1. Nga Ye Mwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, entobo y'obuwombeefu bwonna n'okwetoowaza mu mwoyo.

2. Nga Ye Ekitangaala eky'omu ggulu, era awa omukisa obutonde obutaggwaawo, n'abufuula obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu, bwe tuba abeetegefu okufuna okuwummula okw'emyoyo gyaffe mu kwewaayo okuwombeefu n'okwetoowaza eri Katonda, olwo lwe kiri nti Ye, nga Ekitangaala kya Katonda n'eggulu, atuyingirira n'essanyu, n'afuula ekizikiza kyaffe ekitangaala, n'atandika obwakabaka obwo obwa Katonda n'obw'okwagala munda yaffe, obutaliba na nkomerero."

Laba Wholly For God. (Ekitundu kyonna kisaanira okusomebwa n'obwegendereza, nga kiraga mu ngeri ey'ekitalo engeri okugwa wansi obutasalako mu kwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda, okuva ku ludda lw'omuntu, gye kkubo lyokka ery'okufa eri obwomu bwaffe).
fields.body_text: "Yeetoowaza n'afuuka omuwulize okutuusa ku kufa" Abafiripi 2:8. Okwetoowaza gwe kkubo eritwala eri okufa, kubanga mu kufa kwe kuwaayo obukakafu obusingayo obw'okutuukirira kwakwo. Okwetoowaza kye kimuli, so ng'okufa eri obwomu bwaffe kwe kibala ekituukiridde. Yesu yeetoowaza n'atuuka okufa, n'aggulawo ekkubo naffe mwe tuteekwa okutambulira. Nga bwe kyali nga tewali kkubo ddala Ye mwe yandiyisizza okulaga okwewaayo kwe eri Katonda mu bujjuvu, oba okuleka n'okuva mu buntu bwaffe okutuuka ku kitiibwa kya Kitaawe, wabula okuyita mu kufa, bwe kityo ne ku ffe. Okwetoowaza kuteekwa okutukulembera okufa eri obwomu bwaffe, tulyoke tukakase engeri gye twewaddeyo ffennyini mu bujjuvu eri kwo n'eri Katonda. Mu ngeri eno yokka mwe tusumululirwa okuva mu buntu obwagwa, ne tuzuula ekkubo eritwala eri obulamu mu Katonda, eri okuzaalibwa okujjuvu okw'obuntu obuggya, okwetoowaza kwe kuli omukka gwakwo n'essanyu lyakwo. Twogedde ku ekyo Yesu kye yakolera abayigirizwa be bwe yabawa obulamu bwe obw'okuzuukira. Mu kukka kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Ye, obuwombeefu obw'ekitiibwa era obwatuuzibwa ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka, yennyini yava mu ggulu okujja okubeera mu bo. Yafuna amaanyi ag'okukola kino ng'ayita mu kufa; mu ntobo yaayo ennamba, obulamu bwe yawaayo bwali bulamu obwava mu kufa, obulamu obwaweebwayo eri okufa, ne bufunibwa okuyita mu kufa. Oyo eyajja okubeera mu bo yali Ye eyali afudde kaakano ng'awangaala emirembe n'emirembe. Obulamu bwa Yesu, omuntu we, n'okubeerawo kwe, bibaako obubonero obw'okufa n'obw'obulamu obwazaalibwa okuva mu kufa. Obulamu obwo mu bayigirizwa be nabwo bulina obubonero bw'okufa. Ekiviirako amaanyi g'obulamu bwe okumanyibwa, kwe kubeera nti Omwoyo ogw'okufa, ogw'Oyo eyafa, gwe gubeera ne gukola mu mwoyo. Akabonero akasooka era akasinga obukulu ak'okufa kwa Mukama Yesu, mu bubonero bw'okufa obulaga omugoberezi wa Yesu ow'amazima, kwe kwetoowaza. Olw'ensonga zino ebbiri, kwetoowaza kwokka kwe kutuusa eri okufa okutuukiridde, era kufa kwokka kwe kutuukiriza okwetoowaza. Okwetoowaza n'okufa biri mu buzaaliranwa bwabyo. Okwetoowaza kwe kimuli ekitannaabika; mu kufa, ekibala kyengezebwa ne kituukirira. Okwetoowaza kutuusa eri okufa okutuukiridde. Okwetoowaza kitegeeza okwewaayo obwomu bwaffe n'okukkiriza okuba nga toli kintu kyonna mu maaso ga Katonda. Yesu yeetoowaza n'afuuka omuwulize okutuusa ku kufa. Mu kufa, yawaayo obukakafu obusingayo era obutuukiridde nti yali awaddeyo okwagala kwe eri okwagala kwa Katonda. Mu kufa, Yesu yeewaayo yennyini, awamu n'okutaayaaya kwe okw'obuzaaliranwa okunywa ekikompe. Yaleka obulamu bwe yalina nga yeegatta n'obuntu bwaffe, n'afa eri obwomu bwe, n'ekibi ekyamukema, bwe kityo, ng'omuntu, n'ayingira mu bulamu bwa Katonda obutuukiridde. Singa tekyandibadde lwa kwetoowaza kwe okutaliiko kkomo, nga yeeyita nga taliiko kya kubalibwa okuggyako okuba omuweereza akola era abonaabonera okwagala kwa Katonda, teyandifudde. Kino kituwa eky'okuddamu ku kibuuzo ekibuuzibwa emirundi mingi, so ng'amakulu gaakyo si bulijjo gategeerekeka bulungi. Nnyinza ntya okufa eri obwomu bwange? Okufa eri obwomu bwo si mulimu gwo; guli mulimu gwa Katonda. Mu Kristo, oli mufu eri ekibi, obulamu obuli mu ggwe buyise mu nkola y'okufa n'okuzuukira, era oyinza okukakasa nti mazima oli mufu eri ekibi. Naye okwolesebwa okujjuvu okw'amaanyi g'okufa kuno mu mpisa zo ne mu bikolwa byo kwesigamye ku kigero Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw'awaayo amaanyi g'okufa kwa Kristo. Era wano we wetaagibwa okuyigirizibwa, bw'oba oyagala okuyingira mu bumu obujjuvu ne Kristo mu kufa kwe, n'omanya okununulibwa okujjuvu okuva mu bwomu bwo, n'oyeetoowaza. Guno gwe mulimu gwo ogumu. Weeteeke mu maaso ga Katonda mu bunafu bwo obutuukiridde, okkirize n'omutima gwo gwonna nti tolina buyinza kwetta wadde okwewa obulamu ggwe wennyini, era ogwe wansi mu butaba kintu kyo, mu mwoyo ogw'obuwombeefu, obugumiikiriza, n'okwewaayo okw'obwesige eri Katonda. Kkiriza buli kuswazibwa, era buli muntu munno akugezesa oba akukwasa obuyinike omutwalire ng'ekkubo ly'ekisa erikuleetera okwetoowaza. Kozesa buli kakisa okwetoowaza mu maaso ga bantu bannaawo ng'obuyambi obw'okunywerera mu kwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda. Katonda ajja kukkiriza okwetoowaza okwo ng'obukakafu nti omutima gwo gwonna kwe gwegomba, ng'ekisingira ddala obulungi, kusabire, ng'okwetegeka kwo olw'omulimu gwe ogw'amaanyi ogw'ekisa, Omwoyo we Omutukuvu bw'aliba akunyweza n'amaanyi, n'akubikkulira Kristo mu bujjuvu munda yo, Ye, mu kifaananyi kye eky'omuweereza, alyoke atondebwe ddala munda yo, era abeere mu mutima gwo. Ekkubo ery'okwetoowaza lye litwala eri okufa okutuukiridde, okumanya okujjuvu era okutuukiridde nti tuli bafu mu Kristo. Kale kiddirira nti: Okufa kuno kwokka kwe kutuusa eri okwetoowaza okutuukiridde. Ayi, weegendereze ensobi eyo abantu bangi gye bakola, abaagala okwetoowaza naye nga batya okwetoowaza ennyo. Balina ebisaanyizo n'ebikoma bingi, okulowooza n'okubuuza kungi, ku ekyo okwetoowaza okw'amazima kwe kuteekwa okubeera n'okukola, ne batayeewaayo mu bujjuvu eri kwo. Weegendereze kino. Weetoowaze okutuusa ku kufa. Mu kufa eri obwomu bwaffe mwe kwetoowaza kwe kutuukirira. Kakasa nti mu ntobo y'okufuna okw'amazima okw'ekisa ekingi, okw'okukulaakulana kwonna okw'amazima mu kwewongera, okw'okwefaananyiriza Yesu okweyongera, wateekwa okubeerawo okufa eri obwomu bwaffe okwekakasa eri Katonda n'abantu mu mpisa zaffe n'empisa z'obulijjo. Kya nnaku nti kisoboka okwogera ku bulamu obw'okufa n'okutambula okw'Omwoyo, ate ng'okwagala okw'ekisa okusingira ddala tekusobola butalaba nga waliwo obwomu bungi bwe biri. Okufa eri obwomu bwaffe tekulina kabonero ka kufa akakakafu okusinga okwetoowaza okuteefaayo ku kitiibwa kyakwo, okwefukamu kyokka ne kutwala ekifaananyi ky'omuweereza. Kisoboka okwogera nnyo era mu bwesimbu ku bumu ne Yesu eyanyoomebwa era eyagaanibwa, n'okusitula omusaalaba gwe, ate ng'okwetoowaza okuwombeefu, okwa wansi, okw'ekisa, era okuteredde okw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda tekulabika era nga tekunoonyezebwa n'akatono. Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda ategeeza bintu bibiri: obuwombeefu n'okufa. Ka tunoonye okumwaniriza mu bifaananyi byombi. Mu Ye, tebyawukana; noolwekyo biteekwa okubeera ne mu ffe. Nga gwandibadde mulimu ogutaliiko ssuubi singa ffe twekakkombe okugukola! Obuzaaliranwa tebuyinza kuwangula buzaaliranwa, wadde n'obuyambi bw'ekisa. Obwomu tebuyinza kugoba bwomu, wadde mu muntu eyazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Katonda atenderezebwe! Omulimu gwakoleddwa ne guggwa, ne gutuukirizibwa emirembe gyonna. Okufa kwa Yesu, omulundi gumu emirembe gyonna, kwe kufa kwaffe eri obwomu bwaffe. Ate n'okulinnya kwa Yesu, okuyingira kwe omulundi gumu emirembe gyonna mu Watukuvu Ennyo, kutuwadde Omwoyo Omutukuvu okututuusaako mu maanyi n'okufuula obwaffe ddala amaanyi g'obulamu obw'okufa. Omwoyo bwe gunoonya era ne gukola okwetoowaza, ne gugoberera ebigere bya Yesu, okutegeera kwagwo okw'obwetaavu bw'ekintu ekirala ekisingawo ne kuzuukusibwa. Okwegomba kwagwo n'essuubi lyagwo ne biraga amaanyi, okukkiriza kwagwo ne kunywezebwa, ne guyiga okwolekera waggulu n'okusaba n'okufuna okujjula okwo okw'amazima okw'Omwoyo gwa Yesu, okuyinza buli lunaku okukuuma okufa kwe eri obwomu n'ekibi mu maanyi gaakwo agajjuvu, era n'okufuula okwetoowaza omwoyo ogubuna mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna. (Laba ekigambo "C" ku nkomerero y'essuula eno.) Abaruumi 6:3 wagamba nti: "Oba temumanyi nga ffe fenna abaabatizibwa mu Kristo Yesu, twabatizibwa mu kufa kwe?" Abaruumi 6:11 wagamba nti: "Bwe mutyo nammwe mwerowoozeeko nga muli bafu eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu." Okwetegeera kwonna okw'Omukristaayo kuteekwa okujjuzibwa n'okukwatibwako omwoyo ogwaleeta obulamu mu kufa kwa Kristo. Omuntu bulijjo ateekwa okweyanjula eri Katonda ng'omu eyafiira mu Kristo, era mu Kristo ng'mulamu okuva mu bafu, ng'atwala mu mubiri gwe okufa kwa Mukama Yesu. Obulamu bwe bulijjo bulina obubonero obw'engeri bbiri, emirandira gyabwo nga gyeyongera mu kwetoowaza okw'amazima okutuuka wansi ennyo mu ntaana ya Yesu, okufa eri ekibi n'obwomu, ate omutwe gwabwo nga guyimusibbwa mu maanyi g'okuzuukira okutuuka mu ggulu Yesu gy'ali. Ggwe akkiriza, twala mu kukkiriza okufa n'obulamu bwa Yesu ng'obubwo. Yingira mu ntaana ye mu kuwummula okuva mu bwomu n'emirimu gyabwo, okuwummula kwa Katonda. Wamu ne Kristo, eyawaayo omwoyo gwe mu mikono gya Kitaawe, weetoowaze era okke buli lunaku mu kwesigama okwo okutuukiridde, okutaliimu buyinza, ku Katonda. Katonda ajja kukuzuukiza n'akugulumiza. Buli nkya ogwe wansi mu butaba kintu okw'ewala ennyo mu ntaana ya Yesu; buli lunaku obulamu bwa Yesu bujja kulabika mu ggwe. Leka okwetoowaza okw'okweyagalira, okw'okwagala, okuwummudde, era okusanyufu kubeere akabonero nti mazima weeyagalidde omugabo gwo ogw'obuzaale, okubatizibwa mu kufa kwa Kristo. "Kubanga olw'ekiweebwayo kimu yatuukiriza emirembe gyonna abo abatukuzibwa." Abaebbulaniya 10:14. Emyoyo egiyingira mu kwetoowaza kwe girifuna mu Ye amaanyi ag'okulaba n'okubalira obwomu nga bufudde, era, ng'abo abayize era abafunye okuva gy'ali, okutambula mu buwombeefu bwonna n'obuteefu, nga bagumiikirizaganya mu kwagala. Obulamu obw'okufa bulabika mu buwombeefu n'obuteefu nga obwa Kristo. EKIGAMBO C Okufa eri obwomu bwaffe, oba okuva wansi w'obuyinza bwabwo, si kintu, so tekiyinza kukolebwa lwa kuziyiza kwonna kwe tuyinza okukukola nga tukozesa amaanyi ag'obuzaaliranwa. Ekkubo erimu ery'amazima ery'okufa eri obwomu bwaffe kwe kubeera n'obugumiikiriza, obuwombeefu, okwetoowaza, n'okwewaayo eri Katonda. Guno gwe mazima era gwe butuukiridde bw'okufa eri obwomu bwaffe. Kubanga bwe nkubuuza Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda kye ategeeza, toteekwa kuntegeeza nti kye kiri era kye kitegeeza kwe kutuukirira kw'obugumiikiriza, obuwombeefu, okwetoowaza, n'okwewaayo eri Katonda? Noolwekyo, toteekwa kugamba nti okwegomba n'okukkiriza empisa zino kwe kwesiga Kristo, kwe kwewaayo ggwe wennyini eri Ye, era kwe kutuukirira kw'okukkiriza mu Ye? Ate era, olwokubanga okwekubira kuno okw'omutima gwo okugwa mu bugumiikiriza, obuwombeefu, okwetoowaza, n'okwewaayo eri Katonda mazima kwe kuleka byonna by'oli ne byonna by'olina okuva mu Adamu eyagwa, kwe kuleka mu bujjuvu byonna by'olina okugoberera Kristo. Kye kikolwa kyo eky'okukkiriza mu Ye ekisingira ddala waggulu. Kristo taliiwo wadde wamu okuggyako mu mpisa zino; bwe ziba awo, Ye aba mu bwakabaka bwe. Leka ono abeere Kristo gw'ogoberera. "Omwoyo ogw'okwagala okwa Katonda tegusobola kuzaalibwa mu kitonde kyonna ekyagwa, okutuusa lwe kiyagala ne kironda okuba ekifu eri obwomu bwonna, mu kwewaayo okw'obugumiikiriza n'okwetoowaza eri amaanyi n'okusaasira kwa Katonda." Nnoonya obulokozi bwange bwonna ng'ayita mu birungi n'obutabaganya bw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda owuwombeefu, ow'obwetoowaze, omugumiikiriza, era abonaabona, oyo yekka alina amaanyi ag'okuzaala okuzaalibwa okw'omukisa okw'empisa zino ez'omu ggulu mu mwoyo gwange. Tewali ngeri ndala ey'obulokozi wabula mu n'olw'okuzaalibwa kw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda owuwombeefu, ow'obwetoowaze, omugumiikiriza, era eyeewaayo, mu myoyo gyaffe. Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda bw'aleeta okuzaalibwa okw'amazima okw'obuwombeefu bwe, okwetoowaza kwe, n'okwewaayo kwe okujjuvu eri Katonda mu myoyo gyaffe, olwo lwe lunaku olw'okuzaalibwa kw'Omwoyo ogw'okwagala mu myoyo gyaffe, ogunaagenda, buli lwe tugutuukako, ne guliisa emyoyo gyaffe emirembe n'essanyu mu Katonda ebinaagenda okusangula okujjukira kwa buli kimu kye twayita emirembe oba essanyu edda. "Ekkubo lino eritwala eri Katonda terisobya. Obutasobya buno bwesigamiziddwa ku ngeri ebbiri ez'Omulokozi waffe. 1. Nga Ye Mwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, entobo y'obuwombeefu bwonna n'okwetoowaza mu mwoyo. 2. Nga Ye Ekitangaala eky'omu ggulu, era awa omukisa obutonde obutaggwaawo, n'abufuula obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu, bwe tuba abeetegefu okufuna okuwummula okw'emyoyo gyaffe mu kwewaayo okuwombeefu n'okwetoowaza eri Katonda, olwo lwe kiri nti Ye, nga Ekitangaala kya Katonda n'eggulu, atuyingirira n'essanyu, n'afuula ekizikiza kyaffe ekitangaala, n'atandika obwakabaka obwo obwa Katonda n'obw'okwagala munda yaffe, obutaliba na nkomerero." Laba Wholly For God. (Ekitundu kyonna kisaanira okusomebwa n'obwegendereza, nga kiraga mu ngeri ey'ekitalo engeri okugwa wansi obutasalako mu kwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda, okuva ku ludda lw'omuntu, gye kkubo lyokka ery'okufa eri obwomu bwaffe).

fields.title: Okwetoowaza N'essanyu
fields.body_html:
"Nzija kwenyumiririza n'essanyu okusingako mu bunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke gabeere ku nze.

Kyenva nsanyukira mu bunafu, mu kuvumibwa, mu kwetaaga, mu kuyigganyizibwa, ne mu kunakuwala, ku lwa Kristo. Kubanga bwe mba omunafu, ne ndyoka mba w'amaanyi." 2 Abakkolinso 12:9, 10.

Pawulo aleme okwegulumiza olw'obukulu obw'ekitalo obw'okubikkulirwa kwe yafuna, yaweebwa eriggwa mu mubiri okumukuuma ng'eyetoowazizza. Ekyasooka Pawulo kye yayagala kwe kuriggyibwako, era yeegayirira Mukama emirundi esatu liryoke limuveeko. Okuddamu ne kujja nti ekigezo kyali mukisa, nti mu bunafu ne mu kutolobezebwa kwe kyaleeta, ekisa n'amaanyi ga Mukama mwe biyinza okwolesebwa obulungi. Amangwago Pawulo n'ayingira mu mutendera omuggya mu ngeri gye yatwala ekigezo. Mu kifo ky'okukigumiira obugumiizi, yakyenyumiririzaamu n'essanyu lingi. Mu kifo ky'okusaba okununulibwa, yakisanyukira.

Yali ayize nti ekifo eky'okutolobezebwa kye kifo eky'omukisa, eky'amaanyi, n'eky'essanyu. Buli Mukristaayo ayita mu mitendera egino ebibiri mu kunoonya kwe okw'okwetoowaza. Mu ogusooka, atya, adduka, era anoonya okununulibwa mu buli ekiyinza okumwetoowaza. Aba tannayiga kunoonya kwetoowaza ka kibe ky'omuwendo ki. Akkirizza ekiragiro eky'okwetoowaza era agezaako okukigondera, wadde nga akizuula bw'alemererwa ddala. Asaba okwetoowaza, oluusi n'obunyiikivu bungi, naye mu mutima gwe ogw'ekyama, asaba okusinga, bw'ataba mu bigambo, kale mu kwegomba, okukuumibwa eri ebintu ebyo byennyini ebinaamwetoowaza.

Aba tannayagala kwetoowaza ng'obulungi bw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, n'essanyu ery'omu ggulu, okutuusa lwe yandidde ebintu byonna okukufuna. Mu kukunoonya kwe, ne mu kukusabira kwe, wakyaliyo akakwe k'okuwulira omugugu n'obuddu; okwetoowaza tekunnafuuka kye kiva mu bulamu n'obuntu obwetoowaza mu butonde bwabwo. Tekunnafuuka ssanyu lye n'okusanyuka kwe kwokka. Tannasobola kugamba nti, "N'essanyu lingi ennyo nneenyumiririza mu bunafu, era nsanyukira buli kimwetoowaza." Tuyinza okusuubira okutuuka ku mutendera ogwo bino gye biriba? Awatali kubuusabuusa.

Kale kiki ekinatutuusa eyo? Kye kiri ekyatuusa Pawulo eyo, okubikkulirwa okuggya okwa Mukama Yesu. Tewali kirala wabula okubeerawo kwa Katonda okuyinza okwolesa n'okugoba ekyefaananyi. Pawulo yali wa kuweebwa okutegeera okusingako obulungi mu mazima amaziimu nti okubeerawo kwa Yesu kunaagoba buli kwegomba okw'okunoonya ekintu kyonna mu ffe, era kunaatusanyusa mu buli kutolobezebwa okututegeka olw'okwolesebwa kwe okujjuvu. Okutolobezebwa kwaffe kutukulembera mu kufuna okumanya okubeerawo n'amaanyi ga Yesu okulonda okwetoowaza ng'omukisa gwaffe ogusingayo obukulu.

Ka tugezeeko okuyiga amasomo ebyafaayo bya Pawulo bye bitusomesa. Tuyinza okuba n'abakkiriza abakuze, abayigiriza ab'ettutumu, n'abasajja ab'okumanya okw'omu ggulu, abatannayiga bulungi essomo ery'okwetoowaza okutuukiridde n'engeri y'okwenyumiririza n'essanyu mu bunafu. Kino tukiraba mu Pawulo. Akabi k'okwegulumiza kaali kasembera nnyo okumpi. Yali tannategeera bulungi kye kitegeeza okuba atali kantu, okufa, Kristo yekka alyoke abeere mu ye, n'okusanyukira mu buli ekyamussa wansi. Kirabika ng'eno gye yali essomo erisingayo obukulu lye yalina okuyiga, okufaanana Mukama we mu bujjuvu mu kwefuula ekitali kantu, we yeenyumiririza mu bunafu Katonda alyoke abeere byonna.

Essomo erisingayo obukulu omukkiriza ly'alina okuyiga kwe kwetoowaza, era buli Mukristaayo anoonya okukulaakulana mu butukuvu akijjukire bulungi kino! Wayinza okubaawo okwewaayo okw'amaanyi, n'obunyiikivu obungi, n'okumanya okw'omu ggulu, so nga wabula bwe kutaziyizibwa nkola za Mukama ez'enjawulo ennyo, wayinza okubaawo okwegulumiza okutamanyiddwa awamu ne byonna ebyo.

Ka tuyige essomo nti obutukuvu obusingayo obungi kwe kwetoowaza okusingayo obuwanvu, era ka tujjukire nti tekwejjiira kwokka, wabula lwe kufuulibwa ekintu eky'enkola ey'enjawulo ku ludda lwa Mukama waffe omwesigwa n'omuweereza we omwesigwa. Ka tutunuulire obulamu bwaffe mu kitangaala ky'okumanya kuno, tulabe oba twenyumiririza n'essanyu mu bunafu, oba tusanyukira, nga Pawulo bwe yakola, mu kunyigirizibwa, mu kwetaaga, ne mu biseera eby'ennaku.

Weewaawo, ka twebuuze oba twayiga okutwala okunenyezebwa, okw'ensonga oba okutali kwa nsonga, okuvumibwa okuva eri mukwano oba omulabe, okunyigirizibwa, oba akabi, oba obuzibu abalala bwe batuleetamu, ng'okusingira ddala mukisa gwa kukakasa nti Yesu ye byonna gye tuli, engeri essanyu lyaffe oba ekitiibwa kyaffe bye biri ebitaliimu, n'engeri okutolobezebwa mu mazima kwe tusanyukiramu. Mazima kya mukisa, essanyu eriziimu ery'omu ggulu, okuba nga twesumuluddwa ku kyefaananyi n'olwo buli ekyogerwa ku ffe oba ekitukolebwa kibula ne kimirwa mu kulowooza nti Yesu ye byonna.

Ka twesige oyo eyalabirira Pawulo naye atulabirire. Pawulo yali yeetaaga okukangavvulwa okw'enjawulo, awamu n'okuyigirizibwa okw'enjawulo, okuyiga ekyali eky'omuwendo okusinga n'ebintu ebitayogerekeka bye yawulira mu ggulu, kye kitegeeza okwenyumiririza mu bunafu ne mu buwombeefu. Naffe tukyeetaaga, weewaawo nnyo nnyo.

Oyo eyamulabirira naffe anaatulabirira. Atukuuma n'obwegendereza obw'obuggya n'obw'okwagala, tuleme kwegulumiza. Bwe tuba tukikola, anoonya okututegeeza ekibi n'okutununula mu kyo.

Mu kigezo, mu bunafu ne mu buzibu, anoonya okutussa wansi okutuusa lwe tuyiga nti ekisa kye kye byonna, ne kituusa okusanyukira ekintu kyennyini ekitussa era ekitukuuma wansi. Amaanyi ge agatuukirizibwa mu bunafu bwaffe, okubeerawo kwe okujjuza n'okumatiza obwereere bwaffe, kifuuka ekyama eky'okwetoowaza okutayinza kulemererwa. Kiyinza, nga Pawulo, ng'alaba bulungi Katonda ky'akola mu ffe, era n'okuyitira mu ffe, bulijjo okugamba nti, "Saali wa wansi n'akatono eri abatume abasingayo bano, wadde nga siri kantu." 2 Abakkolinso 12:11.

Okutolobezebwa kwe kwali kumutuusizza ku kwetoowaza okwa mazima, n'essanyu lyakwo ery'ekitalo n'okwenyumiririza mu buli ekyetoowaza.

"Nzija kwenyumiririza n'essanyu okusingako mu bunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke gabeere ku nze.

Kyenva nsanyukira mu bunafu, mu kuvumibwa, mu kwetaaga, mu kuyigganyizibwa, ne mu kunakuwala, ku lwa Kristo. Kubanga bwe mba omunafu, ne ndyoka mba w'amaanyi." 2 Abakkolinso 12:9-10. Omuntu omwetoowaze ayize ekyama eky'essanyu eritaggwaawo. Gy'aweddemu amaanyi, gy'akkakkana wansi. Gy'okutolobezebwa kwe bwe kweyongera okulabika obunene, gy'amaanyi n'okubeerawo kwa Kristo bwe byeyongera okuba omugabo gwe, okutuusa, nga bw'agamba, "Siri kantu," ekigambo kya Mukama we ne kileeta essanyu erisingako obuziimu. 2 Abakkolinso 12:9: "Ekisa kyange kikumala." Mpulira nga nteekwa okuddamu omulundi omulala okukuŋŋaanya byonna mu masomo abiri ago; akabi k'amalala kasingako obunene era kasingako okumpi okusinga bwe tulowooza, n'ekisa eky'okwetoowaza nakyo bwe kityo. Akabi k'amalala kasingako obunene era kasingako okumpi okusinga bwe tulowooza, naddala mu kiseera eky'okumanya kwaffe okusingayo obukulu.

Omubuulizi ow'amazima ag'omwoyo ng'ekkanisa emwesiga ng'ewuubaala ku bigambo bye, omwogezi omulina ekirabo ku katale ak'Obutukuvu ng'annyonnyola ebyama eby'obulamu obw'omu ggulu, Omukristaayo ng'awa obujulizi ku kufuna okw'omukisa, omuvaanjuzi ng'agenda mu maaso ng'awangudde, era ng'afuuse omukisa eri ebibiina ebisanyuka, tewali muntu amanyi akabi akakwese, akatamanyiddwa, ako abo be baba bafunye. Pawulo yali mu kabi nga takimanyi; Yesu kye yamukolera kyawandiikibwa okutulabula tulyoke tumanye akabi kaffe era tumanye obukuume bwaffe bwokka.

Oba nga wabaddewo kye kyogerwa ku muyigiriza oba oyo ayatula obutukuvu, nti ajjudde ekyefaananyi, oba nti takola ky'abuulira, oba nti omukisa gwe tegumufudde mwetoowaze, muteefu, ekyo kireme kuddamu kwogerwa. Yesu, gwe twesiga, ayinza okutufuula abetoowaze. Weewaawo, ekisa eky'okwetoowaza kisingako obunene era kisingako okumpi okusinga bwe tulowooza. Okwetoowaza kwa Yesu kwe bulokozi bwaffe. Yesu yennyini ye kwetoowaza kwaffe.

Okwetoowaza kwaffe kwe kulabirira kwe n'omulimu gwe. Ekisa kye kitumala, okutuyamba n'okusinga ekikemo eky'amalala nakyo. Amaanyi ge galituukirizibwa mu bunafu bwaffe. Ka tulonde okuba abanafu, okuba abawombeefu, n'okuba abatali kantu.

Okwetoowaza kutubeerere ssanyu n'okusanyuka. Ka twenyumiririze n'essanyu era tusanyukire mu bunafu, mu buli ekiyinza okutwetoowaza n'okutukuuma wansi, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke gabeere ku ffe. Kristo yeetoowaza, Katonda kyeyava amugulumiza. Kristo alitwetoowaza, era alitukuuma nga twetoowazizza. Ka tukkirize n'omutima gwaffe gwonna, tukkirize n'obwesige n'essanyu byonna ebyetoowaza, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke gabeere ku ffe.

Tujja kuzuula nti okwetoowaza okusingayo obuwanvu kye kyama eky'essanyu erisinga obwa mazima, essanyu eritayinza kuzikirizibwa kintu kyonna.

Akkirizza ekiragiro eky'okwetoowaza era agezaako okukigondera, wadde nga akizuula bw'alemererwa ddala. Okutolobezebwa kwaffe kutukulembera mu kufuna okumanya okubeerawo n'amaanyi ga Yesu okulonda okwetoowaza ng'omukisa gwaffe ogusingayo obukulu. Ka tugezeeko okuyiga amasomo ebyafaayo bya Pawulo bye bitusomesa. fields.title: Obwetoowaze n'Okugulumizibwa
fields.body_html:
"Oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa." Lukka 14:11, 18:14.

"Mwetoowaze mu maaso ga Mukama, naye alibagulumiza." Yakobo 4:10.

"Kale mwetoowaze wansi w'omukono gwa Katonda ogw'amaanyi, alyoke abagulumize mu kiseera ekituufu." 1 Peetero 5:6.

Jjo lwennyini nnabuuzibwa ekibuuzo nti, nnaawangula ntya amalala gano? Eky'okuddamu kyali kyangu.

Ebintu bibiri bye byetaagisa. Kola ekyo Katonda ky'agamba nti gwe mulimu gwo era weetoowaze. Mwesige akole ekyo ky'agamba nti gwe mulimu gwe, era alikugulumiza. Ekiragiro kitegeerekeka bulungi, weetoowaze. Ekyo tekitegeeza nti gwe mulimu gwo okuwangula n'okugoba amalala ag'obuzaale bwo, n'okwekolera munda yo obwetoowaze bwa Yesu omutukuvu. Nedda, guno gwe mulimu gwa Katonda. Ye nsibuko yennyini ey'okugulumizibwa okwo, mw'akugulumiza n'akutuusa mu kufaananako okw'amazima okw'Omwana omwagalwa.

Ekiragiro kye kitegeeza kye kino: kozesa buli kkubo okwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda n'omuntu. Ng'okkiririza mu kisa ekimaze okukola munda yo, ng'okakasibwa ekisa ekisingawo olw'obuwanguzi obujja, okutuuka ku kitangaala omuntu we w'omunda ky'ateekawo buli luvannyuma ku malala g'omutima n'emirimu gyago, wadde nga waliwo okulemererwa n'okugwa, yimirira n'obugumu wansi w'ekiragiro ekitakyuka, weetoowaze.

Kkiriza n'okwebaza buli kimu Katonda ky'akkiriza okuva munda oba ebweru, okuva eri mukwano oba mulabe, mu buzaale oba mu kisa, okukujjukiza obwetaavu bwo obw'okwetoowaza, n'okukuyamba okukituukako. Twala obwetoowaze nga ddala bwe mpisa enkulu, obuvunaanyizibwa bwo obusooka mu maaso ga Katonda, obwo obw'olubeerera obukuuma emmeeme, era teeka omutima gwo ku bwo ng'ensulo ya buli mukisa. Ekisuubizo kya Katonda era kya mazima: oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa (Lukka 14:11). Laba nga okola ekintu ekimu Katonda ky'asaba, weetoowaze. Katonda alikola ekintu ekimu ky'asuubizza. Alikuwa ekisa ekisingawo, era alikugulumiza mu kiseera ekituufu.

Enkola za Katonda zonna n'omuntu ziriko emitendera ebiri. Waliwo ekiseera ky'okweteekateeka, ekiragiro n'ekisuubizo lwe biba, awamu n'okukaddiŋŋana okugatta okufuba n'obunafu, okulemererwa n'obuwanguzi obw'ekitundu, wamu n'okusuubira okutukuvu okw'ekintu ekisingako obulungi, ekizuukusa, ekitendeka era ekikangavvula abantu okutuuka ku mutendera oguwaggulu. Awo ne wajja ekiseera ky'okutuukirira, okukkiriza lwe kusikira ekisuubizo ne kusanyukira ekyo kye kwafubira emirundi mingi awatali kugasa. Etteeka lino likola bulungi mu buli kitundu ky'obulamu bw'Ekikristaayo, ne mu kunoonya buli mpisa eyawukana kubanga linywereddwa mu ntobo y'ebintu byennyini. Mu byonna ebikwata ku kununulibwa kwaffe, Katonda y'ateekwa okusooka.

Ekyo bwe kimala okukolebwa, olwo omuntu n'atuukako. Mu kufuba okugondera n'okutuukiriza, ateekwa okuyiga okumanya obunafu bwe, mu kwekukkakkana yeefiirize, alyoke asobozesebwe mu kweyagalira ne mu magezi okuweebwa Katonda enkomerero, okutuukiriza kw'ekyo kye yakkiriza entandikwa yaakyo mu butamanya. Bw'atyo, Katonda eyali Entandikwa, ng'omuntu tannamutegeera bulungi, oba okumanyira ddala ekigendererwa kye, ayaayaanibwa era ayanirizibwa ng'Enkomerero, nga Byonna mu byonna. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu kunoonya obwetoowaze.

Eri buli Mukristaayo ekiragiro kiva ku ntebe ya Katonda yennyini, weetoowaze. Okufuba okw'amaanyi okuwuliriza n'okugondera kulisasulwa, weewaawo, kulisasulwa n'okuzuula okunakuwaza okw'ebintu bibiri. Ekimu, obuziba obw'amalala obw'obutaagala kweraba nga kimereru era okubalibwa nga kimereru, n'okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda, bwe waaliwo, omuntu bwe yali tamanyi. Ekirala, obunafu obungi ennyo obuli mu kufuba kwaffe kwonna, ne mu kusaba kwaffe kwonna okw'obuyambi bwa Katonda, okuzikiriza ekisolo ekyo eky'entiisa.

Aweereddwa omukisa omuntu kaakano ayiga okuteeka essuubi lye mu Katonda, n'okugumiikiriza, wadde ng'amaanyi gonna ag'amalala gali munda ye, mu bikolwa eby'okwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda n'abantu. Tumanyi etteeka ery'obuntu; ebikolwa bizaala empisa, empisa zizaala engeri, engeri zikola okwagala, n'okwagala okukoleddwa obulungi bwe buntu.

Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu mulimu gw'ekisa. Ng'ebikolwa, bwe biddiŋŋanwa awatali kuwummula, bizaala empisa n'engeri, era bino bwe binyweza okwagala, Oyo akola mu ffe okwagala n'okukola ajja n'amaanyi ge amangi n'Omwoyo we; n'okwetoowaza kw'omutima ogw'amalala omutukuvu eyeenenya kwe yeeteeka emirundi mingi mu maaso ga Katonda, kusasulwa ekisa ekisingawo eky'omutima ogw'obwetoowaze, omwo Omwoyo wa Yesu mw'awangulidde, n'atuusa obuzaale obuggya ku bukulu bwabwo, era Ye, omuwombeefu era omwetoowaze, kaakano abeeramu emirembe gyonna. Mwetoowaze mu maaso ga Mukama, naye alibagulumiza. Kale okugulumizibwa kuli mu ki? Ekitiibwa ekisinga eky'ekitonde kiri mu kuba ekibya kyokka, okufuna, okusanyuka n'okwoleka ekitiibwa kya Katonda.

Kino kiyinza kukikola bwe kiba nga kyetegese okuba nga tekiri kintu mu kyo kyennyini, Katonda alyoke abeere byonna. Amazzi bulijjo gasooka kujjula mu bifo ebya wansi ennyo. Omuntu gy'akka wansi era gy'aba omulele mu maaso ga Katonda, ekitiibwa kya Katonda gye kiyingira mangu era mu bujjuvu obusingawo. Okugulumizibwa Katonda kw'asuubiza si, era tekuyinza kuba, kintu kya kungulu ekitali Ye yennyini: byonna by'alina okuwa oba by'ayinza okuwa kwe kweyongera okwewa yekka, Ye yennyini okwetwalira mu bujjuvu obusingawo. Okugulumizibwa si, ng'empeera ey'oku nsi, kintu eky'obwerere, ekitalina nkolagana na mpisa eteekwa okusasulwa. Nedda, naye mu butonde bwakwo kwe kivaamu era kye kigobererwa eky'okwetoowaza kwaffe. Si kintu kirala wabula kirabo eky'obwetoowaze obwo obw'obuKatonda obubeera munda, okufaananako n'okuba n'obwetoowaze obw'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, obutusobozesa okufuna mu bujjuvu Katonda okubeera munda yaffe.

Oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa. Ku bituufu bw'ebigambo bino, Yesu yennyini ye bukakafu; ku bukakafu obw'okutuukirira kwabyo mu ffe, Ye ye musingo. Twetikke ekikoligo kye tuyige okuva gy'ali, kubanga muwombeefu era mwetoowaze mu mutima. Bwe tuba abeetegefu okumukutamira, nga naye bwe yatukutamira, aliddayo okukutamira buli omu ku ffe, era tulyeraba nga twesibiddwa wamu naye mu bwenkanya.

Bwe tugenda tuyingira mu buziba mu kussaakinnyi kw'okwetoowaza kwe, ne twetoowaza oba ne twetikka okutoowazibwa kw'abantu, tuyinza okwesiga nti Omwoyo ogw'okugulumizibwa kwe, "Omwoyo wa Katonda n'ogw'ekitiibwa," alituwummuliramu. Okubeerawo n'amaanyi ga Kristo eyagulumizibwa birijjira abo abalina omwoyo omwetoowaze.

Katonda bw'aliddamu okuba n'ekifo kye ekituufu mu ffe, alitugulumiza. Bw'oba weetoowaza, ssaako omwoyo ku kitiibwa kye. Ye alissaako omwoyo ku kitiibwa kyo ng'atuukiriza obwetoowaze bwo, era ng'akufuuwamu Omwoyo gwennyini ogw'Omwana we, ng'obulamu bwo obw'olubeerera. Ng'obulamu bwa Katonda obubuna byonna bwe bukwetwalira, tewaliba kintu kya butonde nnyo, era tewaliba kya luwoomerere nnyo, ng'okuba nga toli kintu, nga tolina kirowoozo wadde okwegomba kwa ku ggwe wennyini, kubanga byonna bimaliddwa Oyo ajjuza byonna. "N'essanyu lingi nnyimirira mu bunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke ganziireko."

Owooluganda, tetulina nsonga lwaki okwewaayo kwaffe n'okukkiriza kwaffe bigasizza katono nnyo mu kunoonya obutukuvu? Omulimu gwakolebwa nga guyita mu bwefu n'amaanyi gaabwo mu linnya ery'okukkiriza; Katonda yayitibwa olw'obwefu n'essanyu lyabwo; era, awatali kutegeera, naye nga kituufu, emmeeme yasanyukira mu bwefu n'obutukuvu bwabwo. Twali tetumanyi nti obwetoowaze, okubeera mu Kristo okw'olubeerera, obwetoowaze obufaanana obwa Kristo n'okweggyawo, obubuna era obulambika obulamu bwaffe bwonna ne Katonda n'omuntu, bwe bwali ekintu ekisinga obukulu mu bulamu obw'obutukuvu bwe twanoonya.

Mu kubeera ne Katonda mwokka mwe nzikiririza nze wennyini. Nga bwe kiri mu buwanvu, obugazi n'ekitiibwa eky'omusana, obutono obw'akafuufu akazannya mu misana gyagwo we kalabikira, bwe kutyo n'obwetoowaze kwe kutwala ekifo kyaffe mu maaso ga Katonda okuba nga tuli kafuufu kokka akabeera mu musana ogw'okwagala kwe. Ayogera naffe nti: "Mbeera mu kifo ekigulumivu era ekitukuvu, era ne oyo alina omwoyo omwenenya era omuwombeefu, okuzzaamu amaanyi omwoyo gw'abawombeefu, n'okuzzaamu amaanyi omutima gw'abeenenya." Isaaya 57:15.

Kino kibeere omugabo gwaffe! "Woowe, okuba omulele okusingako, omwetoowaze okusingako, Omutono, atafiibwako, era atamanyibwa, Era eri Katonda ekibya ekitukuvu okusingako, Ekijjudde Kristo, era Kristo yekka!"

EBIGAMBO D Ekyama eky'Ebyama: Obwetoowaze bwe Mmeeme y'Okusaba okw'Amazima. Okutuusa omwoyo gw'omutima lwe gunaazzibwamu obuggya, okutuusa lwe gunaggibwamu okwegomba kwonna okw'ensi, ne guyimirira mu njala n'ennyonta eya bulijjo eya Katonda, kwe mwoyo ogw'amazima ogw'okusaba; okutuusa olwo, okusaba kwaffe kwonna kunaabanga, ekitundu oba ekirala, kufaanana nnyo ebigambo ebiyigirizibwa abayizi; era emirundi mingi tunaabyogeranga, olw'okuba nga tetwaŋŋanga kubiragajjalira. Naye toterebuka; ddira amagezi agajja wammanga, olwo n'oyinza okugenda mu kkanisa awatali kabi konna ak'okukola akamwa kwokka oba obunnanfuusi, wadde nga waliwo oluyimba oba okusaba, olulimi lwabyo lwe lusinga olw'omutima gwo. Kola kino: genda mu kkanisa ng'omusolooza w'omusolo bwe yagenda mu yeekaalu; yimirira munda mu mwoyo gw'omutima gwo mu ngeri eyo gye yayoleka ebweru, bwe yassa amaaso ge wansi, n'asobola kwogera bwogezi nti, "Katonda, onsaasire nze" Yimirira awatakyukakyuka, wadde mu kwegomba kwo kwokka, mu ngeri eno oba embeera eno ey'omutima; kiritukuza buli kusaba okuva mu kamwa ko; era ekintu kyonna bwe kisomebwa oba okuyimbibwa oba okusabibwa, ekisinga omutima gwo okugulumira, bw'okifuula omukisa ogw'okweyongera okukka wansi mu mwoyo gw'omusolooza, olwo oliyambibwa, era oliweebwa omukisa mungi, olw'okusaba n'okutendereza okwo okulabika ng'okw'omutima ogusinga ogugwo obulungi.

Kino, munnange, kye kyama eky'ebyama; kirikuyamba okukungula gy'otaasiga, era kiribeera ensulo eya bulijjo ey'ekisa mu mmeeme yo; kubanga buli kintu ekitanula munda yo, oba ekikutuukako ebweru, kifuuka birungi bya mazima gy'oli, bwe kisanga oba kikuteekamu embeera eno ey'obwetoowaze mu mutima.

Kubanga tewali kya bwereere, wadde ekitaliimu magoba eri emmeeme eyeetoowaza; ebeera bulijjo mu mbeera ey'okukula okw'obuKatonda; buli kimu ekigigwako kiri ng'omusulo ogw'omu ggulu gy'eri. Kale, weesibire mu ngeri eno ey'Obwetoowaze; obulungi bwonna busibiddwa mu bwo; gwe mazzi ag'omu ggulu agakyusa omuliro gw'emmeeme egwidde ne gufuuka obuwombeefu obw'obulamu obw'obuKatonda, era agakola amafuta ago, okwagala Katonda n'omuntu mwe kufunira olulimi lwakwo olw'omuliro.

Kale, beera nga wesibiddwamu bulijjo; kibeere ng'ekyambalo ky'obikkibwako bulijjo, n'olukoba lw'osibibwa; toweeza mukka gwonna wabula mu mwoyo gwakwo era okuva mu gwo; tolaba kintu wabula n'amaaso gaakwo; towulira kintu wabula n'amatu gaakwo. Ka obe mu kkanisa oba ebweru w'ekkanisa, ng'owulira ettendo lya Katonda oba ng'ofuna obukyamu okuva mu bantu n'ensi, byonna biriba kuzimba, era buli kimu kiriyamba okukulaakulanya okukula kwo mu bulamu bwa Katonda (The Spirit of Prayer, Pt II, p.

121).

OKUSABA OLW'OBWETOOWAZE Wano nja kukuwa ekyokugezesa ekitalemererwa ekirigenkanya byonna eri amazima. Kye kino: veeko ku nsi ne ku mboozi zonna, okumala omwezi gumu gwokka; toluwandiika, so toluowuunya oba okuwakana ekintu kyonna newennyini; komya emirimu gyonna egy'edda egy'omutima gwo n'ebirowoozo byo: era, n'amaanyi gonna ag'omutima gwo, yimirira omwezi guno gwonna, nga bw'osobola obutayosa, mu ngeri y'okusaba eno eri Katonda. Kusabe emirundi mingi ng'ofukamidde; naye ka obe ng'otudde, ng'otambula, oba ng'oyimiridde, beera bulijjo ng'oyaayaanira munda, era ng'osaba n'obunyiikivu okusaba kuno okumu eri Katonda: "Nti olw'obulungi bwe obungi akumanyise, era aggye mu mutima gwo, buli kika n'engeri n'omutindo gw'amalala, ka gabe gava mu myoyo emibi oba mu buzaale bwo obwonoonefu; era nti akuzuukusemu obuziba obusingayo obunyweevu era amazima g'obwetoowaze obwo, obuyinza okukufuula asobola okufuna ekitangaala kye n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu." Gaana buli kirowoozo, okuggyako eky'okulindirira n'okusaba mu nsonga eno okuva mu ntobo y'omutima gwo, n'amazima n'obunyiikivu obwenkana ng'abantu abali mu kubonaabona bwe baagala okusaba ne banunulibwa. Bw'osobola era bw'oyagala okwewaayo mu mazima ne mu bwesimbu eri omwoyo guno ogw'okusaba, nja kuvuma nti, singa waliwo mu ggwe emyoyo emibi emirundi ebiri ng'egyali mu Malyamu Magudaleene, gyonna girigobwa mu ggwe, era oliwalirizibwa awamu naye okukaabira amaziga ag'okwagala ku bigere bya Yesu omutukuvu. The Spirit of Prayer, Pt.

2, p. 124.
fields.body_text: "Oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa." Lukka 14:11, 18:14. "Mwetoowaze mu maaso ga Mukama, naye alibagulumiza." Yakobo 4:10. "Kale mwetoowaze wansi w'omukono gwa Katonda ogw'amaanyi, alyoke abagulumize mu kiseera ekituufu." 1 Peetero 5:6. Jjo lwennyini nnabuuzibwa ekibuuzo nti, nnaawangula ntya amalala gano? Eky'okuddamu kyali kyangu. Ebintu bibiri bye byetaagisa. Kola ekyo Katonda ky'agamba nti gwe mulimu gwo era weetoowaze. Mwesige akole ekyo ky'agamba nti gwe mulimu gwe, era alikugulumiza. Ekiragiro kitegeerekeka bulungi, weetoowaze. Ekyo tekitegeeza nti gwe mulimu gwo okuwangula n'okugoba amalala ag'obuzaale bwo, n'okwekolera munda yo obwetoowaze bwa Yesu omutukuvu. Nedda, guno gwe mulimu gwa Katonda. Ye nsibuko yennyini ey'okugulumizibwa okwo, mw'akugulumiza n'akutuusa mu kufaananako okw'amazima okw'Omwana omwagalwa. Ekiragiro kye kitegeeza kye kino: kozesa buli kkubo okwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda n'omuntu. Ng'okkiririza mu kisa ekimaze okukola munda yo, ng'okakasibwa ekisa ekisingawo olw'obuwanguzi obujja, okutuuka ku kitangaala omuntu we w'omunda ky'ateekawo buli luvannyuma ku malala g'omutima n'emirimu gyago, wadde nga waliwo okulemererwa n'okugwa, yimirira n'obugumu wansi w'ekiragiro ekitakyuka, weetoowaze. Kkiriza n'okwebaza buli kimu Katonda ky'akkiriza okuva munda oba ebweru, okuva eri mukwano oba mulabe, mu buzaale oba mu kisa, okukujjukiza obwetaavu bwo obw'okwetoowaza, n'okukuyamba okukituukako. Twala obwetoowaze nga ddala bwe mpisa enkulu, obuvunaanyizibwa bwo obusooka mu maaso ga Katonda, obwo obw'olubeerera obukuuma emmeeme, era teeka omutima gwo ku bwo ng'ensulo ya buli mukisa. Ekisuubizo kya Katonda era kya mazima: oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa (Lukka 14:11). Laba nga okola ekintu ekimu Katonda ky'asaba, weetoowaze. Katonda alikola ekintu ekimu ky'asuubizza. Alikuwa ekisa ekisingawo, era alikugulumiza mu kiseera ekituufu. Enkola za Katonda zonna n'omuntu ziriko emitendera ebiri. Waliwo ekiseera ky'okweteekateeka, ekiragiro n'ekisuubizo lwe biba, awamu n'okukaddiŋŋana okugatta okufuba n'obunafu, okulemererwa n'obuwanguzi obw'ekitundu, wamu n'okusuubira okutukuvu okw'ekintu ekisingako obulungi, ekizuukusa, ekitendeka era ekikangavvula abantu okutuuka ku mutendera oguwaggulu. Awo ne wajja ekiseera ky'okutuukirira, okukkiriza lwe kusikira ekisuubizo ne kusanyukira ekyo kye kwafubira emirundi mingi awatali kugasa. Etteeka lino likola bulungi mu buli kitundu ky'obulamu bw'Ekikristaayo, ne mu kunoonya buli mpisa eyawukana kubanga linywereddwa mu ntobo y'ebintu byennyini. Mu byonna ebikwata ku kununulibwa kwaffe, Katonda y'ateekwa okusooka. Ekyo bwe kimala okukolebwa, olwo omuntu n'atuukako. Mu kufuba okugondera n'okutuukiriza, ateekwa okuyiga okumanya obunafu bwe, mu kwekukkakkana yeefiirize, alyoke asobozesebwe mu kweyagalira ne mu magezi okuweebwa Katonda enkomerero, okutuukiriza kw'ekyo kye yakkiriza entandikwa yaakyo mu butamanya. Bw'atyo, Katonda eyali Entandikwa, ng'omuntu tannamutegeera bulungi, oba okumanyira ddala ekigendererwa kye, ayaayaanibwa era ayanirizibwa ng'Enkomerero, nga Byonna mu byonna. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu kunoonya obwetoowaze. Eri buli Mukristaayo ekiragiro kiva ku ntebe ya Katonda yennyini, weetoowaze. Okufuba okw'amaanyi okuwuliriza n'okugondera kulisasulwa, weewaawo, kulisasulwa n'okuzuula okunakuwaza okw'ebintu bibiri. Ekimu, obuziba obw'amalala obw'obutaagala kweraba nga kimereru era okubalibwa nga kimereru, n'okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda, bwe waaliwo, omuntu bwe yali tamanyi. Ekirala, obunafu obungi ennyo obuli mu kufuba kwaffe kwonna, ne mu kusaba kwaffe kwonna okw'obuyambi bwa Katonda, okuzikiriza ekisolo ekyo eky'entiisa. Aweereddwa omukisa omuntu kaakano ayiga okuteeka essuubi lye mu Katonda, n'okugumiikiriza, wadde ng'amaanyi gonna ag'amalala gali munda ye, mu bikolwa eby'okwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda n'abantu. Tumanyi etteeka ery'obuntu; ebikolwa bizaala empisa, empisa zizaala engeri, engeri zikola okwagala, n'okwagala okukoleddwa obulungi bwe buntu. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu mulimu gw'ekisa. OKUSABA OLW'OBWETOOWAZE Wano nja kukuwa ekyokugezesa ekitalemererwa ekirigenkanya byonna eri amazima. Kye kino: veeko ku nsi ne ku mboozi zonna, okumala omwezi gumu gwokka; toluwandiika, so toluowuunya oba okuwakana ekintu kyonna newennyini; komya emirimu gyonna egy'edda egy'omutima gwo n'ebirowoozo byo: era, n'amaanyi gonna ag'omutima gwo, yimirira omwezi guno gwonna, nga bw'osobola obutayosa, mu ngeri y'okusaba eno eri Katonda. Kusabe emirundi mingi ng'ofukamidde; naye ka obe ng'otudde, ng'otambula, oba ng'oyimiridde, beera bulijjo ng'oyaayaanira munda, era ng'osaba n'obunyiikivu okusaba kuno okumu eri Katonda: "Nti olw'obulungi bwe obungi akumanyise, era aggye mu mutima gwo, buli kika n'engeri n'omutindo gw'amalala, ka gabe gava mu myoyo emibi oba mu buzaale bwo obwonoonefu; era nti akuzuukusemu obuziba obusingayo obunyweevu era amazima g'obwetoowaze obwo, obuyinza okukufuula asobola okufuna ekitangaala kye n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu." Gaana buli kirowoozo, okuggyako eky'okulindirira n'okusaba mu nsonga eno okuva mu ntobo y'omutima gwo, n'amazima n'obunyiikivu obwenkana ng'abantu abali mu kubonaabona bwe baagala okusaba ne banunulibwa. Bw'osobola era bw'oyagala okwewaayo mu mazima ne mu bwesimbu eri omwoyo guno ogw'okusaba, nja kuvuma nti, singa waliwo mu ggwe emyoyo emibi emirundi ebiri ng'egyali mu Malyamu Magudaleene, gyonna girigobwa mu ggwe, era oliwalirizibwa awamu naye okukaabira amaziga ag'okwagala ku bigere bya Yesu omutukuvu. The Spirit of Prayer, Pt. 2, p. 124.
